Pointwise projected ODE estimates are unsafe under the recorded Calderón–Zygmund spikes; the correct framework is a dual Jacobi-field/Wronskian flux with ambient-tower subtraction and signal normalization. [Steps 32–36, 42, 46–49]

- ADE invariant calculations give local algebraic restrictions: \(A_1\) has full five-dimensional Weyl freedom on the relevant chiral block, \(A_3\) a three-dimensional block, \(D_4\) a two-dimensional block, most \(A_k\) and higher \(D_k\) one-dimensional blocks, and \(E_6,E_7,E_8\) no invariant spin-2 component on the nontrivial block. These do not alone exclude a bubble in a compactness sequence. [Steps 46–47, 62]

## Biquard source retrieval and operator-norm scaling

- The primary source Biquard arXiv:1105.4904 was retrieved. The relevant estimate is Section 4, Lemmas 4.1–4.2, not Section 14. For the refined glued metric,
  \[
  |\nabla^k(\operatorname{Ric}_{g_t}-\Lambda g_t
      -t\textstyle\sum_j\lambda_j\chi_to_j)|_{\rm EH}
  \le C_k t^2\rho^{2-k},
  \qquad \rho\le t^{-1/4}.
  \]
  The source’s \(o_j\) are global smooth \(L^2\)-decaying EH tensors; compact support appears only after multiplication by the gluing cutoff. The equation is written
  \[
  D_{\rm EH}\operatorname{Ric}(h)
  =\Lambda g_{\rm EH}+\sum_j\lambda_jo_j
  \]
  unless the obstruction coefficients are explicitly rescaled. [Steps 58, 66]

- Since \(g_t\sim t\,g_{\rm EH}\), a \((0,2)\)-tensor of EH norm \(A\) has operator size \(t^{-1}A\). Thus a refined residual \(O(t^2\rho^2)\) becomes \(O(t\rho^2)\), \(O(t)\) on the core and at most \(O(t^{1/2})\) at \(\rho=t^{-1/4}\). A nonzero \(t\lambda o\) first obstruction remains order one after raising an index. Higher exact-gluing obstruction terms are subcritical for the near-pinching input problem. [Steps 49–50, 58]

- The source controls a refined insertion in Biquard’s setting; it does not by itself prove a compact, reversed-chirality, four- or 36-bubble theorem with all gauge, kernel, and interaction terms. Neck disjointness separates supports but does not remove global Green-operator coupling. [Steps 58–59, 65–69]

## Resonance, exponential drift, and the flux dichotomy

- In the ALE frame, the \(l=2\) radial operator
  \[
  Lf=f''+3r^{-1}f'-8r^{-2}f
  \]
  has roots \(2,-4\). A constant source produces
  \[
  f_p=\frac S6r^2\log(r/r_0)
      -\frac S{36}\left(r^2-r_0^6r^{-4}\right).
  \]
  If \(S\sim t\delta\) and the outer radius is \(R\sim t^{-1/2}\), the obstruction coefficient drifts by
  \[
  O(t\delta\log(1/t))
  \]
  relative to an \(O(t)\) signal. The earlier claim that the \(\delta\log(1/t)\) condition could be removed was circular because it assumed the two-scale rate it sought to prove. [Steps 59–60]

- The first toric-cone realization was invalid. Its degree-two mode introduced a traceful \(O(1)\) Ricci defect, violated smoothness on degeneration axes, and had inconsistent energy scaling. The replacement uses normal-coordinate quadratic Einstein jets. Algebraic curvature tensors in dimension four form a 20-dimensional space; Ricci contraction has rank 10, so the fixed-Ricci tangent is the full ten-dimensional Weyl space
  \[
  \operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\Lambda^+)\oplus
  \operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\Lambda^-).
  \]
  Symbolic checks verified that Weyl-direction jets have zero linearized Ricci at the center and that radial drift terms vanish there, remaining \(O(\delta)\) at the outer edge under the selected schedule. This proves local two-jet reachability, not a closed smooth neck. [Steps 61–63]

- The clean-annulus flux calculation is now established in the cumulative manuscript rather than merely hypothesized. If \(K\) is a TT homogeneous quadratic tensor and \(o=r^{-n-2}K\) with \(o(\nu,\cdot)=0\), then gauge terms vanish under integration by parts and
  \[
  \int_A\langle D\operatorname{Ric}\,u,o\rangle
  =-\frac{n+2}{2}I_K.
  \]
  In dimension four the coefficient is \(-3\). In the spherical model,
  \[
  I_K=v_\Gamma/216,\qquad J_K=v_\Gamma/9,
  \]
  yielding lower bounds \(1/(8L)\) in the unrestricted case and \(1/(6L)\) under the constant-scalar constraint. [Steps 69–70]

- The correct necessity statement for an actual bubbling sequence remains conditional. Under harmonic/Bianchi neck coordinates, ambient Einstein-tower subtraction, endpoint quadratic models, weighted nonlinear control, finite-node uniformity, and inner/outer flux matching, a nonzero Weyl mismatch forces
  \[
  \delta L\ge c,\qquad L\asymp|\log t|,
  \]
  hence
  \[
  t\le e^{-c/\delta}.
  \]
  If \(\delta|\log t|\to0\), the projected first obstruction must vanish. Step 70 organized the needed transfer assumptions as T1–T8; the manuscript handles the clean identity, while weighted energy and inner/outer matching remain central open inputs. [Steps 69–71]

- The exponential branch is sharp only at the local two-jet level. Step 63 showed that the free Cotton/trace-free-Hessian channel can drift through Weyl space with \(O(\delta)\) Ricci defect, but no globally closed neck or closed near-pinched sequence realizing this behavior has been proved. Consequently it is incorrect to say that both global branches of the dichotomy are realized. [Steps 60–63, 70–71]

## Positive noncollapsed proof architecture and its open status

- A conditional proof architecture for the noncollapsed part of \(P_4^+\) was articulated at Step 71. Assume a noncollapsed sequence \((M_i,g_i)\) with \(\delta_i\to0\) and no Einstein metric on \(M_i\). Cheeger–Naber extraction should give an Einstein orbifold limit after fixing a diffeotype. If there is no bubbling, smooth recovery contradicts the no-Einstein assumption. With bubbling, the limit defines a Biquard–Ozuch desingularization datum. If tight pinching forces the whole finite-dimensional obstruction tower to vanish and Ozuch’s transversality/kernel hypotheses hold, exact desingularization would produce an Einstein metric on the same smooth manifold, again a contradiction. [Step 71]

- This is a research architecture, not a theorem. Its named gaps are: higher-mode necessity beyond the first flux identity; Ozuch transversality and treatment of four full-gauged scalar kernel directions on the product orbifold; and exclusion or absorption of the exponentially thin neck branch. The local two-jet drift result neither proves nor disproves global realizability. [Steps 68–71]

## Product-quotient mixed-wall families

- For the negative mirror
  \[
  O=(\Sigma_2\times\Sigma_2)/
    \langle\iota\times\iota\rangle,
  \]
  there are 36 isolated \(A_1\) points and
  \[
  \chi=56,\qquad
  \tau=-36+2r,\qquad
  (b_+,b_-)=(9+r,45-r).
  \]
  Every row satisfies strict Hitchin–Thorpe. The all-compatible endpoint is a smooth double cover of \(\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1\) branched over a smoothed \((6,6)\) curve with ample canonical class and a negative Kähler–Einstein metric; the all-reversed endpoint is its orientation reverse. [Steps 55–56]

- All sign-pattern fillings in both product-quotient mirrors are simply connected. For the negative family this follows from the simply connected smoothing and the fact that each \(\pm2\) disk-bundle filling kills the same boundary \(\mathbb Z/2\) image. Hence simplicial-volume, Sambusetti, and BCG-type obstructions are vacuous there. [Steps 56–57]

- In every mixed row, non-torsion \(+2\)-spheres occur in both orientations with \(b_+>1\). Adjunction combined with Witten/Taubes implies no mixed row admits a Kähler or symplectic structure in either orientation. This strengthens the earlier Noether-parity check but also removes the standard source of nonzero monopole invariants. Known tools being silent does not prove Einstein existence or nonexistence. [Steps 56–57]

- The positive mirror \((S^2\times S^2)/\mathbb Z_2\) has four \(A_1\) nodes and product Einstein curvature
  \[
  R_+=R_-=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0).
  \]
  Both chiralities therefore have two-dimensional first-obstruction kernels. Its mixed rows have \(\chi=8\) and include the homeomorphism types
  \[
  \#_2\mathbb{CP}^2\#4\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2,\quad
  \#_3(S^2\times S^2),\quad
  \#_3\mathbb{CP}^2\#3\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2,\quad
  \#_4\mathbb{CP}^2\#2\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2.
  \]
  They are simply connected, PSC, strict-Hitchin–Thorpe, ordinary-SW-void, and non-Kähler/non-symplectic in both orientations. Their smooth Einstein status remains open. [Steps 44–57, 64, 72]

- The Step-64 seam-spin ledger corrected the claim that every balanced pattern is \(\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\). The four \(\mathbb{RP}^3\) seams carry two Rokhlin \(\mu\)-types. A filling is spin exactly when the two reversed \(\pm2\)-disk-bundle pieces occupy the two distinguished seams. Thus balanced patterns realize both a spin type homeomorphic to \(\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\) and a nonspin type homeomorphic to
  \[
  \#_3\mathbb{CP}^2\#3\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2.
  \]
  This is a Freedman homeomorphism classification; exotic diffeotypes are not excluded. The all-compatible row recovers the known degree-four del Pezzo type \(\mathbb{CP}^2\#5\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2\), providing a consistency anchor. [Step 64]

- The negative higher-genus family has
  \[
  N=4(h+1)^2,\qquad
  \chi=8(h^2+h+1),\qquad
  \tau=-4(h+1)^2+2r.
  \]
  Its Hitchin–Thorpe margins are
  \[
  2\chi+3\tau=4(h-1)^2+6r,\qquad
  2\chi-3\tau=4(h-1)^2+6(N-r),
  \]
  always positive. Endpoints, already Einstein, minimize every margin-monotone obstruction. Enlarging this wall cannot produce a contradiction based only on \(\chi,\tau,\|M\|\), or degree. [Steps 57, 59, 61]

## Exact-desingularization evidence on the product orbifold

- LeBrun–Ozuch’s admissible-sequence result applies when all bubbles have \(W^+\equiv0\) in the induced orientation. For the product Kähler–Einstein orbifold with \(c_1^2=4\), admissible sequences lie on the degree-four del Pezzo Kähler–Einstein side. This corrects the earlier suggestion that uncomputed higher obstructions prohibit all nearby exact metrics on the control row: nearby Kähler–Einstein degenerations are known there. [Step 67]

- Reversed bubbles are precisely the non-admissible case left open by that theorem. The first vector obstruction vanishes for either EH chirality because
  \[
  R_+=R_-=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0).
  \]
  A nonzero higher mixed obstruction would exclude only exact Einstein metrics near that degeneration; it would neither harm the operator-norm near-pinched construction nor exclude a far Einstein metric. Vanishing plus transversality could instead produce new positive Einstein examples on mixed rows. [Steps 67–72]

- The product ambient quadratic jet has five active components in the \(\omega_i^+\circ\omega_j^-\) basis, only one in the \(U(2)\)-invariant sector. The node isotropy is \(T^2\), not \(U(2)\). Therefore the earlier three-function radial EH correction cannot represent the physical ambient data; nonradial \(l=2\) modes are required. [Step 67]

- The reflection
  \[
  c(z,w)=(\bar z,w)
  \]
  is an orientation-reversing product isometry, commutes with the quotient involution, fixes all four nodes, and exchanges \(\Lambda^\pm\). It proves all-order conjugacy of compatible and reversed single-node obstruction problems. Globally it sends the reversed set \(S\) to \(S^c\), so \(r=1\) and \(r=3\) systems must be equivalent, and balanced \(r=2\) systems must respect complement symmetry. It does not imply literal equality of coefficient arrays in unrelated bases. [Steps 68–69]

- Ozuch’s convention is
  \[
  P=\tfrac12\nabla^*\nabla-\mathring R,
  \]
  while Kröncke’s \(\Delta_E=2P\). For \(h_{\mathrm{rel}}=g_1-g_2\) on \(S^2(\Lambda)\times S^2(\Lambda)\),
  \[
  Ph_{\mathrm{rel}}=-\Lambda h_{\mathrm{rel}},
  \]
  not \(-4\Lambda h_{\mathrm{rel}}\). This is a negative saddle direction bounded away from zero. [Steps 68–69]

- A direct \(S^2\) Hessian audit resolved a degraded TTCS conflict. For a first spherical harmonic \(f\),
  \[
  \nabla^2f=-\Lambda fg.
  \]
  A scalar-sector tensor
  \[
  Afg_1+Bfg_2+C\nabla^2f
  \]
  reduces to \((A-C\Lambda)fg_1+Bfg_2\); trace-free and divergence-free conditions force it to vanish. Factor TT modes vanish on \(S^2\), mixed modes are positive, and \(g_1-g_2\) is negative rather than zero. Thus the quotient TT kernel is zero. The full gauged \(P\)-kernel nevertheless has four non-TT scalar directions generated by invariant \(l=1\) harmonics times the two factor metrics; a faithful Green-operator calculation must slice or project these modes. [Steps 68–69]

- The needed inter-node object is not the bare value sum \(\sum\psi(p_i)\psi(p_j)/\lambda\). An EH end supplies an \(r^{-4}\) tensor quadrupole; its effect at a second node is the normalized second jet of the Bianchi-gauge Green solution after singular-part subtraction, full-kernel projection, and local constant-term normalization. The mixed Ozuch coefficient computation was not completed. [Steps 67–69]

## EH metric-export attempts and corrected local construction

- Direct metric-export attempts showed that raw EH insertion has order-one operator defect:
  \[
  \operatorname{Ric}_{t g_{\rm EH}}-\Lambda(tg_{\rm EH})
  \]
  has endomorphism norm \(|\Lambda|\) on the core. The correction is essential, not cosmetic. [Steps 65–66]

- On EH, \(\Delta(r^2)=8\) exactly, but \(h=cr^2g_{\rm EH}\) does not solve the full linearized Ricci equation because Hessian-of-trace and symmetrized-divergence terms do not vanish. The symbolic check gave
  \[
  D\operatorname{Ric}_{00}[cr^2g]
  =2c\frac{a^4+3r^4}{a^4-r^4},
  \]
  rather than a constant multiple of \(g_{00}\). A conformal ansatz also retained an order-one defect. [Step 65]

- For the \(U(2)\)-invariant diagonal ansatz, the extracted highest-derivative system has rank two. The left-null relation gives the compatibility constraint
  \[
  \Lambda r^6-(3r^4+1)f_1
  +2(r^4+1)f_2+2r^5f_2'
  +(r^4-1)f_3+r(r^4-1)f_3'=0.
  \]
  This constraint propagates under the two second-order equations; the remaining degree is radial diffeomorphism gauge and must be fixed by Bianchi gauge. It is not an independent equation for \(f_1'\). [Steps 65–66]

- A finite-difference least-squares profile reduced an interior linearized residual to max about \(0.0125\), median about \(5\times10^{-4}\), but hit the iteration limit and had a bolt defect about \(4.7\times10^3\). Its nonlinear operator audit remained roughly \(18\)–\(20\) globally and about \(0.65\) even on \(r>1.2\) over tested scales. Scalar cutoff profiles similarly left \(O(1)\) core defects. These are diagnostic failures, not near-pinching certificates. [Step 66]

- Radial Kähler variations satisfy the checked identity
  \[
  D\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm EH}(h_\phi)
  =-\tfrac12\,i\partial\bar\partial(A_\phi+B_\phi).
  \]
  However,
  \[
  i\partial\bar\partial(r^2)
  =(4+4r^{-4})e^0\wedge e^3
   +(4-4r^{-4})e^1\wedge e^2,
  \]
  so it is not proportional to the EH Kähler form. The end potential with \(A=B=4\),
  \[
  \phi=r^2+\tfrac12\log\frac{r^2-1}{r^2+1},
  \]
  is logarithmically singular at the bolt. This is a cohomological obstruction in the fixed-complex-structure scalar channel, not the whole Biquard obstruction space. [Step 66]

- The cumulative manuscript supplies the correct explicit radial core. It gives a biaxial Einstein family \(q_\Lambda\) on the \(\mathcal O(-2)\) disk bundle. Differentiating at \(\Lambda=0\) and subtracting
  \[
  V=\frac5{72}(r^3-r^{-1})\partial_r
  \]
  yields a smooth tensor \(\widetilde h\) satisfying
  \[
  D\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm EH}\widetilde h=g_{\rm EH}
  \]
  with the required far-field quadratic behavior. Independent symbolic differentiation reproduced the manuscript’s coefficients. This solves the radial inner source but not the full non-\(U(2)\) ambient matching. [Steps 68–69]

## Logarithmic Weyl interpolation

- For a Weyl tensor \(C\), let
  \[
  K_{ij}=-\tfrac13C_{ikjl}x^kx^l.
  \]
  The checked model satisfies: \(K\) is trace-free, divergence-free, harmonic, and in radial gauge, and
  \[
  D\operatorname{Ric}_e\bigl(\eta(\log r)K\bigr)
  =-\frac{\eta_{tt}+6\eta_t}{2r^2}K.
  \]
  Thus a logarithmically long annulus interpolates a pure-Weyl quadratic mismatch with Ricci error \(O(1/L)\). [Steps 68–69]

- The manuscript’s fixed-\(A_1\)-resolution construction combines this interpolation with the explicit \(q_\Lambda\) core and finite patching to produce
  \[
  \delta_\sigma(g_a)\le \frac C{|\log a|}\to0
  \]
  under its fixed local representation, filling, marking, smoothness, and gluing hypotheses. The local formulas and constants were independently checked in representative sectors, while the theorem remains an internal cumulative research result rather than an externally verified full Yau-26 theorem. It supplies near-pinched input metrics; it neither proves exact desingularization nor excludes far-away Einstein metrics. [Steps 68–72]

## Smooth-category fidelity and Burns/ADE evidence

- Negative Einstein nonexistence examples in the LeBrun record are generated by nonminimal \((-1)\)-blowups. Their natural local model is Burns,
  \[
  \phi(s)=s+\log s,\qquad
  \det(g_{i\bar j})=1+1/s,
  \]
  which is scalar-flat Kähler but not Ricci-flat. Scaling makes its Ricci endomorphism order \(t^{-1}\), so an ordinary blowup core cannot be hidden in a \(\|\operatorname{Ric}+g\|_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\) sequence. Pinching-compatible Ricci-flat ALE pieces instead model crepant/ADE topology. [Steps 43, 53–54]

- Complex-structure Kähler–Einstein nonexistence does not imply smooth Einstein nonexistence. ADE minimal resolutions are diffeomorphic to their Milnor fibers; Brieskorn simultaneous resolution and Ehresmann identify the global smooth manifolds in a smoothing family. The nodal quintic examined earlier therefore carries an Einstein metric on the same smooth manifold after smoothing to an ample-canonical quintic, despite the original resolution having nef-big-not-ample canonical class. [Steps 54–56]

## Higher dimensions

- The inspected literature produced no established closed manifold of dimension \(n\ge5\) carrying no Einstein metric of any sign. Nonexistence of invariant Einstein metrics is insufficient. Thus a high-dimensional refutation would first require a new no-Einstein manifold, itself an open problem in the checked record. [Steps 22–24, 58]

- Cheeger–Naber singular strata in \(n\ge5\) have codimension at least four. A higher-dimensional analogue of the EH obstruction would need a pointwise bundle-valued condition
  \[
  R_{{\rm normal},\pm}(y)\zeta(y)
  \]
  with normal-connection and tangential-derivative terms. A warped toy model shows that \(O(1)\) tangential variation of the ALE parameter causes unsuppressed curvature. No stratified ALE-bundle theorem of the needed strength is available. [Steps 46, 53–54]

- Stable Lean algebraic kernels exist for the Heisenberg model, Bochner identities, local twist algebra, flux constants, scalar-sector TT algebra, dimensional counts, and elementary dichotomy arithmetic. In particular, `Step69FluxKernelAlgebra.lean` compiles and its audited theorem uses only the permitted axioms `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. `Step70FluxDichotomyAlgebra.lean` formalizes rational threshold arithmetic and dimension-count formulas. These files do not formalize Ricci geometry. [Steps 27–29, 69–70]

- `Step70LowDimAndStructure.lean` records the \(n=2\) and \(n=3\) reductions using declared geometric axioms for uniformization and Ricci-flow convergence. It is therefore documentation of dependency shape, not a formal proof of those dimensions. [Step 70]

- A direct imported-name search found Riemannian-manifold and metric infrastructure but no visible native interfaces under the searched names for Ricci, Riemann curvature, scalar curvature, sectional curvature, Levi-Civita connection, or Christoffel symbols. The failed faithful-statement probe and successful synthetic shell establish a practical environment limitation, not a theorem about all of Mathlib. `Step71Yau26SyntheticStatement.lean` formalizes only the proposition’s quantifier shape over uninterpreted predicates. Its clean audit must not be represented as a Ricci-geometric formalization. [Steps 71–72]

- Future formalization must either build a genuine curvature layer—connection, curvature, Ricci contraction, quadratic-form inequalities, Einstein predicate, and closed-manifold quantification—or wait for a theorem whose geometry can be encoded faithfully. Further synthetic shells or isolated arithmetic audits do not satisfy the user’s proposition-consistency and independent-kernel-verification requirement. [Step 72]

## 负分支开局：Min–Oo 尺度逃逸与算子范数中的第一障碍临界性 [Steps 1–3, 22–24, 32]

最初核对 Min–Oo 原论文 OCR 与记号，纠正了把其附加条件理解成局部 Ricci 控制的倾向。Min–Oo 在负标量归一化、小 Ricci 各向异性并满足 \(d(g)^2\max|K_g|<\Lambda^2\) 时得到 Einstein 存在；该尺度条件不由本题双侧 Ricci 夹逼自动给出 [Step 1]。因此若某个无 Einstein 流形族存在 \(\|\operatorname{Ric}_{g_j}+g_j\|_{\rm op}\to0\)，必须通过直径、Weyl/全曲率集中、塌缩或线性化近核退化逃离 Min–Oo 紧致区，至少 \(d(g_j)^2\max|K_{g_j}|\to\infty\) [Steps 1–2]。闭双曲流形本身可精确满足 \(\operatorname{Ric}=-g\) 而直径任意大，说明直径控制不可能成为一般负分支终点 [Step 22]。

会话组最早尝试利用 Morteza–Viaclovsky、Ozuch 型 orbifold 解消在无 Einstein 流形上制造 near-Einstein 度量。用 `workspace/scripts/orbifold_scaling_exponents.py` 把 weighted tensor 估计换成本题的 Ricci-endomorphism 范数后发现：若 \(\operatorname{Ric}_{g_t}-\Lambda g_t-t\lambda\chi_t o=O_{g_{\rm cal}}(t^2\rho^2)\)、\(g_t\sim t\,g_{\rm cal}\)，普通余项升指标后核心区为 \(O(t)\)、过渡区至多 \(O(t^{1/2})\)，但第一障碍项 \(t\lambda o\) 升指标后是阶一非标量 endomorphism；Calabi 核上障碍张量有非平凡特征值差，调整标量 Einstein 常数不能消掉该谱间隙 [Steps 1–2]。由此，第一障碍非零已知的 MV 非存在例和 Ozuch 的 \(L^p\)/GH near-Einstein 例不能直接反驳本题；多奇点障碍仅在积分上相消也无用，因为本题要求逐点上确界小。有效解消构造必须在每个局部使第一障碍向量消失，或使相对幅度 \(|\lambda_j|/|\Lambda_j|\to0\) [Steps 1–3]。Step 32 将此整理为 obstruction-amplitude principle：本题的 \(C^0\) Ricci 算子范数恰是第一障碍的尺度临界范数，weighted 或积分小性不能代替它 [Step 32]。Steps 48–50 进一步明确：第二及更高障碍升指标后通常为 \(O(t)\) 或更小，对 exact Einstein gluing 重要，但对制造 near-pinched 输入度量并非负载性障碍 [Steps 48–50]。这一原则在 Steps 55–64 的混合泡构造中被反复使用，并在 Step 58 由 Biquard 原文直接锚定。

## LeBrun–Seiberg–Witten 路线的错误修复、稳定积分障碍与零余量边界 [Steps 2–4, 22–24, 33–64]

Step 2 曾误写四维 Einstein Chern–Gauss–Bonnet 项，并错误声称 \(X\#k\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2\) 对所有 \(0<k<A=c_1^2(X)\) 都无负 Einstein 度量；用户叫停后 Step 3 完整撤回并修复。正确公式为：当 \(\operatorname{Ric}=\lambda g\) 时
\[
8\pi^2(2\chi+3\tau)=4\int |W^+|^2+\frac43\lambda^2V
\]
[Step 3]。修复还厘清 LeBrun 估计使用 monopole 类凸包及自对偶投影，不是单个 blow-up 类的平方。对符号族平均后可取 \(a=\pi^*K_X\)，得 \((a^+)^2\ge A\)，恢复文献阈值：粗标量估计给 \(k\ge2A/3\)，精细标量–\(W^+\) 估计给 \(k\ge A/3\) 的 Einstein 非存在 [Step 3]。记录为 `workspace/scripts/step3_corrected_lebrun_bounds.py` 和 `workspace/notes/step3_stable_integral_obstruction_principle.md` [Steps 3–4]。

该路线形成稳定积分障碍原则：若对所有度量成立的曲率积分不等式与 Einstein CGB 拓扑量之间有严格余量，而 near-Einstein 补偿仅为 \(\frac12\int|E|^2=O(\delta^2)V\)，则 exact Einstein 非存在稳定成正的 Ricci-pinching 下界 [Steps 3–4]。固定 blow-up 比率 \(p=k/A\) 时不等式齐次；代表性界为
\[
\frac{\delta}{1-\delta}\ge\sqrt{\frac{p-1/3}{2}},
\]
任意固定 \(p>1/3\) 都有与 \(A\) 无关的正间隙 [Steps 3–4, 53]。Step 54 修正了重要混淆：LeBrun 的 exact Einstein 非存在阈值包含等号 \(k\ge A/3\)，所以 \(p=1/3\) 时非存在结论仍成立；消失的是稳定 pinching 余量，而不是 LeBrun 非存在本身 [Step 54]。故已知无 Einstein 复曲面族中的真正残余风险集中在 \(p\downarrow1/3\) 的零余量边界、塌缩、尺度逃逸或其他不被稳定积分估计捕捉的机制。Step 64 的路由分配把"在 p 略大于 1/3 的 Ishida–LeBrun 流形上构造显式 near-pinched 度量、检验稳定间隙公式是否锐利"定为 A02 在负侧的有界补位实验（pre-registered），其余负链工作留给 A01/A03 [Step 64]。

## 四维正 pinching：CGB–Weyl 预算、拓扑筛选与紧致性纠偏 [Steps 3–11, 17–18]

若 \(\|\operatorname{Ric}-\sigma g\|_{\rm op}\le\delta\)，四维 CGB 与 Ricci 特征值优化给出
\[
\int |W|^2+\beta(\delta)V\le8\pi^2\chi,
\]
可用小 \(\delta\) 区间内 \(\beta(\delta)>0\) [Step 4]。正分支还有 \(\operatorname{Ric}\ge(1-\delta)g\)，故 Myers、Bishop、Bochner 给直径上界、体积上界、\(b_1=0\) 和有限基本群；更小 \(\delta\) 时由 \(2\chi\pm3\tau\) 的曲率表达式得严格 Hitchin–Thorpe [Steps 2,4–5,18]。因此 \(\#_5\mathbb{CP}^2\) 等违反 HT 的流形不能成为 tight positive-pinching 候选；Step 17 曾误称其为外部 Einstein 障碍，Step 18 撤回 [Steps 17–18]。这些预算不排除塌缩：透镜空间说明有限基本群阶没有维数统一上界，\(b_1=0\) 不排除有限商塌缩、细颈、注入半径退化、orbifold/ALE 泡 [Steps 3–5]。正标量曲率使通常 SW/monopole 非存在机制失效，候选逐渐转向 \(M_k=\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\) 一类经典拓扑障碍允许但 Einstein 存在性未知的流形 [Steps 8,18]。

Step 5 曾错误地从双侧 Ricci 界、直径界、总体积下界和 \(\delta_i\to0\) 推出统一 harmonic radius、光滑 Einstein 极限与固定微分拓扑；TTCS 指出 \(n\ge4\) 时即使 exact Einstein 序列也可发生 Weyl 集中、orbifold 极限与 ALE 泡 [Step 5]，erratum 为 `workspace/notes/step5_erratum_theorem2_correction.md`。一个可复用的条件性有限型结论是：四维 \(\|\operatorname{Ric}-g\|_{\rm op}\le\delta<1/2\) 且 \(\operatorname{Vol}(M)\ge v>0\) 时，Myers 与 Bishop–Gromov 给单位球非塌缩，Cheeger–Naber 给有限微分同胚型 [Step 9]。因此若 \(M_k\) 且 \(k\to\infty\) 存在 tight 正 pinching 序列，其总体积不能有统一正下界；large-\(k\) stress family 的潜在反例必然塌缩 [Steps 9, 43–45]。Step 64 把非塌缩 wall 的平衡行与该 stress family 的 \(k=3\) 成员在同一个同胚型上汇合（见下文 product quotient 节）[Step 64]。

## Calderón–Zygmund spike：点态二阶正则化路线的决定性否定及其后续约束 [Steps 11, 30, 33–35, 42, 47, 58]

Step 11 直接构造反例，否定"\(C^0\) Ricci pinching 加小局部 \(L^2\) 曲率可推出点态 \(|\mathrm{Rm}|\) 界"。在 \(S^2(1)\times S^2(1)\) 上取相反 warping
\[
g=dx^2+dy^2+e^{2(F_1+u)}d\theta^2+e^{2(F_2-u)}d\phi^2,
\]
使 \(\operatorname{Hess}u\) 在 Ricci 基块中抵消，Ricci 主要感知 \(\Delta u\)，而混合 Riemann 分量保留完整 Hessian [Step 11]。取
\[
w_\sigma(X,Y)=-\tfrac12XY\log(X^2+Y^2+\sigma^2),\quad a_j=\Lambda^{-2/3},\quad \sigma_j=e^{-\Lambda},
\]
得 \(\|\operatorname{Ric}_{g_j}-g_j\|_{\rm op}=O(\Lambda^{-2/3})\to0\)、\(|\operatorname{Rm}_{g_j}|(0)\gtrsim\Lambda^{1/3}\to\infty\)，且局部 Hessian/\(L^2\) 贡献趋零 [Step 11]。记录于 `workspace/notes/step11_cz_spike_and_proposition_A.md` 与相应脚本。

该模型迫使后续 compactness、smoothing 和 projection 使用 harmonic radius、弱型体积估计、有限 \(L^p\)/BMO、相对 Sobolev、cover 非塌缩或能量量子，而不能恢复 pointwise \(C^2\) 控制 [Steps 11, 21–24]。spike 否定的是点态曲率 epsilon-regularity，不必否定 almost-volume-cone 上的 \(C^{1,\alpha}\) 控制 [Steps 33, 35]。它两次改变 Route A：Step 42 放弃 \((\hat g_i-g_{\rm EH})/t_i^2\) 的 pointwise 二阶极限，改用 angular mode projection；Step 47 又指出必须写弱配对 ODE，把二阶导数移到 TT/Jacobi 测试场上 [Steps 42, 47]。

Step 58 补上了这条线的正则性对照：Cheeger–Tian 原始 JAMS 论文未能取回（AMS 403），二手来源 Ge–Jiang 2017 陈述 CT 定理为 exact Einstein 四维流形在小局部 \(L^2\) 曲率下无需体积假设的点态 epsilon regularity；Step-11 spike 在结构上封死了把它移植到 \(C^0\) Ricci pinching 的任何直接路线——Einstein 度量满足椭圆曲率方程组，而单纯 \(L^\infty\) Ricci 夹逼留下不受控的 trace-free Hessian 通道。记录于 `workspace/notes/step58_biquard_ct_and_collapse_ceiling.md` [Step 58]。同一"自由通道"（\(\nabla\operatorname{Ric}\)/Cotton 与 trace-free Hessian 不受 \(C^0\) 夹逼控制）后来在 Step 60 成为指数 neck 漂移渠道的机制基础 [Step 60]。

## Torus 约化、rod/corner 方程与 alternating stress family [Steps 12–21, 25–26]

CZ ansatz 导向一般 torus 约化 \(g=g_B+h_{IJ}(d\phi^I+A^I)(d\phi^J+A^J)\)、\(w=\sqrt{\det h}\)。符号 jet 计算给出竖直 trace 方程
\[
\Bigl(-\Delta_B+\tfrac12|F|_h^2\Bigr)w=2\lambda w
\]
（Einstein 情形）与 twist 守恒 \(d(wh_{IJ}*_BF^J)=0\) [Step 12]；轨道空间边界 \(w=0\)、内部 \(w>0\)，形成带非负 twist 势的 Dirichlet ground-state 图景 [Steps 12–13]。无 twist 对角形式 \(g=g_B+p^2d\theta^2+q^2d\phi^2\) 下，研究多次纠正符号：Step 14 混淆 Hessian 项错误推出 \(K_B\ge3\)；正确关系为
\[
K_B=\tfrac14\bigl(|\nabla v|^2-|\nabla\log w|^2\bigr),\qquad
-\Delta_Bp=(1-K_B)p,\quad -\Delta_Bq=(1-K_B)q,
\]
边缘方程 \(Q''+(1-2K_B|_{\rm edge})Q=0\) [Steps 14, 25]。Step 17 撤回任意轨道曲面的欧氏 Faber–Krahn；Step 25 撤销虚假约束 \(\int K_Bw=\int w\)，Green 配对只给 rod 间 flux 等分 [Steps 17, 25]。

## 高维正 Einstein collapse、Heisenberg 多尺度机制、almost-Killing 桥与塌缩重构 [Steps 24–30, 42–45, 58, 60]

Step 24 检验四维自由圆塌缩障碍能否推广到高维，Kaluza–Klein 计算给出反例：恒长主圆丛中
\[
\operatorname{Ric}_M^H=\operatorname{Ric}_B-\tfrac12(\phi\circ\phi),\quad
\operatorname{Ric}_M(U,U)=\tfrac12|\phi|^2,\quad
\operatorname{Ric}_M^{mix}=\pm\tfrac12d_B^*\phi,
\]
取 \(B=S^2_{\operatorname{Ric}=2}\times N^d_{\operatorname{Ric}=1}\)、\(\phi=\sqrt2\,\omega_{S^2}\)，得到每个 \(n\ge5\) 的精确正 Einstein collapse
\[
L(q,1)\times N^d\cong(S^3(\sqrt2)/\mathbb Z_q)\times N^d,
\]
纤维长度和体积随 \(q^{-1}\) 衰减而截面曲率有界 [Step 24]。因此正 collapse 不能整体禁止，只能区分 Einstein-compatible 与不兼容的 collapse；四维圆障碍是低维特殊机制。

非阿贝尔 nilpotent fiber 方向，Step 26 建立 cohomogeneity-one 模型 \(g=dt^2+a(t)^2(\theta_1^2+\theta_2^2)+c(t)^2\theta_3^2\)（\([E_1,E_2]=E_3\)），定义 \(b=c/a^2\)、\(k_1=a'/a\)、\(k_3=c'/c\)、\(H=2k_1+k_3\)，推导并用 `step26_heisenberg_moving_frame_ricci.py` 验证
\[
\operatorname{Ric}_{00}=-2(k_1'+k_1^2)-(k_3'+k_3^2),\quad
\operatorname{Ric}_{11}=\operatorname{Ric}_{22}=-\tfrac{b^2}{2}-k_1'-Hk_1,\quad
\operatorname{Ric}_{33}=\tfrac{b^2}{2}-k_3'-Hk_3.
\]
竖直 Ricci 归一后约束 \(C_\Lambda=b^2+4k_1^2+8k_1k_3+4\Lambda=0\) 满足 \(C'=-2HC\)；样本 \(b_0=20\) 局部积分满足 exact positive Einstein ODE，否定"正 Ricci 点态迫使 bracket 小"；大 bracket 伴随 \(|T|\sim b\) 与快速相对尺度变化 [Steps 26–27]。正 \(\Lambda\) 时 \(b\) 在 regular 区间无临界点，闭圆轨道或普通端点无法闭合；负 Einstein 的 \(\mathbb{CH}^2\) horosphere 允许 plateau。此结果只覆盖四维对角、无 twist、一维 base ansatz [Step 27]。

Step 28 提升为 ansatz-free 的 Killing 中心 Bochner 界：闭流形上 \(\int|\nabla Z|^2=\int\operatorname{Ric}(Z,Z)\)，中心方向 fiber geometry 给 \(\langle b^2\rangle_{|Z|^2}\le2(\Lambda+\delta)\) [Step 28]。TTCS 纠正：闭流形 compact Lie algebra 不含非阿贝尔 nilpotent 等距子代数；但四维 nilpotent fiber 维数至多三，非阿贝尔情形只有 \(H_3\)，所有 bracket 落在中心，故若能获得尺度正确的中心 exact/almost-Killing 场，中心 Bochner 足以控制全部 bracket [Steps 28–29]。almost-Killing 恒等式修正为
\[
\int|\nabla Z|^2=\int\operatorname{Ric}(Z,Z)+\tfrac12\int|\sigma|^2-\tfrac14\int(\operatorname{tr}\sigma)^2.
\]
真正缺口是从 Ricci-only collapse 构造长度可比、Lie derivative 足够小的中心 almost-Killing 场：Cheeger–Fukaya–Gromov 需要全曲率界，Kapovitch–Wilking/Naber–Zhang 不给 invariant metric 或 \(L_Zg\) 控制；Step 30 变分思路未闭合，平锥上 \(r\partial_r\) 警告不能未经模型分析使用普通 Killing 能量 [Steps 28–30]。此桥自 Step 29 后无实质突破。Step 58 进一步裁定：透镜空间、内建主丛等对称例子不能用来"测试"almost-Killing 产生，因为它们恰好预设了待构造的场；有成效的姿态是对抗性的——把 Step-29 局部 twist-spike 全局化，或让遇到的障碍成为证明 [Step 58]。

Step 58–60 把正塌缩重构为更清晰的形态：四维 tight 正 pinching 加 \(\operatorname{Vol}\to0\) 时 Chern–Weil 给
\[
\int|W^\pm|^2\to2\pi^2(2\chi\pm3\tau),
\]
对 \(\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\) 总量 \(8\pi^2(2k+2)\)，旧 toric rod 模型恰好逐 rod 饱和，故纯能量计数无法阻止塌缩 [Step 58]。另一方面 \(\sup|W|^2\ge\int|W|^2/\operatorname{Vol}\to\infty\)，而 bounded-curvature collapse 会产生 F-structure 迫使 \(\chi=0\)，与 \(\chi>0\) 矛盾；故紧 pinching 下的塌缩必须伴随曲率爆发与 bubbling，自然候选 bubble 模型是 ALF 而非纯 ALE（未证；Step 60 只算了标量 ALF 质量 proxy：\(\mathbb R^3\) base 上根为 \(\ell\) 与 \(-\ell-1\)，mass pair \((0,-1)\)，并注明需要 Taub–NUT/Euclidean Schwarzschild 上的张量化 Lichnerowicz 分析）[Step 60]。任何塌缩障碍必须来自低维极限、过渡区、非极大 nilpotent 拓扑或全局闭合处的被迫能量缺陷，而非 Chern–Weil 预算缺失 [Steps 58–60]。已形式化的局部 Lean 文件仍为 `Step27H3Algebra.lean`、`Step28BochnerKilling.lean`、`Step29TwistSpikeAlgebra.lean`，只覆盖代数核 [Steps 27–29]。

## 正塌缩 toric 前线的 Schwarzschild/Weyl 实验与降级 [Steps 34–42]

Step 34 在 toric \(\alpha\)-family 中识别局部 bolt 尺度：每条 rod 近似二维球面，\(K_\Sigma=1+2A\)、横向 collar width \(\sim A^{-1/2}\)、形式能量约 \(8\pi^2\) 每 rod；按 \(\sqrt{2A}\) rescale 后 Kottler 质量趋于 \(1/2\)，局部趋向 Euclidean Schwarzschild [Step 34]。Step 35 纠正"孤立 Schwarzschild bubble"：rescaled rod spacing 保持有限，极限应是 infinite/periodic toric Ricci-flat rod chain，类似 generalized Weyl/Israel–Khan [Step 35]。Step 36 正确指出 Atiyah–LeBrun edge-cone defect 是 singular limit 的独立项；但随后错误地由 alternating labels 的相邻 basis 性推出无 strut，Step 37 根据用户纠正撤回：strut/conical deficit 是同一 collapsing circle 在不同 rods 上全局 period/surface-gravity 不一致，标签 \(v\) 与 \(-v\) 生成同一 subgroup，alternating pattern 有大量非相邻 same-circle period conditions [Steps 36–37]。非紧 Weyl line-source probes 发现的 period mismatch 被识别为精确乘积 \(\prod(2k+1)/(2k)\)，是 finite-chain end effect [Steps 37–38]；Step 39 用 Page、CLW 和 toric Kähler–Einstein 例校准后撤回"noncompact mismatch 推出 compact obstruction"：这些 compact 例有 repeated circle classes 且 periods 完全匹配 [Steps 39–41]。

Step 40 借 Liu 结构事实重构 diagonal sector：固定 lattice basis 的 diagonal fiber metric 沿 rod 消失只允许 \(v=\pm e_1,\pm e_2\)；Liu 的 exact Einstein \(T^2\)-manifold 结果覆盖 alternating two-unoriented-circle sector；Page/CLW/dP3 属 non-diagonal sector [Steps 40–41]。子问题变为是否存在 \(m\ge6\) 的 diagonal \(T^2\)-invariant positive Einstein metric。Step 40 的"三约束对一函数"与 product-rigidity 线性化不是证明；Step 41 重算发现原线性化方程错误，constant-curvature regular polygon FEM 的"68.7% hexagon gap"修正为约 \(1.84\%\) 的 restricted-model near miss（\(\mu_6\approx6.973\)、\(A_{\rm eig}\approx0.2868\)、\(A_{\rm side}\approx0.2710\)），不足以排除 variable curvature [Steps 40–41]。该路线在 Steps 41–42 降为 symmetry-restricted laboratory；有用遗产是 rod/corner、period transport 和 variable-curvature compatibility map，而不是 compact obstruction theorem。Step 58 的 Chern–Weil 饱和分析进一步说明这类 rod  bookkeeping 不可能单独成为塌缩障碍 [Step 58]。

## 四维正非塌缩 Route A：从 EH obstruction 到一般 ADE 表示论 [Steps 30–47, 62]

若四维正 pinching 序列非塌缩且 GH 极限没有 codimension-4 奇点，Cheeger–Naber 的 \(C^{1,\alpha}\cap W^{2,q}\) 收敛、弱 Ricci 方程和 elliptic regularity 可给 smooth exact Einstein 极限，并通过 diffeomorphism recovery 放回原流形 [Step 30]；真正剩余的是 bubbling。Ozuch 的 Einstein degeneration 文献确认 Eguchi–Hanson 第一障碍来自 Taub/Pohozaev/Wronskian 守恒量：orbifold 展开 \(g_o=e+H_2+O(r^3)\) 与 ALE 展开 \(g_b=e+H^4+O(r^{-5})\) 的边界配对在 exact degeneration 中必须消失，向量条件为
\[
R_\pm(p)\zeta^\pm=0,\qquad R_\pm=W_\pm+\frac{\Lambda}{3}\operatorname{Id},
\]
不能仅写 \(\det R_\pm=0\) [Steps 30–31, 43]。Step 31 谱脚本校准圆 \(S^4\) 有 \(\det R_+\ne0\)，Kähler–Einstein 例在 Kähler chirality 上有 kernel。

研究把 obstruction transfer 重写为平衡 annulus/mode projection：orbifold \(l=2\) 模式 \(H_2\sim r^2\)，尺度 \(t\) 的 ALE 模式 \(t^4H^4\sim t^4r^{-4}\)，Wronskian signal 为 \(t^4\) [Steps 32–34]。flat cone \(\mathbb R^4/\{\pm1\}\) 上 Bianchi/TT probe 给齐次 rates \(l\) 与 \(-l-2\)；parity 排除 \(l=1\)，首个非 gauge even regular mode 是 \(l=2\)，对偶 decaying mode \(-4\) 正对应 EH coefficient；Wronskian mode-diagonal [Steps 33–34]。

Step 43 chirality 分析修正了"KE 使第一障碍失效"的过强结论：正 Kähler–Einstein 四流形在 complex orientation 上 \(R_+=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0)\)，Kähler form 只 pin 住 self-dual block，reversed EH 测试未受约束的 \(R_-\)；compactly supported intersection rank 才是正确拓扑输入 [Step 43]。Step 46 用脚本 `step46_gamma_invariant_l2_modes.py` 对 spin-2 representation 限制到 ADE rotation groups 作 character 计算：A、D 型保留非零 invariant \(l=2\) modes；E 型相关 self-dual spin-2 invariant 空间为空 [Step 46]。Step 47 补出另一半：orbifold 固定点曲率块本身也是 \(\Gamma\)-不变的，脚本 `step47_curvature_invariant_degeneracy.py` 解出 invariant linear equations——A\(_1\) 是相关 block 完全不受约束的主要类型；A\(_k\)（\(k\ge2\)）和 D 型把 \(\det R=0\) 压缩为显式标量方程；E 型相关 block 上 \(W=0\)，正 \(\Lambda\) 时 \(R=(\Lambda/3)I\) 不可退化 [Step 47]。这撤销了 Step 46 的 E 型 exceptional-locus 表述，并删除"Kähler generic"语言：紧致性序列给定的是固定 orbifold、固定奇点和固定 bubble direction，正确结论是有限维 dichotomy [Steps 46–47]。Step 62 的 `step62_ade_invariant_reachability.py` 把这套不变量整理为 reachability ledger：A1 全 5 维自由、A3 三维、多数 A\(_k\)/D\(_k\) 一维、D4 二维、E 型在 nontrivial block 上为零；但 determinant 方程只表达 kernel 存在的可能，真正障碍仍是向量、chirality-specific，且依赖未证的 H_flux [Step 62]。

## H4 dual：从归一化 Jacobi 通量到共振修正、指数逃逸渠道与锐利条件二分 [Steps 47–50, 59–63]

这条线经历多次重构，是本弧唯一的证明侧资产。Step 47 把 H4 从 pointwise radial ODE 改为 dual TT pairing [Step 47]；用户随后指出 compactly supported 测试场只给近乎恒等的两-mode 关系，正确测试场是 bubble 上光滑于核心、无穷远衰减的 obstruction Jacobi field \(o_k\)，只在外端 cutoff，外端 flux 读取 ambient 二次系数与 \(\zeta\) 的配对 [Step 48]。Step 49 纠正归一化：未归一化边界泛函因 \(h_i\to0\) 平凡趋零，signal 与 ambient quadratic perturbation 同为 \(t=\epsilon^2\) 阶，必须研究 \(\mathcal B_k(R,i)/t_i\)；真正缺口是 quantitative two-scale matching——从 Cheeger–Naber 仅有的 \(h_i=o(1)\) 推出 \(t_i^{-1}h_i\to H_2\) 并识别归一化 Wronskian 为 \(c\langle R_\pm(p)\zeta,\zeta_{(k)}\rangle\) [Step 49]。

Step 59 把缺口分析到具体：ALE 坐标中 \(f_i=h_i/t_i\) 满足 \(P_{eh}f_i=\Lambda eh+O(\delta_i+t_i|f_i|^2)\)，Arzelà–Ascoli 给子列极限，obstruction 系数由大 \(\rho\) 行为 \(f\sim H_2+O(\rho^{-2})\) 决定；脚本 `step59_h4dual_indicial_and_matching.py` 验证 EH 上 \((2,-4)\) indicial pair 与 R-无关 Wronskian \(-6\pi^2\)，并量化朴素逐尺度椭圆 bootstrap 的失败：\(k\sim|\log t|/2\) 个 doubling scales 上常数积累 \(C^k\sim t^{-c/2}\)（\(t=10^{-8}\) 时超目标 \(2.56\times10^8\) 倍）；exact-Einstein 的 weighted Fredholm 在 pinched 情形遇到随 \(t^2\rho^2\) 增长的 cosmological source，不可控 [Step 59]。

Step 60 是关键修正。Strategist 指出 Step 59 的权重取错：点态 Ricci defect 权重恰为 0，匹配权重被迫取共振端点 \(\beta=2\)；\(\beta<2\) 的估计 \(\delta_it_i^{\beta/2}\) 严格劣于目标 \(t_i\)。共振只产生一个对数，可用 flux 直接计算：常值投影源的精确特解
\[
f_p=\tfrac{S}{6}r^2\log(r/r_0)-\tfrac{S}{36}(r^2-r_0^6r^{-4})
\]
使 \(H_2\) 系数从 \(O(1)\) 到 \(R\sim t_i^{-1/2}\) 漂移 \(O(t_i\delta_i\log(1/t_i))\)，相对 \(O(t_i)\) signal 误差为 \(O(\delta_i\log(1/t_i))\)。这恢复了 Step 34 的 \(\delta\log(1/t)\) 条件：Steps 35–36/42 用固定 bubble frame 加迭代极限"去掉"该条件的论证是循环的（预设了待证的跨颈 \(O(t_i)\) 速率），必须撤回 [Steps 34–36, 60]。机制上，\(\operatorname{div}W\) 是 Cotton 张量、由 \(\nabla\operatorname{Ric}\) 控制，而 \(C^0\) 夹逼完全不碰 \(\nabla\operatorname{Ric}\)——正是 Step-11 spike 利用的通道；在 \(\sim1/\delta\) 个 dyadic scales 上 neck 可使 \(R_\pm(r)\) 漂移 \(O(1)\)，且几乎不耗 Chern–Weil 能量。失败渠道被命名为指数颈尺度 \(t_i\lesssim\exp(-c/\delta_i)\) [Step 60]。Step 60 用精确符号 Ricci 检验器（`step60_verify_warped_ricci_symbolic.py`：双 warping 度量满足 \(\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm base}=-2du\otimes du\)、纤维分量 \(\pm\Delta_Bu\)）和修复后的收缩外半径调度（\(\eta_i^2\asymp\delta_i\)、\(t_i=\delta_ie^{-2a/\delta_i}\)，`step60_full_warped_neck_ricci.py`）证明该渠道不是标量 ODE 假象：完整局部 Ricci defect 保持 \(O(t_i\delta_i)\) 而 \(l=2\) 系数改变 \(O(t_i)\)。TTCS 核实共振与尺度，但要求补上完整张量 flux 恒等式、gauge、ambient tower subtraction、内端 EH-flux 归一化与外端曲率识别，才可称几何定理 [Step 60]。

Step 61 按 Strategist 建议把模型搬上正确几何（flat cone \(\mathbb R^4/\mathbb Z_2\) 的 toric 形式），符号验证了 \(v=0\) 时平坦、base Ricci 只含一阶导数、唯一 \(T^2\)-不变二次调和函数 \(r_1^2-r_2^2\)，并计算线性化 Weyl 特征值 \(8\varepsilon A/3\)（二重）与 \(-16\varepsilon A/3\)（期间发现并修复 Scal/6 vs Scal/12 公式 bug）[Step 61]。但 Step 62 的 Preceptor 审计用模型自己的两个数字将其否决：(1) 该 warped mode 的线性化 Ricci 是 traceful rank-2（标量 \(-8\varepsilon A\)），达到 Weyl 退化的振幅 \(\varepsilon A=\Lambda/16\) 会引入 \(O(\Lambda)\) 的 Ricci 缺陷，不是 Ricci-neutral 方向；(2) 轴光滑性要求 \(v(0,r_2)=v(r_1,0)=0\)，而唯一 \(T^2\)-不变二次调和函数在两轴上非零，产生 \(O(1)\) 锥角亏缺，ansatz 内不可修复（角向截断需 \(\theta_0\gg\delta^{-1/2}\)）；能量段落亦自相矛盾 [Step 62]。记录于 `step62_step61_model_audit.py/.json` 与 `workspace/notes/step62_preceptor_correction_rate_limited_flux_and_model_replacement.md`。

Step 62 同时给出更简单的替代框架并保留了机制：法坐标下 Einstein-compatible 二次曲率 jet 的仿射空间
\[
\mathcal E^{\rm NC}_\Lambda=\{H_R:\operatorname{Ric}(R)=\Lambda e\},\qquad H_{R,ij}=-\tfrac13R_{ikjl}x^kx^l,
\]
其切空间正是改变 Weyl 的 jet，维数经符号审计确认为 20 维代数曲率张量、Ricci 秩 10、固定 Ricci 切空间为 10 维 Weyl 空间 \(\operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\Lambda^+)\oplus\operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\Lambda^-)\)。沿 \(\mathcal E\) 中路径取 \(g=e+H(A(\log r))\)，缺陷为 \(O(A')+O(A'')=O(\delta)\)，二次 jet 光滑且自动 \(\mathbb Z_2\)-偶，无轴条件，全 10 维 Weyl 空间可用 [Step 62]。TTCS 限定其范围：这是法坐标规范下的局部代数/2-jet 自由，还不是构造出的径向 neck；缺的是沿路径变化的 jet-neck 的 Ricci 展开 [Step 62]。Step 63 补上了这个计算：`step63_jet_drift_ricci.py`、`step63_jet_drift_full.py` 符号验证 \(\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm lin}(H_E)|_0=\Lambda\delta\)（jet 空间 Einstein-compatible）、\(\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm lin}(W)|_0=0\)（Weyl 方向在核中）、所有 drift 项在 \(x=0\) 消失（\(W\) 二次、\(dW\) 线性），外缘处缺陷 \(O(A')+O(A'')=O(\delta)\)；`step63_two_point_reachability.py` 显示退化集为余维 1（账上记为三个超平面的并），任意外端 Weyl 值都可由有界路径连接到退化构型——两点可达性是普遍的 [Step 63]。

由此 H4 线的当前准确状态是一个锐利的条件二分：若弱 TT/Wronskian 通量引理 H_flux（含相容 Bianchi/TT 环带 gauge、ambient \(H_2/H_4\) tower 在 signal 阶的减除、非线性/gauge/坏集/截断误差控制、内外 ALE flux 识别）成立，则有效 ADE 泡满足
\[
\bigl\|\Pi_\Gamma\bigl(R_\pm(p)\zeta\bigr)\bigr\|\le C\delta_i\log(1/t_i)+o(1),
\]
故在速率区 \(\delta_i\log(1/t_i)\to0\) 下第一向量障碍必消失；持续性障碍则迫使 \(t_i\le\exp(-c/\delta_i)\)，而 Step 63 证明这个指数渠道在 2-jet 层面真实存在，速率是 sharp 的而非证明技术的弱点 [Steps 60–63]。这不能升级为无条件定理，也不构成反例：全局实现需要在指数颈上解几何匹配问题、保证各奇异处光滑、并确定底层光滑流形的 Einstein 状态（smooth-category fidelity）[Steps 63–64]。Step 64 决定给 H_flux 最后一次聚焦攻击（TT gauge + tower subtraction + signal 阶 flux 归一化），此后归档为 standing hypothesis [Step 64]。

## Bi-Kähler product quotient：双号混合 wall 的完成、Kähler 排除定理与光滑型识别 [Steps 44–51, 53–58, 62–64]

正镜像模型为 \((S^2\times S^2)/\langle\sigma\rangle\)（\(\sigma\) 为两因子 \(\pi\)-rotation），四个 \(-I_4\) 型 \(A_1\) 奇点，乘积 Einstein 度量下降，且 \(S^2\times S^2\) 对两种取向都是 Kähler，故
\[
R_+=R_-=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0)
\]
[Step 44]。Step 45 修复能量账：quotient 的 Satake Euler 为 2，每个 EH 泡量子为 \(12\pi^2\)，总量 \(64\pi^2=8\pi^2\chi\)，只是 CGB 一致性 [Step 45]。若 \(r\) 个泡 reversed，有理不变量 \(\chi=8\)、\((b_+,b_-)=(1+r,5-r)\)。Steps 48–50 建立关键构造认识：每个 \(R_\pm\) 的二维 kernel 允许任意 chirality assignment 杀掉一阶障碍；二阶 Ozuch 障碍即使非零，升指标后仍趋零，对本题 operator norm 非负载，故无需完成 exact Einstein gluing 便可沿 Biquard/Ozuch refined approximate metric 直接估计 Ricci-endomorphism defect——杀第一障碍后核心 \(O(t)\)、过渡区 \(O(t^{1/2})\)，reversed EH 与普通 EH 等距同尺度、仅 attaching orientation 与测试块改变 [Steps 48–50]。Step 50 整理为单向 hardness reduction \(P_4^+\Rightarrow M_r\) 承载 Einstein 度量（\(r=1,2,3\)），混合行是简单连通、PSC、\(b_+\ge2\)、严格 HT 的四流形，已知存在与非存在定理都够不到 [Steps 50–51]。

负侧经 Steps 53–54 的 crepant 墙分析和用户纠正后，Step 55 完成转向。Step 54 的显式 nodal quintic（`step54_negative_wall_audit.py` 验证唯一 \(A_1\) 奇点、\(K=\mathcal O_X(1)\)、\(K^2=5\)）被裁定为 smooth-category 无害：ADE 曲面奇点的 Milnor fiber 与 minimal resolution 微分同胚（A1 两者都是 \(T^*S^2\)），Brieskorn 同时解消加 Ehresmann 使其全局化；在 ample-canonical 族中平滑后 Aubin–Yau 给负 KE。这固化了目标忠诚原则：某个复结构上 \(K\) nef-big-not-ample、无 KE，不等于底层光滑流形无 Einstein——Yau26 的输出量词允许换复结构 [Steps 54–55]。真正非全纯的构造是 reversed 泡；Step 55 引入负双 Kähler 模型
\[
(\Sigma_2\times\Sigma_2)/\langle\iota\times\iota\rangle
\]
（两因子曲率 \(-1\)，\(\iota\) 为超椭圆对合），\(6\cdot6=36\) 个 \(-I_4\) 型 \(A_1\) 点，\(R_+=R_-=\operatorname{diag}(-1,0,0)\)，每个节点两种 chirality 都可取二维 kernel 中的 \(\zeta\) 杀向量障碍。脚本 `step55_negative_bikahler_mixed_wall.py` 算出 sign-pattern resolution 账本：\(\chi=56\)、\(b_1=0\)、\(b_2=54\)、全 compatible 行 \(K^2=4\)、\(\tau=-36+2r\)、\((b_+,b_-)=(9+r,45-r)\)，所有行严格 HT [Step 55]。Step 56 补入取向反转对称（复共轭 \(c\times\mathrm{id}\) 下降，\(r\leftrightarrow36-r\)）与 Noether 奇偶（奇 \(r\) 行两种取向都无复结构），并确认全 compatible 行是 \(\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1\) 沿光滑 \((6,6)\) 曲线（genus 25）的双覆盖，\(K=\pi^*\mathcal O(1,1)\) ample，Aubin–Yau 给负 KE；端点 \(r=0,36\) 都是已知 Einstein 控制行 [Steps 55–56]。脚本为 `step56_negative_bikahler_audit.py`。

Step 57 把这条线收成为统一定理包（`workspace/notes/step57_dichotomy_and_kahler_exclusion.md` 与两个脚本/JSON）：

1. **Kähler 排除定理**：对 \(1\le r\le35\)，混合行含非挠 \(+2\)-球面且 \(b_+>1\)；若承载 Kähler/辛结构，Taubes 给非零 SW，而 adjunction 加把手论证（球面加环柄成 genus-1 代表，\(|\langle c,[S]\rangle|+[S]^2\le0\)）与 \([S]^2=2\) 矛盾。反向取向同理。故没有任何混合行在任一取向是 Kähler/辛的；这对正镜像 \(r=1,2,3\) 逐字成立，严格强于 Noether 奇偶，并彻底关闭"偶数行也许可由 Aubin–Yau 解决"的可能 [Step 57]。
2. **van Kampen 证明 \(\pi_1=1\)**：\(M_0\) 由 Catanese 循环覆盖命题简单连通；\(\pm2\) disk bundle 都简单连通且都杀掉边界 \(\mathbb{RP}^3\) 的 \(\mathbb Z/2\) 像；故所有 sign-pattern filling \(\pi_1=1\)，simplicial volume 为零，Gromov-norm/Sambusetti/BCG 障碍对该族全部 vacuous [Steps 56–57]。
3. **Bauer–Furuta 范围核查**：所有已知非零 monopole/BF 输入都经 Kähler/辛被加项；混合行非 Kähler 且不沿 \(+2\)-球面分裂（边界 \(\mathbb{RP}^3\) 非 \(S^3\)）。这是"无已知机制可达"的状态陈述，不是 vanishing 定理 [Steps 56–57]。

Step 57 还核算高亏格推广 \((\Sigma_h\times\Sigma_h)/\langle\iota\times\iota\rangle\)：\(N=4(h+1)^2\) 节点、\(\chi=8(h^2+h+1)\)、\(\tau=-4(h+1)^2+2r\)，两个 HT margin 为 \(4(h-1)^2+6r\) 与 \(4(h-1)^2+6(N-r)\)，所有 \(h\ge2\) 与所有 \(r\) 严格为正；扩大族不产生拓扑矛盾 [Step 57]。Steps 58–59 补入"Einstein 端点之间的 wall"原则：\(\chi\) 跨族不变、端点 margin 最小且端点已知 Einstein，故任何单调依赖 \((\chi,\tau,\|M\|,\deg)\) 的 Einstein 障碍都不可能排除内部行；这也解释了为什么换商群引入非平凡 \(\pi_1\) 不能辨别混合行 [Steps 58–59]。组织性结论：compatible ALE 泡是全纯的、保持 \(K^2\)、落在 Aubin–Yau/del Pezzo 已供度量的区域；任何 reversed 泡要求对侧手性块逐点退化并插入 \(+2\)-球面，同时湮灭存在机器（Kähler）与非存在机器（monopole）的输入——四维非塌缩 Yau26 至少与"在单连通、\(b_+\ge2\)、无 monopole 类的流形上判定 Einstein 存在性"同等困难；端点关联（保 monopole 的恰是已知 Einstein 的两行）是结构性的，对双号镜像逐字成立 [Step 57]。

Step 58 通过用户提供的链接直接取回 Biquard 原文（arXiv:1105.4904，存档于 `workspace/data/source_text/`），修正引用：所需局部估计是第 4 节 Lemmas 4.1–4.2 而非第 14 节（后者是横截性）。Lemma 4.2 给
\[
\bigl|\nabla^k\bigl(\operatorname{Ric}_{g_t}-\Lambda g_t-t\textstyle\sum\lambda_j\chi_to_j\bigr)\bigr|_{\rm eh}\le C_kt^2\rho^{2-k},
\]
升到 \(g_t\sim t\,g_{\rm EH}\) 的 operator norm 后，杀第一障碍则核心 \(O(t)\)、过渡最坏 \(O(t^{1/2})\)，未杀的第一障碍保持阶一。这把混合泡 near-pinching 构造的局部/raw 残差估计锚定到原始来源；`step58_biquard_ct_collapse_ledger.py` 同时在双号镜像的最小 genuinely-mixed 图案上核实 \(\zeta=(0,1,0)\) 杀任一侧向量障碍而 \(\zeta=(1,0,0)\) 不杀，保持条件的向量性 [Step 58]。仍需注意的诚实边界：完整 unprojected defect 的逐区核算、compact orbifold 转移、多泡小特征值相互作用属于更强陈述；对产生 near-pinched 输入度量而言不需要全局逆或横截性（那些属于 exact gluing）[Steps 58–59]。

Step 64 完成了这条弧缺失的最后一块记录——**正镜像混合行的光滑型识别**（`step64_positive_mirror_homeomorphism.py`、`workspace/notes/step64_positive_mirror_homeomorphism_and_allocation.md`）：\(\mathbb{RP}^3\) 恰有两个 spin 结构（Rokhlin \(\mu=\pm1\)），所有保向微分同胚保持之（Hatcher：\(\pi_0\operatorname{Diff}(\mathbb{RP}^3)=\mathbb Z/2\) 由反向等距生成）；\(\mathcal O(\pm2)\) disk bundle 皆 spin 且在边界诱导 \(\mu=\pm1\)；补体 \(X^*\) spin 且 \(\sigma(X^*)=0\)，Rokhlin 迫使接缝 \(\mu\)-pattern 为 \(\{+1,+1,-1,-1\}\)，故 spin 填充当且仅当两个 reversed 块恰好落在两个 \(\mu=-1\) 接缝上。六种平衡子集选择两种都出现，因此平衡行 \(r=2\) 同时实现 spin 型与 non-spin 型。Freedman 分类命名全部行：
\[
r=0:\ \mathbb{CP}^2\#5\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2\ (\text{degree-4 del Pezzo，正 KE，一致性锚}),
\]
\[
r=1:\ \#2\mathbb{CP}^2\#4\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2,\qquad
r=2:\ \#_3(S^2\times S^2)\ (\text{spin})\ \text{或}\ \#3\mathbb{CP}^2\#3\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2\ (\text{non-spin}),\qquad
r=3:\ \#4\mathbb{CP}^2\#2\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2,
\]
\(r=4\) 为 \(r=0\) 的反向。这修正了 Strategist 不加限定的"平衡行同胚于 \(\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\)"，且修正反而加强方案：non-spin 平衡行无条件可实现 [Step 64]。所有混合行单连通、PSC、严格 HT、普通 SW 为零、两种取向非 Kähler；Kotschick 文献（lines 131–156）确认单连通四流形上经典 Einstein 障碍只有 HT、所有精细化都靠 monopole 输入，故这些流形的 Einstein 状态真正开放。**两个正弧就此汇合**：spin 平衡行同胚于 Step-9 塌缩 stress family 的 \(k=3\) 成员 \(\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\)——非塌缩 wall（显式 near-pinched 度量）与塌缩 dichotomy 共用一个具名同胚型（微分同胚型开放，SW 不能判定）[Step 64]。

Step 64 的路由裁定基于反驳的两半结构：(i) 任意 pinched 度量的构造——已在现有工具极限内完成；(ii) 底层流形的 Einstein 非存在——整个开放问题。Step 63 的 sharpness 结果表明障碍框架在速率区内强制第一障碍消失、速率区外失明，两种情形都不能判定 (ii)；因此全局 drift-neck 实现只投资于已解决的一半，被撤资（同时回答了 A03 #450：jet-drift 渠道受其自身锐化的必要性定理约束，单独不能产生反例）。决策点定为 χ=8 平衡行的 Einstein 状态，决定性实验是从显式 near-pinched 胶合度量出发的非微扰 Einstein–DeTurck/变分搜索（高阶障碍已排除邻近精确解，故任何 Einstein 度量必为远度量，而流对远近无差别）：收敛给出 SW-void 非 Kähler 单连通流形上的新正 Einstein 存在机器并验证 \(P_4^+\) 的必要推论；具名机制的稳健发散结合 near-pinched 构造则构成 \(P_4^+\) 的反驳候选。失败判据已在 `workspace/plans/step64_route_allocation.md` 预登记 [Step 64]。

## 负 cutoff-flow 链的独立审计、m=1 collar adjudication 与当前接口状态 [Steps 51–54, 58–63]

Step 51 核验归一化 cutoff 流 \(\partial_tg=-2a(\operatorname{Ric}+g)\) 的 \(L^p\) 反应项系数为 \(2p-n\)（临界 \(p=n/2\) 消失），并指出 cutoff Hessian source 应分部积分、用 \(|\nabla a|^2/a=4|\nabla\chi|^2\) 吸收一阶项 [Step 51]。Step 52 发现两个更基本问题：flat \(T^4\) 上 \(\chi=(1+\cos x_1)/2\) 从零曲率产生 \(\int|\mathrm{Rm}|^2=48\pi^4t^2+O(t^3)\)（\(E'/E\sim2/t\)），击破未平移的 homogeneous closure；以及 DeTurck pullback 满足 \(\phi^*(a\hat g)=(a\circ\phi)\phi^*\hat g\)，普通 DeTurck trick 得到的是 transported-cutoff flow 而非原 fixed-cutoff flow [Step 52]。Steps 53–54 限定：flat-\(T^4\) 只反驳 unshifted 方案，shifted \(T=\mathrm{Rm}+G\) 正是为吸收此类源项而设计；Step 52–53 的"\(A^{-1/2}\) scaling 不可能性"强说法在 Step 54 撤回（eligible cores 体积可与 \(A\) 同阶，局部上界反推乘积下界不合法）[Steps 52–54]。

Steps 62–63 按"裁决而非加入施工"的原则完成两项独立裁定。其一，IL m=1 base 问题：star-notation 中 \(\int\chi|C_2||U_1|^p\) 的带符号原形 \(\int\chi\,\nabla_i\nabla_j\chi\,B^{ij}(U_1)\) 经一次分部积分即可闭合，只需 \(\|\nabla\chi\|_\infty\) 而无需 \(\|\nabla^2\chi\|\)；flat-\(T^4\) 门槛不杀加权 m=1 估计——因为 \(T=\mathrm{Rm}+G\) 中 \(G\neq0\)，\(\|T\|^2\) 有正下界，加权能量与指数界相容。故 m=1 collar 不是失败点；真正的活缺口是 defect Moser 端点（A01 #441：一般 \(p\) 双因子不等式与嵌套递推未证，阻塞 bootstrap 的 V-leg）。脚本 `step63_m1_collar_adjudication.py` [Steps 62–63]。其二（对 A01/A03 全部架构的 Step-62 分诊）：高阶 continuation 的 DeTurck pullback 代数、uniqueness-free 时间 jet 拼接、归纳账修复（提取 \(B_{m+2}U_0\) 等顶阶项）、固定背景转换的严格三角结构、终端 Liouville-pullback 选择（正确消去 \(\int\Phi\le C\delta^2A\) 与 \(\operatorname{Vol}(P)\ge c_0A\) 中的拓扑尺度 \(A\)）与 Derdziński forbidden-germ 算术均内部一致；但 base collar 包、低阶 first-exit/Moser、精确编号演化/重排引理、退化 DeTurck 存在接口、终端校准与文献来源、统一 geography 常数仍是负载接口。A01 #433 已自行下调"7/8 模块已建立"的说法 [Step 62]。

即使该受限定理完成，其范围也只是指定 IL 无 Einstein 流形附近 \(\operatorname{Ric}=-g\) 的族级间隙：不构造反例度量、不给维数常数、不触及正分支、一般四维拓扑、\(n\ge5\) 或 Lean 形式化 [Step 62]。A02 在负侧保留的有界补位是 \(p=1/3\) sharpness 实验（见 LeBrun 节）；Steps 3–4 的固定 \(p>1/3\) 稳定积分 gap 仍是更可靠的已证负结果 [Steps 52–54, 64]。

## 高维 codimension-four stratum probe 与 n≥5 状态 [Steps 22–24, 46, 53–58]

Step 46 曾提出把四维孤立 ALE 泡的 mode/Wronskian 推广到 \(n\ge5\) 的 codimension-four singular stratum；Step 53 的有界 probe 否定了 naive integral cancellation：本题逐点 operator norm 下，stratum 上任一点第一障碍系数非零即出现 \(O(1)\) 缺陷，沿 stratum 积分相消不能补救。正确对象应是沿 stratum 的 obstruction bundle：法向曲率块 \(R_{\mathrm{normal},\pm}(y)\) 作用于 bubble 参数截面 \(\zeta(y)\)，含法向联络与切向导数项；warped-product 计算显示 \(\zeta\) 的 \(O(1)\) 切向变化会产生不可忽略曲率，需平行或足够慢变 [Step 53]。Cheeger–Naber stratification/slicing 提供背景但不给 ALE bundle theorem、参数正则性或塌缩情形；四维孤立 H4-dual 本身未闭合，故 Step 54 起该方向保留为有限结论 [Steps 53–54]。

\(n\ge5\) 方面，Steps 22–24 已从 Wang 综述记录：没有已知的闭流形在维数 \(\ge5\) 被证明不承载任何符号的 Einstein 度量；Step 58 裁定不必重跑该检索——任何 \(n\ge5\) 的反驳都首先需要产生一个高维非 Einstein 闭流形（本身是公认开放问题），故反驳工作理性集中于四维，高维须从证明侧或新障碍侧进入 [Steps 22–24, 58]。Step 24 的 Kaluza–Klein 精确正 Einstein collapse（见上）同时说明高维塌缩与四维机制本质不同 [Step 24]。

### Research Line

- The project began by fixing the logical burden of Yau–26 and testing whether known stability, prescribed-curvature, or obstruction theorems already decided a sign branch. Min-Oo showed how negative almost-Einstein sequences escape restricted stability, while ALE gluing exposed the difference between weighted residual control and pointwise Ricci-endomorphism control. The question shifted from "does an existing theorem solve the problem?" to "which degeneration lets a tightly Ricci-isotropic metric evade Einstein existence?" [Steps 1–3].

- Four-dimensional gauge theory was the first sustained obstruction line. The Step-2 arithmetic error and user correction forced a reconstruction of LeBrun; the broad obstruction failed but yielded the stable-integral principle and isolated the zero-margin regime \(p=1/3\). Because that regime covers one sign and one dimension, A02 moved away from it as the central all-dimensional route [Steps 2–4].

- Chern–Gauss–Bonnet became the shared accounting language across positive collapse, negative obstruction, and bubbling, repeatedly failing as a standalone contradiction because fixed energy concentrates on shrinking features [Steps 4, 8, 14–18, 34–37, 45].

- Positive pinching gained priority from Myers/Bishop dimension-only ceilings. That priority never became a no-collapse thesis: exact Einstein collapse examples changed the program from excluding collapse to distinguishing Einstein-compatible from obstructed collapse. Noncollapsed compactness hopes were corrected through Cheeger–Naber; Step 11's spike killed pointwise curvature control and redirected everything toward weak methods [Steps 5–12, 30–31, 43].

- The toric and nilpotent programs explored collapse directly, shedding false assumptions one by one; the alternating toric family showed tested local and integral constraints all permit collapse, moving the obstruction to global closure; the \(H_3\)/Bochner line isolated the missing almost-Killing production theorem. Positive collapse was then left dormant for roughly thirty steps, with its missing bridge explicitly recorded [Steps 12–30, 34–41].

- The noncollapsed bubbling line grew from Ozuch's Pohozaev identities into the H4-dual architecture: balanced annuli, mode-sensitive Wronskians, the discarded second-order-jet formulation, the whole-bubble Jacobi-field test, the normalization correction, and the ADE representation-theoretic scope with the \(E\)-type withdrawal [Steps 30–49].

- The bi-Kähler product quotient transformed first obstruction from a loophole into a construction laboratory: both chiral blocks degenerate, reversed bubbles satisfy the same local estimate, and killing the first obstruction suffices for operator-norm pinching. The positive mixed rows became a hardness reduction tying \(P_4^+\) to the open \(b_+\ge2\) positive-Einstein problem [Steps 44–51].

- A02 then cross-audited the A01/A03 negative cutoff-flow program, found the normalization-sign error, the unsafe Hessian bounds, the DeTurck transport issue, and the flat-\(T^4\) curvature-creation witness, and withdrew its own \(A^{-1/2}\) impossibility claim after A03's correction — leaving the chain conditional [Steps 51–54].

- The first-obstruction machinery was redirected to the negative side, where genuine Einstein nonexistence theorems exist. The first picture was a crepant/noncrepant mismatch: admissible Ricci-flat ALE bubbles preserve \(c_1^2\), while LeBrun deficits come from non-Ricci-flat Burns cores inadmissible under tight pinching. with both factors hyperbolic of curvature \(-1\) has \(6\cdot6=36\) isolated fixed points, local action \(-I_4\), hence 36 \(A_1\) singularities, and product Einstein curvature \(R_+=R_-=\operatorname{diag}(-1,0,0)\) at every point: the vector first obstruction can be killed for **either** EH chirality by choosing \(\zeta\) in the two-dimensional kernel (verified: \(\zeta=(0,1,0)\) kills, \((1,0,0)\) does not). Finite ledger: quotient Euler \((4+36)/2=20\), resolution \(\chi=56\); \(b_1=0\) rationally (hyperelliptic acts as \(-1\) on \(H^1\)), \(b_2=54\); all-compatible \(K^2=4\), \(\tau=-36\); with \(r\) reversed nodes,
\[
\chi=56,\qquad \tau=-36+2r,\qquad (b_+,b_-)=(9+r,\,45-r),
\]
with strict Hitchin–Thorpe for every \(0\le r\le36\) (margins \(4+6r\) and \(4+6(36-r)\)). [Steps 55–56, 58]

**Orientation symmetry and endpoints (Step 56).** Complex conjugation on one real genus-2 factor descends to an orientation-reversing orbifold diffeomorphism, pairing node patterns \(r\leftrightarrow36-r\) (smooth type may depend on the subset, not only \(r\)). The all-compatible row \(r=0\) is a double cover of \(\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1\) branched over a smoothed \((6,6)\) curve (branch genus 25, \(\chi=56\), \(K=\pi^*\mathcal O(1,1)\) ample, \(K^2=4\)), hence carries a negative Kähler–Einstein metric by Aubin–Yau; \(r=36\) is its orientation reverse, also Einstein as an unoriented manifold. Live representatives: \(r=1,\ldots,18\). Reversed bubbling is not intrinsically Einstein-hostile. [Steps 55–56]

**\(\pi_1=1\) and Gromov-norm closure (Steps 56–57).** Van Kampen proof completed: \(M_0\) is simply connected (smooth flexible-branch double cover, Catanese-type criterion); both \(\pm2\) disk bundles over \(S^2\) are simply connected with boundary \(\mathbb{RP}^3\), and each filling kills the same boundary \(\mathbb Z/2\) image; hence **all sign-pattern fillings are simply connected**. Consequently simplicial volume vanishes (amenable \(\pi_1\) sources) and Gromov-norm/Sambusetti/BCG obstructions are vacuous for this family. This closes the Gromov-norm door here; it reopens only for constructions with nonamenable or rationally essential topology. [Steps 56–57]

**Kähler/symplectic exclusion on all mixed rows (Step 57).** For \(1\le r\le35\): the row carries \(r\) non-torsion \(+2\)-spheres with \(b_+=9+r>1\), and \(36-r\ge1\) such spheres in the reverse orientation with \(b_+=45-r>1\). Any Kähler structure with \(b_+>1\) has nonzero SW invariants (Witten: \(SW(\pm K)=\pm1\) for minimal general type, \(K\) non-torsion since \(K^2=4+6r>0\); Taubes for symplectic), and the adjunction inequality with the genus-1 handle representative (\(|\langle c,[S]\rangle|+[S]^2\le0\)) contradicts \([S]^2=+2\). Hence **no mixed row admits a Kähler or symplectic structure in either orientation**, strictly strengthening the Step-56 Noether-parity exclusion (which reached only odd \(r\): \(c_1^2+c_2=60+6r\) or \(276-6r\) fails 12-divisibility) and removing the even-row ample-canonical question entirely. The same argument applies verbatim to the positive mirror rows \(r=1,2,3\) (\(b_+=2,3,4\) original; \(4,3,2\) reverse). [Steps 56–57]

**Obstruction scope.** Source-closed: ordinary simple-type numerical SW basic classes with \(b_+>1\) are killed by a non-torsion \(+2\)-sphere (`Constraints-on-embedded-spheres...` lines 27–48). Not source-closed: vanishing of all generic monopole, special monopole, torsion, or Bauer–Furuta stable-cohomotopy classes in the presence of a \(+2\)-sphere; Kotschick's source distinguishes these classes and records BF connected-sum survival. Inverted check (Step 57): all *known* nonvanishing mechanisms (Kotschick Thm 10, Ishida–LeBrun Cor 13, Bauer connected-sum) require Kähler/symplectic summands, and mixed rows are not Kähler and do not split along their \(+2\)-spheres (boundary \(\mathbb{RP}^3\neq S^3\)). A surviving BF/generic class feeding a LeBrun–Kotschick estimate on a mixed row would be a genuine \(P_4^-\) refutation route and remains the one live smooth-obstruction door. [Steps 55–57]

**Higher-genus check and endpoint principle (Steps 57, 59, 61).** The family \((\Sigma_h\times\Sigma_h)/\langle\iota\times\iota\rangle\) has \(N=4(h+1)^2\) nodes, \(\chi=8(h^2+h+1)\), \(\tau=-4(h+1)^2+2r\), HT margins \(2\chi\pm3\tau=4(h-1)^2+6r\) and \(4(h-1)^2+6(N-r)\), strictly positive for all \(h\ge2\), all \(r\). Structurally, across any such family \(\chi\) is fixed and \(|\tau|\) is largest at the endpoints, so the endpoints (known Einstein) *minimize* every margin-monotone Einstein inequality; no \((\chi,\tau,\|M\|,\deg)\)-type obstruction can exclude an interior row, and surgery near isolated points does not raise \(\|M\|\) or degrees. Enlarging the family adds no contradiction and no new mechanism. [Steps 57, 59, 61]

**The dichotomy (organizing statement, Steps 57–59).** Compatible (holomorphic) ALE bubbling preserves \(K^2\)-type data and lands on smooth manifolds already known Einstein (Aubin–Yau/del Pezzo/smoothing); reversed bubbling — forced when the first obstruction requires the opposite chirality — inserts a non-torsion \(+2\)-sphere that kills Kähler/symplectic structure in both orientations and thereby removes both the standard existence input (Kähler geometry) and the standard nonexistence input (nonzero monopole classes). The endpoint rows retaining monopole classes in one orientation are exactly the rows known Einstein. This holds verbatim for both mirrors. It is a structural explanation of why tight operator-norm pinching drives constructions into the existence/nonexistence void — a hardness wall, not a counterexample, and not a proof that all conceivable tools fail. [Steps 55–59, 62]

## Negative ALE construction, Burns obstruction, and smoothing caveat

- The first-obstruction amplitude mechanism is sign-agnostic: for a Kähler–Einstein surface orbifold in complex orientation, \(R_+=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0)\) for either sign. Known LeBrun nonexistence topology is generated by nonminimal \((-1)\)-blowups; the natural local model is Burns (\(\phi(s)=s+\log s\), \(\det(g_{i\bar j})=1+1/s\), \(\rho\ne0\)): scalar-flat Kähler, **not** Ricci-flat, and \(t\)-scaling makes its Ricci endomorphism visible at order \(t^{-1}\), so an ordinary blowup core cannot hide in a \(\|\operatorname{Ric}+g\|_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\) sequence. Structural mismatch evidence: pinching-compatible Ricci-flat ALE pieces model ADE/crepant topology, while established nonexistence margins come from noncrepant blowups. [Steps 43, 53–54]

- **Smooth-category fidelity correction (Steps 54–55).** The nodal quintic \(F=z^3(x^2+y^2+w^2)+x^5+y^5+w^5+xyw^3\) (verified single \(A_1\) point, \(K=\mathcal O_X(1)\), \(K^2=5\), resolution has nef-big-not-ample \(K\)) is **harmless** for Yau-26: for ADE surface singularities the Milnor fibre and minimal resolution are diffeomorphic (\(A_1\): both are \(T^*S^2\); in general, plumbing on the Dynkin tree), and Brieskorn simultaneous resolution plus Ehresmann makes this global. Smoothing inside the quintic system gives an ample-\(K\) fibre with an Aubin–Yau metric on the **same smooth manifold**. Complex-structure KE nonexistence is not smooth Einstein nonexistence; the output metric may live on a different complex structure. \(H^2(T^0)\) computations are only needed where global smoothability is genuinely in doubt (non-hypersurface quotient singularities, A01's BCGP situation). A01 #395's Lefschetz scan (\(K^2=2\) row supports existence; \(K^2=4,6\) rows \(d>0\)) records only failure of that sufficient route, not nonexistence. [Steps 54–56]

## Resonant H4 flux, the rate-limited necessity alternative, and the exponential drift channel

This arc (Steps 59–63) has a nontrivial supersession chain; the final status is at the end.

- **Step 59 (gap localized, one lemma misweighted).** In the ALE bubble frame, \(f_i=h_i/t_i\) satisfies \(P_{\rm eh}f_i=\Lambda\,{\rm eh}+O(\delta_i+t_i|f_i|^2)\); subsequential limits solve \(P_{\rm eh}f=\Lambda\,{\rm eh}+\sum\lambda_ko_k\), with \(\lambda_k\) determined by the large-\(\rho\) behavior \(f\sim H_2+O(\rho^{-2})\). The missing link is propagating \(h_i=O(t_i)\) from the matching radius \(\rho\sim\eta/\sqrt{t_i}\) to compact sets. Indicial pair \((2,-4)\), \(R\)-independent Wronskian \(-6\pi^2\). Naive bootstrap fails: elliptic constants accumulate \(C^k\sim t^{-c/2}\) over \(k\sim|\log t|/2\) scales (at \(t=10^{-8}\), the bound exceeds the target by \(2.56\times10^8\)). The pinched residual also carries a cosmological source \(\Lambda t_i^2\underline h_2\) growing as \(t_i^2\rho^2\). [Step 59]

- **Step 60 (resonance restored; the rate condition is real).** The nonresonant weighting was misidentified: \(\beta=2\) is exactly the resonant indicial root, and for \(\beta<2\) the estimate \(\|E_i\|_{C^0_{\beta-2}}\sim\delta_it_i^{\beta/2}\) is strictly worse than the \(O(t_i)\) target. The scalar \(l=2\) radial operator \(Lf=f''+3r^{-1}f'-8r^{-2}f\) has roots \(2,-4\), Wronskian \(r^3W=-6\), and the constant-source particular solution
  \[
  f_p=\tfrac{S}{6}r^2\log(r/r_0)-\tfrac{S}{36}\bigl(r^2-r_0^6r^{-4}\bigr)
  \]
  (symbolically verified). With \(S\sim t_i\delta_i\) and outer radius \(R\sim t_i^{-1/2}\), the obstruction-coefficient drift is \(O(t_i\delta_i\log(1/t_i))\) against the \(O(t_i)\) ambient signal: relative error \(O(\delta_i\log(1/t_i))\). **Steps 35–36/42's removal of the \(\delta\log(1/t)\) condition was logically circular** (it assumed the cross-neck \(O(t_i)\) rate it sought to prove); Step 34's resonance insight was structurally right. The Bianchi/Cotton mechanism is the same inequality read backwards: \(\operatorname{div}W=\) Cotton is controlled by \(\nabla\operatorname{Ric}\), which \(C^0\) pinching does not control; rotating \(W\) by \(O(1)\) over a neck of length \(L\) needs \(L\gtrsim1/\delta\), i.e. \(t\lesssim e^{-c/\delta}\). [Steps 34–36, 42, 59–60]

- **Step 60 local annulus evidence.** Exact symbolic Ricci for \(g=dr^2+r^2d\theta^2+e^{2u}d\phi^2+e^{-2u}d\psi^2\): \(\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm base}=-2\,du\otimes du\), fiber blocks \(\pm\Delta_Bu\). The mode \(u=t\,r^2A(\log r)\cos2\theta\) has \(\Delta u=t(A''+4A')\cos2\theta\). With the repaired shrinking-outer-radius schedule \(\eta_i^2\asymp\delta_i\), \(R_i=e^{a/\delta_i}\), \(t_i=\delta_i e^{-2a/\delta_i}\), the full exact local Ricci tensor is \(O(t_i\delta_i)\) (both \(|\Delta u|\) and \(|du|^2\)) while the \(l=2/H_2\)-type coefficient drifts by \(O(t_i)\); exact Ricci/(tδ) constants are bounded (\(\approx17.9\) at \(\delta=0.1,a=4\), similar at smaller \(\delta\)). The old fixed-\(\eta=1\) schedule fails (gradient-square/(tδ) grows like \(1/\delta\)). This is a local flat-\(T^2\)-warped model, not an EH/\(A_1\) neck or closed metric. [Step 60]

- **Step 61 (toric-cone transfer — model later invalidated).** The opposite-warping cancellation transfers exactly to the toric flat cone \(\mathbb R^4/\mathbb Z_2\), \(g=dr_1^2+r_1^2e^{2v}d\phi^2+dr_2^2+r_2^2e^{-2v}d\psi^2\): at \(v=0\) Ricci vanishes; base Ricci carries only first derivatives of \(v\); fiber Ricci is \(\pm Dv\) with \(D=\partial_{r_1}^2+\partial_{r_2}^2+r_1^{-1}\partial_{r_1}+r_2^{-1}\partial_{r_2}\). The unique \(T^2\)-invariant degree-2 harmonic is \(r_1^2-r_2^2=r^2\cos2\alpha\) (\(D(r_1^2-r_2^2)=0\)); \(v=A(\rho)(r_1^2-r_2^2)\) gives \(Dv=\cos2\alpha(A''+6A')\). Linearized Weyl at \(r_1=r_2\): \(W^+=W^-=\varepsilon A\,\operatorname{diag}(8/3,-16/3,8/3)\), eigenvalues \(8\varepsilon A/3\) (double), \(-16\varepsilon A/3\), char poly \(-(8A-3\lambda)^2(16A+3\lambda)/27\); sectional curvatures \(K_{12}=0,K_{13}=-6A,K_{14}=2A,K_{23}=2A,K_{24}=-6A,K_{34}=4A\). A Scal/6-vs-Scal/12 bug was caught via nonzero trace and fixed. [Step 61]

- **Step 62 (Preceptor invalidation and replacement).** Step 61's ansatz cannot model near-pinching: its linearized Ricci is \(\varepsilon A\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}-4&4\\4&-4\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)\oplus0\), eigenvalues \(-8\varepsilon A,0,0,0\), scalar \(-8\varepsilon A\) — **not Ricci-neutral**; the claimed Weyl-degeneracy amplitude \(\varepsilon A=\Lambda/16\) imports an \(O(\Lambda)\) Ricci defect, so "reachability under pinching" was false. Smoothness where each circle degenerates requires \(v(0,r_2)=v(r_1,0)=0\), which \(r_1^2-r_2^2\) violates on both axes (conical deficits along two 2-planes); no \(T^2\)-invariant degree-2 harmonic vanishes on either axis, and an angular cutoff would cost \(A/\theta_0^2\) in \(Dv\), needing \(\theta_0\gg\delta^{-1/2}\). Step 61's energy paragraph was also self-contradictory (\(O(t^{-2})\) is not \(\ll8\pi^2\chi\)). The Weyl/Ricci tables survive only as a dictionary for the discarded ansatz. [Steps 61–62]

- **Replacement: normal-coordinate Einstein-compatible 2-jets (Steps 62–63).** Let \(\mathcal E=\{H\text{ quadratic homogeneous}:\delta\operatorname{Ric}(H)=\Lambda e\}\), \(H_{R,ij}=-\tfrac13R_{ikjl}x^kx^l\). Dimension count (audited): algebraic curvature tensors in dimension four form a 20-dimensional space, Ricci contraction has rank 10, so the fixed-Ricci tangent is the full 10-dimensional Weyl space \(\operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\Lambda^+)\oplus\operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\Lambda^-)\). Quadratic jets are smooth and \(\mathbb Z_2\)-even — no axis condition. Step 63 verified symbolically: \(\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm lin}(H_E)|_0=\Lambda\,\delta_{ij}\) (jet space Einstein-compatible), \(\operatorname{Ric}_{\rm lin}(W)|_0=0\) for Weyl-direction jets, and **all drift terms vanish at \(x=0\)** (\(W\) quadratic, \(dW\) linear); the \(O(A'),O(A'')\) corrections appear only at \(O(r)\), scaling as \(O(\delta)\) at the outer edge for \(|A'|,|A''|\lesssim\delta\). Thus the Weyl block can traverse the full 10-dimensional Weyl space with \(\|\operatorname{Ric}-\Lambda g\|_{\rm op}\le C\delta\) at the 2-jet level. [Steps 62–63]

- **Two-point reachability is universal (Step 63).** The degenerate set in \(\operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\mathbb R^3)\) is a union of three hyperplanes (codimension 1); any outer Weyl value connects to a degenerate configuration by a bounded path. The drift channel is not specific to special orbifold geometry; on the product-quotient orbifolds it is moot because \(R_\pm=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0)\) is already degenerate with a 2D kernel. [Steps 61, 63]

- **Final status: a sharp conditional alternative, not an unconditional theorem.** The missing analytic object is a genuine weak TT/Wronskian flux lemma \(H_{\rm flux}\): compatible Bianchi/TT annular gauges, ambient \(H_2/H_4/\cdots\) tower subtraction at signal order, control of nonlinear/gauge/bad-set/cutoff errors, and inner/outer ALE flux identification giving
  \[
  |B_k(r_2)-B_k(r_1)|\le Ct_i\delta_i\log(r_2/r_1)+o(t_i)
  \]
  against signal \(t_i\langle R_\pm(p)\zeta,\zeta_k\rangle\). If \(H_{\rm flux}\) holds, an effective ADE bubble satisfies
  \[
  \|\Pi_\Gamma(R_\pm(p)\zeta)\|\le C\delta_i\log(1/t_i)+o(1),
  \]
  hence: **either** the projected first Biquard–Ozuch obstruction vanishes (rate regime \(\delta_i\log(1/t_i)\to0\), with the ADE invariant refinement making this finite and E-types excluded on the nontrivial block), **or** \(t_i\le e^{-c/\delta_i}\). Step 63's jet-drift verification shows the exponential branch is a **genuine geometric channel at the 2-jet level**, so the rate \(\delta\log(1/t)\) is sharp, not a proof artifact. This does not construct a counterexample: global realization requires the matching problem on an exponential neck, smoothness at singular loci, and smooth-category Einstein nonexistence of the filling. The drift neck is Chern–Weil invisible (added Weyl energy \(o(1)\) under the correct outer-matching schedule), so no energy-counting argument can detect the channel. [Steps 60–63]

## Positive collapse reframed

- In dimension four, tight positive pinching with \(\operatorname{Vol}\to0\) and \(\chi>0\) **forces curvature blow-up**: \(\int|W|^2\to8\pi^2\chi>0\) while volume vanishes, and bounded-curvature collapse would produce an \(F\)-structure, hence \(\chi=0\), contradiction. So pinched collapse must bubble, and the collapse branch is not a regular principal-circle theory (\(S^2\times S^2\) is not a principal \(S^1\) bundle over a 3-manifold, \(\chi=4\)). [Steps 58, 60]

- The natural collapsed-bubbling models are plausibly ALF rather than pure ALE (unproved). Only a scalar ALF proxy is recorded: on the \(\mathbb R^3\) base the roots are \(\ell,-\ell-1\), mass pair \((0,-1)\), flux \(r^2W=-(2\ell+1)\); the ALE \(l=2\) degeneracy condition is not the right ALF obstruction, and a true result needs the tensor Lichnerowicz/Einstein operator on Taub–NUT/Euclidean Schwarzschild with gauge. [Step 60]

- Almost-Killing production remains the identified missing theorem; the productive posture is adversarial — globalize fast fibre/twist variation (Step 29's local jet, Step 60's annulus) into a closed collapsing near-pinched family, or let the obstruction encountered become the proof. Symmetric examples (lens spaces, principal bundles) cannot test production because the fields are assumed. [Steps 28–30, 58–60]

## Higher-dimensional codimension-four probe

- In \(n\ge5\), Cheeger–Naber gives codimension-four singular strata; a nonzero first-obstruction coefficient at any stratum point gives an \(O(1)\) Ricci-endomorphism defect on the corresponding ALE core, and an integrated obstruction cannot control the pointwise operator norm. A possible extension needs a pointwise obstruction-bundle condition \(R_{{\rm normal},\pm}(y)\zeta(y)\) with normal-connection and tangential-derivative terms; a warped-product toy shows \(O(1)\) tangential variation of the ALE parameter produces unsuppressed curvature. No stratified ALE-bundle theorem exists in the record. [Steps 46, 53–54]

## High-dimensional obstruction status

- Inspected literature (Wang's survey) produced **no known closed manifold of dimension \(\ge5\) admitting no Einstein metric of any sign**; nonexistence of invariant Einstein metrics does not imply smooth nonexistence. Refuting \(P_n\) for any \(n\ge5\) therefore first requires producing a high-dimensional non-Einstein closed manifold — itself a recognized open problem — so refutation effort concentrates in dimension four, and \(n\ge5\) must be approached from the proof side or via new construction. Kaluza–Klein families show positive collapse can be fully Einstein-compatible in every \(n\ge5\). [Steps 22–24, 58]

### Decisions and Recorded Reasons

- The target remains unchanged: prove or strictly refute Yau Problem 26 for every \(n\ge2\), for all closed connected smooth manifolds and arbitrary smooth metrics satisfying a dimension-only two-sided Ricci interval, with no noncollapse, sectional-curvature, topology, symmetry, Kähler, proximity, or sign assumptions. Final completion still requires an independently reproducible Lean 4 proof and audit. The quantifiers were normalized into positive and negative branches; refutation requires arbitrarily tight same-sign pinching on manifolds carrying no Einstein metric of any sign [Step 1].

- The opening search considered Min-Oo negative stability, prescribed-Ricci flexibility, positive compactness and collapse, orbifold/ALE resolutions, gauge-theoretic obstructions, and explicit models. Positive degeneration in dimension four eventually received priority, while negative and high-dimensional lines were retained as unresolved alternatives rather than disproved routes [Steps 1–9].

- Min-Oo’s negative almost-Einstein theorem was retained only as a restricted stability boundary because it requires
  \[
  d(g)^2\max |K_g|<\Lambda^2,
  \]
  not merely Ricci pinching. A negative no-Einstein sequence must escape through diameter growth, collapse, or full-curvature concentration; exact large-diameter hyperbolic examples show why this cannot be a general endpoint [Steps 1, 22].

- The first Calabi/ALE gluing shortcut to a counterexample was rejected. Weighted or \(L^p\)-small remainders can coexist with an order-one nonscalar Ricci endomorphism on an ALE core, so separate bubbles cannot cancel the defect in the pointwise operator norm used by Yau–26. This observation later became the obstruction-amplitude principle distinguishing first from higher gluing obstructions [Steps 1, 32, 48–50].

- A Step-2 LeBrun conclusion was retracted after the user found a factor-four scalar-curvature error. In dimension four, \(\operatorname{Ric}=\lambda g\) gives \(s=4\lambda\); the corrected thresholds are \(k\ge2A/3\) for the scalar estimate and \(k\ge A/3\) for the refined scalar–Weyl estimate. The argument was also repaired to distinguish an individual basic-class square \(A-k\) from the convex-hull projection bound \((a^+)^2\ge A\) [Steps 2–3].

- The valid LeBrun residue is a stable-integral principle: if an all-metric curvature inequality has a strict gap from its Einstein equality value, a near-Einstein metric can pay that gap only through \(O(\delta^2)\operatorname{Vol}\) trace-free Ricci energy. In the recorded family,
  \[
  \frac{\delta}{1-\delta}\ge\sqrt{\frac{p-1/3}{2}},\qquad p=k/A.
  \]
  Fixed \(p>1/3\) gives a uniform negative pinching gap; weakening occurs only toward \(p\downarrow1/3\) [Step 3].

- The equality threshold was clarified again in Step 54: LeBrun’s Einstein nonexistence theorem applies at \(p=1/3\), while the strict quantitative pinching margin above vanishes there. Thus the residual negative difficulty is not failure of the nonexistence theorem but failure of the stable inequality to retain positive room at the boundary [Steps 3–4, 53–54].

- The LeBrun zero-margin regime remains unresolved and was demoted as A02’s original main line because it covers only a normalized negative branch in dimension four. Positive scalar curvature under tight positive pinching also disables the Seiberg–Witten mechanisms used in the negative setting [Steps 3–4, 18].

- Any admissible four-dimensional interval must be same-sign: on a known no-Einstein manifold, rescaling an arbitrary metric drives the Ricci endomorphism toward zero, so every fixed interval straddling zero eventually contains that metric. This observation does not decide either same-sign branch [Step 3].

- Four-dimensional Chern–Gauss–Bonnet was adopted as a common accounting system:
  \[
  8\pi^2\chi
  =\int\left(|W|^2+\frac{s^2}{24}-\frac{|E|^2}{2}\right).
  \]
  Under \(\|\operatorname{Ric}-\sigma g\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\delta\), the pointwise-optimal coefficient
  \[
  \beta(\delta)=
  \begin{cases}
  \frac23(1-\delta)^2,&0\le\delta\le\frac13,\\
  \frac23(1+\delta)(1-2\delta),&\frac13\le\delta<\frac12
  \end{cases}
  \]
  gives
  \[
  \beta(\delta)\operatorname{Vol}+\int|W|^2\le8\pi^2\chi.
  \]
  It remains useful for topology and energy bookkeeping but does not exclude local collapse, Weyl concentration, or boundary bubbles [Steps 4, 14–15].

- “Tight positive pinching excludes collapse” was explicitly withdrawn. Berger-type collapse may become Ricci-anisotropic, but round lens-space quotients and their products are exactly Einstein and collapse. Exact Kaluza–Klein products later supplied positive Einstein collapse in every \(n\ge5\). The correct question is whether pinching-compatible collapse is compatible with some Einstein metric on the same topology, not whether collapse occurs [Steps 3–6, 10, 24].

Since both blocks are rank one at the product quotient, kernel directions are available for every chirality assignment; different bubble points do not interact at leading order [Step 50].
