  (b_+,b_-)=(1+r,5-r),\qquad r=1,2,3,
  \]
  are supported as simply connected positive-scalar-curvature manifolds, satisfy strict Hitchin–Thorpe, and have \(b_+\ge2\). Ordinary Seiberg–Witten obstructions vanish in the PSC setting, and no existence theorem in the session covers them. All known compact positive Einstein four-manifold examples in the session have \(b_+\le1\), but this is a status observation, not a theorem. Thus the reduction ties \(P_4^+\) to the recognized open problem of positive Einstein metrics with \(b_+\ge2\) [Steps 50–51].

- Exact spin, parity, and smooth diffeomorphism type of the mixed rows were deliberately left unclaimed. A corrected toric calibration superseded an erroneous determinant computation, and a discriminant-glue probe showed parity can depend on attaching data. Further spin chasing, \(V_4\) enumeration, higher Ozuch obstructions, and attempts to force SW nonexistence on PSC rows were deprioritized because they do not breach the identified wall [Steps 45, 50–51].

- The positive noncollapsed product-quotient route was declared substantially exhausted at its present ceiling. It supplies explicit near-pinched inputs and a sharp hardness reduction, but no Einstein nonexistence theorem on the target manifolds. Positive collapse remains separately indispensable and blocked at the central almost-Killing-field bridge [Steps 50–51].

- The A01/A03 negative cutoff-flow program was selected for an independent A02 audit because it was the group’s most advanced candidate for a restricted theorem and had repeatedly revised its continuation claims. Verification was explicitly scoped to the single load-bearing start/first-exit interface rather than accepting peer “TTCS-verified” reports or walking the whole chain [Step 51].

- The normalized critical energy reaction coefficient was corrected to \(2p-n\); intermediate formulas with \(2p+n\) are wrong. At \(p=n/2\) the homothetic reaction vanishes. Bounds on evolving \(\nabla_g^2\chi\) or \(\Delta_g\chi\) cannot be inferred from metric equivalence, so the Hessian-source treatment must avoid that shortcut [Step 51].

- Step 52 independently confirmed that a spatially varying cutoff creates curvature even from flat data. On flat \(T^4\), the unshifted normalized cutoff flow gives
  \[
  \int|\mathrm{Rm}|^2=48\pi^4t^2+O(t^3),
  \]
  so no homogeneous unshifted estimate \(E'\le CE\) can hold. This does not refute shifted-curvature formulations, which were introduced precisely to absorb cutoff-created curvature; Step 53 corrected the earlier tendency to read the example as breaking the whole start module [Steps 52–53].

- The DeTurck pullback issue was confirmed: pulling back \(a\hat g\) transports the coefficient, so the ordinary trick gives a transported-cutoff flow, not the fixed-cutoff geometric flow. A coupled metric-plus-scalar-transport system is the correct repair target. A03 later withdrew its initial coupled-start theorem because the frozen-input velocity gave only Hölder dependence; a triangular output-velocity iteration remains pending [Steps 52–54].

- Step 52 proposed a structural \(A^{-1/2}\) ceiling for the Ishida–LeBrun flow program from the Sobolev-energy critical product and metric comparison. Step 53 provisionally used this to demote the coupled fixed point. Step 54 withdrew the strong impossibility conclusion after A03 pointed out that eligible-core volume averaging may cancel the global \(A\) factor and that an upper local-energy bound cannot be inverted into the asserted lower bound. The current status is neither a proved family-uniform gap nor a proved scaling obstruction: the exact-flow start and first-exit estimates remain conditional [Steps 52–54].

- The simpler stable LeBrun inequality remains stronger away from the boundary \(p=1/3\). The flow program can add new value only near the zero-margin Ishida–LeBrun regime; A02 handed its repaired-but-unproved coupled-flow program back to A01/A03 rather than opening another long local-flow project [Steps 53–54].

- The ALE first-obstruction machinery was then redirected to the negative side because genuine Einstein nonexistence results exist there. Step 53 identified a structural tension: Ricci-flat ADE/Kronheimer bubbles compatible with operator-norm pinching are crepant and preserve \(c_1^2\), while the known LeBrun deficits arise from noncrepant \((-1)\)-blowups modeled by Burns geometry [Step 53].

- The Burns distinction was made explicit. For the Burns potential \(\phi(s)=s+\log s\),
  \[
  \det(g_{i\bar j})=1+\frac1s,
  \]
  so the metric is scalar-flat Kähler but not Ricci-flat. Scaling a Burns core by \(t\) makes its nonzero Ricci endomorphism visible at order \(t^{-1}\); it cannot be hidden in a sequence with \(\|\operatorname{Ric}+g\|_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\). Thus the most direct local model for adding the \((-1)\)-curves used by LeBrun nonexistence is inadmissible for tight pinching [Steps 53–54].

- Step 54 corrected an overbroad conclusion that crepant negative resolutions should themselves be Einstein. A crepant resolution of a negative canonical ADE orbifold has \(K\) nef and big but not ample because exceptional \((-2)\)-curves satisfy \(K\cdot E=0\); hence that complex structure has no negative Kähler–Einstein metric. However Yau–26 asks about the underlying smooth manifold. A global \(\mathbb Q\)-Gorenstein smoothing, simultaneous resolution, and Ehresmann identification can put a negative Kähler–Einstein metric from a smooth ample-canonical fibre on the same differentiable manifold. Therefore “nef but not ample” is not a smooth Einstein nonexistence theorem [Step 54].

- A concrete negative ADE test object was constructed: a projective quintic with exactly one ordinary double point, canonical square \(K^2=5\), and crepant resolution carrying a \((-2)\)-curve. It demonstrates that the negative ADE setting is nonvacuous, but a standard smoothing likely makes this example harmless by producing a diffeomorphic smooth ample-canonical fibre [Step 54].

- A01 reported a stronger smoothing bridge for a BCGP \(\mathbb Z_4^2\) row using reflexive tangent-sheaf cohomology, Lee–Park smoothing, simultaneous resolution, Ehresmann, and Aubin–Yau. A02 had not independently read or accepted the proof by the end of Step 54. The immediate recorded task is to verify exactly which examples this establishes and whether the minimal resolution is indeed the same smooth manifold as the negative Kähler–Einstein fibre [Step 54].

- The negative ALE wall was accordingly reformulated in smooth-category terms. The relevant filtered class consists of locally first-obstruction-killed Ricci-flat ALE/ADE desingularizations whose underlying smooth manifolds are neither already known Einstein through global smoothing/simultaneous resolution nor excluded by LeBrun/SW/Hitchin–Thorpe. No explicit source-backed member of this filtered class has yet been established [Step 54].

- Broad classification claims for Ricci-flat ALE bubbles with \(\Gamma\not\subset SU(2)\) were not accepted because retrieval of the named Nakajima, Šuvaina, and Lock–Viaclovsky sources failed. Non-Kähler or non-\(SU(2)\) Ricci-flat ALE bubbles remain a source gap rather than a closed case [Step 54].

- The bounded \(n\ge5\) probe concluded that a naive integral of first obstruction along a codimension-four singular stratum is too weak for a pointwise operator norm: a nonzero coefficient at any stratum point creates an order-one defect on that normal ALE core. Any meaningful extension must be a pointwise or elliptic obstruction-bundle condition
  \[
  R_{\mathrm{normal},\pm}(y)\zeta(y)=0
  \]
  with control of the normal connection and tangential variation of \(\zeta\). Cheeger–Naber stratification alone does not provide such an ALE bundle theorem, and the four-dimensional normalized flux bridge is itself incomplete. This front was kept bounded rather than promoted to a new program [Steps 53–54].

- The current allocation is to reconcile the negative ADE smoothing/existence claim before banking any negative hardness reduction. If A01’s bridge is valid for all accessible examples, those examples should be marked existence-known and the result becomes an explanation of why Ricci-flat ALE constructions align with Einstein existence. If a smoothing-obstructed example exists, it becomes the next candidate for an explicit negative near-pinched construction. The full proposition, positive collapse, unrestricted negative degeneration, \(n\ge5\), and Lean formalization remain open [Step 54].

### Research Line

- The project began by fixing the logical burden of Yau–26 and testing whether known stability, prescribed-curvature, or obstruction theorems already decided a sign branch. Min-Oo showed how negative almost-Einstein sequences could escape restricted stability, while ALE gluing exposed the decisive difference between weighted residual control and pointwise Ricci-endomorphism control. The research question shifted from “does an existing theorem solve the problem?” to “which degeneration lets a tightly Ricci-isotropic metric evade Einstein existence?” [Steps 1–3].

- Four-dimensional gauge theory was the first sustained obstruction line. The Step-2 arithmetic error and user correction forced a reconstruction of the LeBrun argument. The broad obstruction failed, but it yielded the reusable stable-integral principle and clarified that only a zero-margin negative regime remained. Because that regime covered one sign and one dimension, A02 moved away from treating it as the central all-dimensional route [Steps 2–4].

- Chern–Gauss–Bonnet then became a shared accounting language across positive collapse, negative obstruction, and bubbling. It records topology and scale-invariant energy but repeatedly failed as a standalone contradiction because fixed energy can concentrate on shrinking rods, bolts, and bubbles. Later corrections to edge-cone and EH energy decompositions reinforced that it supplies budgets and finiteness, not automatic exclusion [Steps 4, 8, 14–18, 34–37, 45].

- Positive pinching gained priority because Myers and Bishop give dimension-only diameter and volume ceilings, unlike the negative branch. That priority did not become a no-collapse thesis: Berger anisotropy, lens spaces, products, and Kaluza–Klein examples showed that collapse can be exactly Einstein. The program changed from excluding collapse to distinguishing Einstein-compatible collapse from genuinely obstructed collapse [Steps 5–7, 10, 24].

- The first noncollapsed compactness hope was corrected through Cheeger–Naber theory. Regular convergence holds away from codimension-four singularities, but Weyl concentration can preserve bounded Ricci while losing smooth topology. In dimension four, noncollapsed regular convergence is the easy positive alternative; bubbling is the only noncollapsed obstruction. For large topological families, finite diffeomorphism type already forces collapse, so noncollapsed analysis principally addresses fixed-manifold or fixed-complexity problems [Steps 5, 9–10, 30–31, 43].

- Step 11’s opposite-warping spike was the central regularity lesson. It killed direct pointwise curvature estimates from \(C^0\) Ricci pinching while preserving weaker metric compactness. This redirected the work toward harmonic-radius weak estimates, determinant variables, weak tensor pairings, and angular-mode or flux methods instead of \(C^2\) convergence [Steps 10–12, 33–35, 42, 47].

- The toric program grew from that determinant viewpoint. Initial spectral and area ideas were progressively stripped of false assumptions: orbit curvature has no fixed sign, Euclidean Faber–Krahn does not apply arbitrarily, signed Gauss–Bonnet permits boundary wells, and energy quanta fit the Euler budget. Exact edge germs revealed that local Einstein compatibility is abundant and that global closure is the real issue [Steps 12–18].

- The alternating toric family became a direct collapse stress test on \(\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\). Low-order corner calculations and formal \(A_m=m^\alpha\) families showed that all tested local and integral conditions permit collapse. This did not construct a metric, but moved the possible obstruction from local curvature to global filling, mixed eigenfunction equations, determinant closure, and period transport [Steps 18–26].

- The collapsed toric front underwent repeated repairs. The isolated-Schwarzschild interpretation became a periodic or infinite rod-chain problem; the claim that alternating labels exclude struts was corrected because conical defects live along rods; and noncompact Weyl period drift was recognized as an end/asymptotic phenomenon rather than a compact obstruction [Steps 34–38].

- Known compact Einstein metrics prevented another overgeneralization. Page and CLW show that repeated circle classes can close smoothly. Liu’s results isolated the exact diagonal two-class sector where the session’s \(p,q,w\) equations apply. Constant-curvature and linearized numerical tests did not prove rigidity, so this route was retained as a specialized adversary rather than the main theorem path [Steps 39–41].

- In parallel, the collapse program explored nilpotent fibres. The initial Milnor-only abelianization claim failed because extrinsic terms can compensate fibre Ricci. The \(H_3\) model turned that failure into a quantitative positive/negative distinction, and the Bochner center identity replaced the ansatz with a dimension-flexible \(L^2\) mechanism. The missing almost-Killing-field production theorem remains the decisive block, so positive collapse was not reopened without a new mechanism [Steps 25–30, 51].

- Because collapse stalled, the work returned to noncollapsed bubbling. Ozuch’s Pohozaev identities and the cosmological Einstein tensor suggested a derivative-free transfer of first obstruction. The route evolved from a vague weak projection into a balanced-annulus, mode-sensitive Wronskian problem [Steps 30–34].

- The apparent \(\delta\log(1/t)\) obstruction was removed by reading coefficients on fixed bubble-frame annuli rather than transporting them through the whole neck. The demand for a second-order blow-up was then rejected because only \(C^{1,\alpha}\cap W^{2,p}\) convergence is available. Step 47’s dual testing and Step 48’s whole-bubble Jacobi field clarified that the obstruction is a conserved flux forced to vanish by inner regularity, not merely a two-mode expansion on an annulus [Steps 34–36, 42, 47–48].

- Step 46 transformed the bridge into a conditional theorem with explicit dependencies and extended its intended representation-theoretic scope beyond \(A_1\). Step 47’s review removed the invalid “generic” Kähler conclusion, added isotropy invariance of the curvature block, and corrected the \(E\)-type exceptional-locus claim. The useful output is a finite fixed-limit obstruction problem, not a probabilistic or generic exclusion [Steps 46–47].

- The H4-dual architecture was then corrected at the normalization level. The unnormalized bubble perturbation and flux vanish automatically, so necessity requires quantitative matching after division by the ambient quadratic scale. This is a genuinely new two-scale theorem not supplied by Cheeger–Naber convergence. The first-order necessity bridge therefore remains valuable but incomplete [Steps 48–49].

- The bi-Kähler product quotient changed the strategic meaning of first obstruction. Initially treated as a loophole requiring higher-order analysis, it was recognized in Steps 49–50 as a construction laboratory: both chiral blocks have kernel, reversed bubbles satisfy the same local estimate, and killing the first obstruction suffices for operator-norm pinching even if exact Einstein gluing is obstructed at higher order [Steps 44–50].

- The operator-norm scaling correction was decisive. It showed that the first obstruction is not merely the first rung of an infinite gluing tower; it is the complete local obstruction visible at leading order to explicit Yau–26 input metrics. Higher Ozuch obstructions matter for exact desingularization but vanish in the pinching norm. This shifted effort from higher-order analysis to direct refined approximate metrics [Steps 48–50].

- The resulting positive noncollapsed output is a hardness reduction. Mixed resolutions of \((S^2\times S^2)/\mathbb Z_2\) carry near-positive-Einstein metrics, while their Einstein status is outside current positive existence and nonexistence tools. The arrow is only
  \[
  P_4^+\Longrightarrow \text{each mixed row carries an Einstein metric}.
  \]
  This does not settle \(P_4^+\), but it identifies the open \(b_+\ge2\) positive-Einstein problem as a genuine wall rather than an artifact of incomplete gluing [Steps 49–51].

- This wall ended the main positive noncollapsed arc. Exact mixed-row spin or smooth classification was judged unnecessary for the reduction and liable to repeat earlier topology overclaims. Positive collapse remains necessary for the full branch, but the absence of a new almost-Killing mechanism prevented immediate redirection there [Steps 50–51].

- A02 next adopted an independent cross-check role on A01/A03’s negative cutoff-flow program. The goal was not to help complete every estimate but to identify the first nonuniform or invalid interface. This audit found the normalization-sign correction, unsafe cutoff Hessian bounds, a transported-coefficient DeTurck issue, and curvature creation in the unshifted formulation [Steps 51–52].

- Step 52 initially interpreted Sobolev/critical-product scaling as a structural \(A^{-1/2}\) ceiling. Step 53 used that conclusion to argue that the flow could not improve the already uniform LeBrun gap away from \(p=1/3\) and could not reach the boundary where it was needed. Step 54 accepted A03’s correction that the asserted ceiling was not proved: eligible-core averaging may remove the global factor, and the local-energy inequalities did not justify the claimed lower bound. The flow chain remains conditional, but not structurally refuted [Steps 52–54].

- This correction preserved a narrower outcome of the audit. The flat-torus example only rules out homogeneous unshifted curvature-energy closure, not shifted-curvature systems. The coupled fixed-cutoff start is still unproved after A03 withdrew its first theorem, and the first-exit \(H_2,Q,J_6\) chain has not been independently established. A02 therefore did not bank the peer negative theorem [Steps 52–54].

- The first-obstruction machinery was next applied conceptually to negative Kähler orbifolds because this is where local near-pinched construction might meet actual Einstein nonexistence. The first picture was a crepant/noncrepant mismatch: admissible Ricci-flat ADE bubbles preserve canonical square, while LeBrun nonexistence is produced by \((-1)\)-curve deficits whose Burns model is not Ricci-flat [Step 53].

- Step 54 sharpened but also limited that wall. A negative KE ADE orbifold has a compatible Kähler block with the required rank-one kernel, so refined ALE insertion plausibly yields near-negative-Einstein metrics on its crepant resolution. Yet failure of ampleness on the resolved complex surface does not imply absence of an Einstein metric on the smooth manifold. Global smoothing may identify the same manifold with an ample-canonical smooth fibre carrying a negative Kähler–Einstein metric [Step 54].

- The explicit nodal quintic and A01’s claimed BCGP smoothing bridge changed the next question from “does crepancy create a negative hardness wall?” to “which ALE resolutions are not already Einstein by smoothing?” The immediate line is therefore an independent audit of the reflexive-cohomology, global-smoothing, simultaneous-resolution, and Ehresmann chain. If all accessible ADE examples are smoothing-harmless, the bankable conclusion is explanatory: operator-norm-admissible local topology changes naturally align with Einstein existence, while known no-Einstein deficits use inadmissible non-Ricci-flat cores [Step 54].

- The negative residual risk remains localized but unresolved. At \(p>1/3\), the stable LeBrun inequality supplies a strict gap. At \(p=1/3\), LeBrun nonexistence still holds but its stable pinching margin vanishes; the flow theorem remains conditional, and no verified ALE construction has yet produced a smooth no-Einstein target there. Negative collapse and diameter escape also remain outside the ALE picture [Steps 3–4, 22–24, 53–54].

- The bounded \(n\ge5\) probe supplied a structural negative result about the proposed integral-stratum idea. Since the target norm is pointwise, integration along a codimension-four stratum cannot cancel a nonzero local core obstruction. A higher-dimensional extension would need a bundle-valued pointwise or elliptic condition and slow/parallel variation of ALE parameters. The required structure is absent from current bounded-Ricci compactness theory, so this was recorded as a bounded verdict rather than a new long-term program [Steps 53–54].

- The current research state is therefore a collection of substantive restricted results and sharp walls rather than proximity to the full theorem: a stable negative gap away from \(p=1/3\); an endpoint regularity counterexample; toric and nilpotent collapse mechanisms with identified missing bridges; a conditional first-obstruction necessity architecture; an explicit positive product-quotient hardness reduction; a corrected but still unproved negative flow chain; and a filtered negative ALE/smoothing question. Positive collapse, unrestricted negative degeneration, arbitrary non-Kähler/non-\(SU(2)\) bubbling, every dimension \(n\ge5\), and the final Lean formalization remain open [Steps 45–54].

## 研究目标、量词规范化与总体状态 [Steps 1–5, 22–24, 28–54]

研究始终围绕用户给出的完整 Yau 第26题：对每个 \(n\ge2\)，是否存在仅依赖维数的 \(c_n<C_n\)，使任意闭、连通、光滑实 \(n\)-流形上的任意 Riemann 度量 \(g\) 若满足
\[
c_ng\le \operatorname{Ric}_g\le C_ng,
\]
则同一光滑流形承载某个 Einstein 度量。工作中持续纠正量词和隐含假设：输出 Einstein 度量不必接近输入 \(g\)，Einstein 常数符号任意；不得暗加非塌缩、全曲率界、Kähler、对称性、固定拓扑型或特殊 ansatz [Steps 1–5]。

缩放后固定维数可写为
\[
P_n^\sigma:\quad \exists\delta_n>0,\ 
\|\operatorname{Ric}_g-\sigma g\|_{\rm op}\le\delta_n
\Longrightarrow M\text{ 承载某个 Einstein 度量},
\qquad \sigma=\pm1.
\]
原命题在每个维数等价于 \(P_n^+\lor P_n^-\)：证明时每个维数只需建立一个符号分支，反驳则必须在同一维数同时击败正、负两支，且两支反例可以来自不同流形 [Steps 1–2]。二维可由一致化处理，三维正分支可借正 Ricci/Hamilton–几何化型结果；核心困难从四维开始 [Steps 1,5]。

截至 Step 54，尚未证明或证伪任何 \(n\ge4\) 的完整符号分支，更未完成全维命题。四维正非塌缩研究已经产生一个可复用的第一障碍框架和 product-quotient 单向 hardness reduction；四维负分支有稳定 LeBrun 积分障碍，但零余量边界、流动链和 ALE 构造均未闭合；正负塌缩、\(n\ge5\)、任意拓扑与主命题 Lean 形式化仍基本开放。现有 Lean 文件只形式化局部代数模型，不涉及 Cheeger–Naber、bubble tree、Ricci 流、ALE 障碍或主命题 [Steps 27–29,46–54]。

`Skills/qiushi-yau26/references/research/20260910.tex` 一直作为文献地图。研究多次因直接核对原文、脚本、TTCS 和会话组交叉审计而改线；尤其不能把 A01/A03 的“已验证”报告自动视为 A02 已独立核验的结果 [Steps 23–24,35–54]。

## 负分支开局：Min–Oo 尺度逃逸与算子范数中的第一障碍临界性 [Steps 1–3, 22–24, 32]

最初核对 Min–Oo 原论文 OCR 与记号，纠正了把其附加条件理解成局部 Ricci 控制的倾向。Min–Oo 在负标量归一化、小 Ricci 各向异性并满足
\[
d(g)^2\max |K_g|<\Lambda^2
\]
时得到 Einstein 存在；该尺度条件不由本题双侧 Ricci 夹逼自动给出 [Step 1]。因此若某个无 Einstein 流形族存在
\[
\|\operatorname{Ric}_{g_j}+g_j\|_{\rm op}\to0,
\]
则必须通过直径、Weyl/全曲率集中、塌缩或线性化近核退化等方式逃离 Min–Oo 紧致区；至少
\[
d(g_j)^2\max |K_{g_j}|\to\infty
\]
[Steps 1–2]。闭双曲流形本身可以精确满足 \(\operatorname{Ric}=-g\) 而直径任意大，说明直径控制不可能成为一般负分支终点 [Step 22]。

会话组最早尝试利用 Morteza–Viaclovsky、Ozuch 型 orbifold 解消，在无 Einstein 流形上制造 near-Einstein 度量。读取 MV Calabi 胶合区估计并用 `workspace/scripts/orbifold_scaling_exponents.py` 将 weighted tensor 估计换成本题的 Ricci-endomorphism 范数后，发现若
\[
\operatorname{Ric}_{g_t}-\Lambda g_t-t\lambda\chi_t o
=O_{g_{\rm cal}}(t^2\rho^2),\qquad g_t\sim t\,g_{\rm cal},
\]
普通余项升指标后核心区为 \(O(t)\)、过渡区至多 \(O(t^{1/2})\)，但第一障碍项 \(t\lambda o\) 升指标后是阶一非标量 endomorphism [Steps 1–2]。Calabi 核上障碍张量具有非平凡特征值差，即使调整标量 Einstein 常数也不能消掉该谱间隙。

由此，已知第一障碍非零的 MV 非存在例和 Ozuch 的 \(L^p\)/GH near-Einstein 例不能直接反驳本题。多奇点障碍仅在积分上相消也无用，因为本题要求逐点上确界小。有效解消构造必须在每个局部使第一障碍向量消失，或使相对幅度 \(|\lambda_j|/|\Lambda_j|\to0\)；高阶或全局障碍可以阻止精确 Einstein 解，却未必阻止本题所需的 \(\delta\to0\) [Steps 1–3]。Step 32 将此整理为 obstruction-amplitude principle：本题的 \(C^0\) Ricci 算子范数恰是第一障碍的尺度临界范数，weighted 或积分小性不能代替它 [Step 32]。Steps 48–50 后进一步明确：第二及更高障碍升指标后通常为 \(O(t)\) 或更小，对 exact Einstein gluing 重要，但对制造 near-pinched 输入度量并非负载性障碍 [Steps 48–50]。

## LeBrun–Seiberg–Witten 路线的错误修复、稳定积分障碍与零余量边界 [Steps 2–4, 22–24, 33–54]

Step 2 曾误写四维 Einstein Chern–Gauss–Bonnet 项，并错误声称 \(X\#k\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2\) 对所有 \(0<k<A=c_1^2(X)\) 都无负 Einstein 度量。用户叫停后，Step 3 完整撤回并修复。正确公式为
\[
8\pi^2(2\chi+3\tau)
=4\int |W^+|^2+\frac43\lambda^2V
\]
当 \(\operatorname{Ric}=\lambda g\) [Step 3]。修复还厘清 LeBrun 估计使用 monopole 类凸包及自对偶投影，不是单个 blow-up 类的平方。对符号族平均后可取 \(a=\pi^*K_X\)，得到 \((a^+)^2\ge A\)，恢复文献阈值：粗标量估计给 \(k\ge2A/3\)，精细标量–\(W^+\) 估计给 \(k\ge A/3\) 的 Einstein 非存在 [Step 3]。主要记录为 `workspace/scripts/step3_corrected_lebrun_bounds.py`、相应 JSON 和 `workspace/notes/step3_stable_integral_obstruction_principle.md` [Steps 3–4]。

该路线形成稳定积分障碍原则：若对所有度量成立的曲率积分不等式与 Einstein CGB 拓扑量之间有严格余量，而 near-Einstein 补偿仅为
\[
\frac12\int |E|^2=O(\delta^2)V,
\]
则 exact Einstein 非存在会稳定成正的 Ricci-pinching 下界 [Steps 3–4]。固定 blow-up 比率 \(p=k/A\) 时不等式齐次；脚本中曾出现的 \(A^{-1/2}\) 衰减只是整数逼近阈值造成的假象。一个代表性界为
\[
\frac{\delta}{1-\delta}\ge
\sqrt{\frac{p-1/3}{2}},
\]
因此任意固定 \(p>1/3\) 都有与 \(A\) 无关的正间隙 [Steps 3–4,53]。

Step 54 修正了后续表格中的重要混淆：LeBrun 的 exact Einstein 非存在阈值包含等号 \(k\ge A/3\)，所以 \(p=1/3\) 时非存在结论仍成立；消失的是上述稳定 pinching 余量，而不是 LeBrun 非存在本身 [Step 54]。故已知无 Einstein 复曲面族中的真正残余风险集中在 \(p\downarrow1/3\) 的零余量边界、塌缩、尺度逃逸或其他不被稳定积分估计捕捉的机制。

A01/A03 后来尝试用 Ishida–LeBrun、cutoff Ricci flow、DeTurck、critical Moser、terminal density 等跨越该零余量边界。A02 多次审计后撤回“负分支 smoothing 链已完成”的说法：Ricci 流无有限传播，早期 local bootstrap 有 domain mismatch，good-point 小量未覆盖 transition region；相对 Sobolev 常数、buffered support、transported coefficients、Hardy/critical Moser 和 restart 均是负载接口 [Steps 16,21–24,33–45]。Steps 40–45 会话组虽报告 fixed \(J_6\)、一般 \(p\) defect inequality、全阶导数能量和 terminal \(G\)-density 等修复，但 continuation theorem 曾多次撤回，A02 始终未独立接受整条链。

## 四维正 pinching：CGB–Weyl 预算、拓扑筛选与紧致性纠偏 [Steps 3–11, 17–18]

若
\[
\|\operatorname{Ric}-\sigma g\|_{\rm op}\le\delta,\qquad \sigma=\pm1,
\]
四维 CGB 与 Ricci 特征值优化给出
\[
\int |W|^2+\beta(\delta)V\le8\pi^2\chi,
\]
在可用小 \(\delta\) 区间内 \(\beta(\delta)>0\) [Step 4]。正分支还有
\[
\operatorname{Ric}\ge(1-\delta)g,
\]
故由 Myers、Bishop、Bochner 得到直径上界、体积上界、\(b_1=0\) 和有限基本群；更小 \(\delta\) 时由
\[
2\chi\pm3\tau
=\frac1{4\pi^2}\int\left(
2|W^\pm|^2+\frac{s^2}{24}-\frac{|E|^2}{2}
\right)
\]
得到严格 Hitchin–Thorpe [Steps 2,4–5,18]。因此 \(\#_5\mathbb{CP}^2\)、\(\#_4\mathbb{CP}^2\) 等违反或贴近 HT 的流形不能成为 tight positive-pinching 候选；Step 17 曾把它们误说成外部 Einstein 障碍，Step 18 已撤回 [Steps 17–18]。

这些预算不排除塌缩。透镜空间说明有限基本群阶没有维数统一上界；\(b_1=0\) 也不排除有限商塌缩、细颈、注入半径退化、orbifold/ALE 泡或高曲率 cap [Steps 3–5]。正标量曲率使通常 SW/monopole 非存在机制失效，候选逐渐转向
\[
M_k=\#_k(S^2\times S^2)
\]
一类经典拓扑障碍允许但 Einstein 存在性未知的流形 [Steps 8,18]。

Step 5 曾错误地从双侧 Ricci 界、直径界、总体积下界和 \(\delta_i\to0\) 推出统一 harmonic radius、光滑 Einstein 极限与固定微分拓扑。TTCS 指出 \(n\ge4\) 时即使 exact Einstein 序列也可发生 Weyl 集中、orbifold 极限与 ALE 泡；简单光滑紧致性还需全曲率界 [Step 5]。erratum 为 `workspace/notes/step5_erratum_theorem2_correction.md`。研究随后转向 Cheeger–Naber/Naber–Zhang/Ozuch 的弱结构。

一个可复用的条件性有限型结论是：若四维
\[
\|\operatorname{Ric}-g\|_{\rm op}\le\delta<1/2,\qquad
\operatorname{Vol}(M)\ge v>0,
\]
则 Myers 与 Bishop–Gromov 给单位球非塌缩，Cheeger–Naber 给有限微分同胚型 [Step 9]。因此若 \(M_k=\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\) 且 \(k\to\infty\) 存在 tight 正 pinching 序列，其总体积不能有统一正下界；large-\(k\) stress family 的潜在反例必然塌缩 [Steps 9,43–45]。这不解决固定 \(M\) 的非塌缩 bubbling，也不直接产生 Einstein 度量。

## Calderón–Zygmund spike：点态二阶正则化路线的决定性否定 [Steps 11, 30, 33–35, 42, 47]

Step 11 直接构造反例，否定“\(C^0\) Ricci pinching 加小局部 \(L^2\) 曲率可推出点态 \(|\mathrm{Rm}|\) 界”。在 \(S^2(1)\times S^2(1)\) 上取相反 warping
\[
g=dx^2+dy^2+e^{2(F_1+u)}d\theta^2
+e^{2(F_2-u)}d\phi^2,
\]
使 \(\operatorname{Hess}u\) 在 Ricci 基块中抵消，Ricci 主要感知 \(\Delta u\)，而混合 Riemann 分量保留完整 Hessian [Step 11]。选择
\[
w_\sigma(X,Y)=-\frac12XY\log(X^2+Y^2+\sigma^2),
\quad a_j=\Lambda^{-2/3},\quad \sigma_j=e^{-\Lambda},
\]
得到
\[
\|\operatorname{Ric}_{g_j}-g_j\|_{\rm op}
=O(\Lambda^{-2/3})\to0,\qquad
|\operatorname{Rm}_{g_j}|(0)\gtrsim\Lambda^{1/3}\to\infty,
\]
且局部 Hessian/\(\mathrm{Rm}\) 的 \(L^2\) 贡献可以趋零 [Step 11]。记录于 `workspace/notes/step11_cz_spike_and_proposition_A.md`、`workspace/scripts/step11_cz_spike_analytical.py` 及 JSON。

该模型迫使后续 compactness、smoothing 和 projection 使用 harmonic radius、弱型体积估计、有限 \(L^p\)/BMO、相对 Sobolev、cover 非塌缩或能量量子，而不能恢复 pointwise \(C^2\) 控制 [Steps 11,21–24]。spike 否定的是点态曲率 epsilon-regularity，不必否定 almost-volume-cone 上的 \(C^{1,\alpha}\) harmonic-coordinate 控制；其高 Hessian 集中在指数小尺度，\(C^{1,\alpha}\) seminorm 仍可小 [Steps 33,35]。

这一警告后来两次改变 Route A。Step 42 放弃直接取
\[
(\hat g_i-g_{\rm EH})/t_i^2
\]
的 pointwise second-order limit，改用 angular mode 的 metric-value projection与弱 ODE/Wronskian。Step 47 又指出，即使每个 \(g_i\) 光滑，也不能对 projected coefficient 写带统一 pointwise source bound 的二阶径向 ODE；正确方式必须是把线性化 Ricci 配对到 TT/Jacobi 测试场并分部积分，把二阶导数移到测试场上 [Steps 42,47]。

## Torus 约化、rod/corner 方程与 alternating stress family [Steps 12–21, 25–26]

CZ ansatz 导向一般 torus 约化
\[
g=g_B+h_{IJ}(d\phi^I+A^I)(d\phi^J+A^J),\qquad
w=\sqrt{\det h}.
\]
符号 jet 计算给出竖直 trace 方程
\[
\operatorname{tr}_h\operatorname{Ric}^V
=-\frac{\Delta_Bw}{w}+\frac12|F|_h^2,
\]
故 Einstein 情形满足
\[
\left(-\Delta_B+\frac12|F|_h^2\right)w=2\lambda w,
\]
并有 twist 守恒
\[
d(wh_{IJ}*_BF^J)=0
\]
[Step 12]。轨道空间边界上 \(w=0\)、内部 \(w>0\)，形成带非负 twist 势的 Dirichlet ground-state 图景，可用 \(w\) 作 Rayleigh/Barta 测试而无需 \(\nabla E\) [Steps 12–13]。

在无 twist 对角形式
\[
g=g_B+p^2d\theta^2+q^2d\phi^2,\qquad
w=pq,\quad v=\log(p/q),
\]
系统被拆成竖直 trace、竖直差、水平 trace/traceless 方程。研究多次纠正符号：Step 14 混淆 \(\operatorname{Hess}\log(pq)\) 与 \(\operatorname{Hess}p/p+\operatorname{Hess}q/q\)，错误推出 \(K_B\ge3\)；正确关系为
\[
K_B=\frac14\bigl(|\nabla v|^2-|\nabla\log w|^2\bigr)
=-\langle\nabla\log p,\nabla\log q\rangle.
\]
边缘方程为
\[
Q''+(1-2K_B|_{\rm edge})Q=0
\]
[Step 14]。Step 17 撤回在任意轨道曲面使用欧氏 Faber–Krahn。Step 25 进一步校准 individual warping 方程：
\[
-\Delta_Bp=(1-K_B)p,\qquad
-\Delta_Bq=(1-K_B)q,
\]
并撤销 Step 20 的虚假 \(\int K_Bw=\int w\) 约束；Green 配对只给 \(p\)-rod 与 \(q\)-rod flux 等分，不给内部加权曲率下界 [Steps 17,25]。

Step 18 建立周期标签
\[
(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1),\ldots
\]
作用于偶数 \(m=2k+2\) 边形。初始有理 checker 有误，随后改用整数 quasitoric 上同调；脚本验证相邻 determinant、秩 \(m-2\)、unimodularity、偶形式和 signature \(0\)，并将交叉形式整数同余分解为 \(kH\)，支持底层为 \(\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\) [Step 18]。核心文件为 `workspace/scripts/step18_toric_topology_checker_integral.py`、`step18_hyperbolic_split_periodic_labels.py` 及 JSON。

用户要求不得把粗全局 PDE residual 数值趋势当作 BUILD/BREAK；决定性对象应是 rod/corner 与解析匹配 [Steps 18–19]。Step 19 的局部固定点坐标给最低 jets
\[
-6a-4u-1=0,\qquad -6b-4u-1=0,
\quad a=b=-\frac{2A+1}{6},
\]
与 rod Taylor 系数一致；更高阶形式级数到首个非平凡 \(r^2\) 阶仍可对任意 \(A\) 求解。故 unimodularity、right-angle smoothness 或低阶角点 Ricci 代数都不能单独封顶大负边缘曲率 [Step 19]。

Step 21 构造形式 adversary
\[
A_m=m^\alpha,\qquad1<\alpha\le2,
\]
每条 rod 取常负曲率时
\[
Q_i(s)=\frac{\sin(\sqrt{1+2A_m}\,s)}{\sqrt{1+2A_m}},
\quad L_m=\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{1+2A_m}},\quad
\Phi_i=\frac2{1+2A_m}.
\]
总通量 \(\sim m^{1-\alpha}\to0\)，局部角点匹配、signed Gauss–Bonnet 与 Bishop 上界均未产生矛盾 [Steps 19,21]。到 Step 26，rod 恒等式、flux、角点、混合谱和 Gauss–Bonnet 仍与 BREAK-compatible，但没有实际构造出光滑 pinched 度量。

## 高维正 Einstein collapse、Heisenberg 多尺度机制与 almost-Killing 桥 [Steps 24–30, 42–45]

Step 24 检验四维自由圆塌缩障碍能否推广到高维，Kaluza–Klein 计算给出反例。恒长主圆丛中令单位竖直向量 \(U=t^{-1}\xi\)、\(\phi=tF\)，则
\[
\operatorname{Ric}_M^H=\operatorname{Ric}_B-\frac12(\phi\circ\phi),\quad
\operatorname{Ric}_M(U,U)=\frac12|\phi|^2,\quad
\operatorname{Ric}_M^{mix}=\pm\frac12d_B^*\phi.
\]
取
\[
B=S^2_{\operatorname{Ric}=2}\times N^d_{\operatorname{Ric}=1},
\qquad \phi=\sqrt2\,\omega_{S^2},
\]
得到每个 \(n\ge5\) 的精确正 Einstein collapse
\[
L(q,1)\times N^d
\cong(S^3(\sqrt2)/\mathbb Z_q)\times N^d,
\]
纤维长度和体积随 \(q^{-1}\) 衰减而截面曲率有界 [Step 24]。因此正 collapse 不能整体禁止，只能区分 Einstein-compatible 与不兼容的 collapse；四维圆障碍是低维特殊机制。

研究随后转向非阿贝尔 nilpotent fiber。初始 Milnor Ricci 符号似乎暗示正 pinching 会迫使 \(H_3\) bracket 小，但用户指出二基本形式 \(T\) 可补偿。Step 26 建立 cohomogeneity-one 模型
\[
g=dt^2+a(t)^2(\theta_1^2+\theta_2^2)+c(t)^2\theta_3^2,\qquad
[E_1,E_2]=E_3,
\]
定义
\[
b=c/a^2,\quad k_1=a'/a,\quad k_3=c'/c,\quad H=2k_1+k_3,
\]
并推导
\[
\operatorname{Ric}_{00}=-2(k_1'+k_1^2)-(k_3'+k_3^2),
\]
\[
\operatorname{Ric}_{11}=\operatorname{Ric}_{22}
=-\frac{b^2}{2}-k_1'-Hk_1,\qquad
\operatorname{Ric}_{33}=\frac{b^2}{2}-k_3'-Hk_3.
\]
`workspace/scripts/step26_heisenberg_moving_frame_ricci.py` 验证了公式 [Step 26]。

竖直 Ricci 归一为 \(1\) 后，\(00\) 方程给约束
\[
C=4k_1^2+8k_1k_3+b^2+4=0,\qquad C'=-2HC.
\]
样本 \(b_0=20,k_1=10,k_3=-10.05\) 局部积分满足 exact positive Einstein ODE，误差 \(<10^{-12}\)，否定“正 Ricci 点态迫使 bracket 小” [Step 26]。约束面上
\[
|T|^2\ge\frac{b^2+4}{2},\qquad
|\partial_t\log b|^2\ge\frac54(b^2+4),
\]
说明大 bracket 必伴随 \(|T|\sim b\) 与快速相对尺度变化。Step 27 恢复任意 \(\Lambda\)：
\[
C_\Lambda=b^2+4k_1^2+8k_1k_3+4\Lambda=0,
\]
并得相应 pinched 速率界。正 \(\Lambda\) 时 \(b\) 在 regular 区间无临界点，闭圆轨道或普通 smooth endpoints 无法闭合；负 Einstein 的 \(\mathbb{CH}^2\) horosphere 数据则允许 plateau [Step 27]。此结果只覆盖四维对角、无 twist、一维 base、普通端点 ansatz。

Step 28 将 H3 ODE 提升为 ansatz-free 的 Killing 中心 Bochner 界。闭流形上 Killing 场 \(Z\) 满足
\[
\int|\nabla Z|^2=\int\operatorname{Ric}(Z,Z)
\le(\Lambda+\delta)\int|Z|^2.
\]
若 \(Z\) 是 nilpotent fiber 中心方向，fiber geometry 给
\[
|\nabla^FZ|^2=\frac{b^2}{2}|Z|^2,
\]
故
\[
\langle b^2\rangle_{|Z|^2}\le2(\Lambda+\delta)
\]
[Step 28]。TTCS 随即纠正：闭流形 compact Lie algebra 不含非阿贝尔 nilpotent 等距子代数，可用的是中心圆 Killing 作用，而非完整 Heisenberg 等距作用；但四维 nilpotent fiber 维数至多三，非阿贝尔情形只有 \(H_3\)，所有 bracket 落在中心，因此若能获得尺度正确的中心 exact/almost-Killing 场，中心 Bochner 足以控制全部 fiber bracket，无需 quotient induction [Steps 28–29]。

almost-Killing 恒等式被修正为
\[
\int|\nabla Z|^2
=\int\operatorname{Ric}(Z,Z)
+\frac12\int|\sigma|^2-\frac14\int(\operatorname{tr}\sigma)^2.
\]
真正缺口是从 Ricci-only collapse 构造长度可比、Lie derivative 足够小的中心 almost-Killing 场。Cheeger–Fukaya–Gromov 需要全曲率界，Kapovitch–Wilking/Naber–Zhang 给短环群几乎幂零性但不给 invariant metric 或 \(L_Zg\) 控制 [Steps 28–30]。Step 30 的变分 almost-Killing/conformal-Killing 思路也未闭合；平锥上的 \(r\partial_r\) 是 conformal Killing，警告不能未经模型分析使用普通 Killing 能量。此桥自 Step 29 后没有实质突破，故正塌缩仍是 \(P_4^+\) 的核心未解部分 [Steps 30,42–54]。

已形式化的局部文件为 `workspace/proofs/Step27H3Algebra.lean`、`Step28BochnerKilling.lean`、`Step29TwistSpikeAlgebra.lean`；只覆盖代数核，不覆盖 collapse 几何 [Steps 27–29]。

## 正塌缩 toric 前线的 Schwarzschild/Weyl 实验与降级 [Steps 34–42]

Step 34 在 toric \(\alpha\)-family 中识别局部 bolt 尺度：每条 rod 近似二维球面，\(K_\Sigma=1+2A\)、面积 \(\sim2\pi/A\)、横向 collar width \(\sim A^{-1/2}\)，形式能量约 \(8\pi^2\) 每 rod。按 \(\sqrt{2A}\) rescale，Kottler 质量趋于 \(1/2\)，cosmological term 消失，局部趋向 Euclidean Schwarzschild，而非 ASD/ALE [Step 34]。Step 35 又纠正“孤立 Schwarzschild bubble”：rescaled rod spacing 保持有限，相邻 rods/nuts 不消失，极限应是 infinite/periodic toric Ricci-flat rod chain，类似 generalized Weyl/Israel–Khan [Step 35]。

Step 36 正确指出 Atiyah–LeBrun edge-cone defect 是 singular limit 的独立项，不能当作 smooth bulk \(\int|W|^2\) 的额外能量；但随后又错误地由 alternating labels 的相邻 basis 性推出 principal family 没有 strut。Step 37 根据用户纠正：strut/conical deficit 位于 rod 上，是同一 collapsing circle 在不同 rods 上所要求的全局 period/surface-gravity 不一致；相邻 rods collapse 不同 circles 并不消除缺陷。标签 \(v\) 与 \(-v\) 生成同一 subgroup，因此 alternating pattern 有大量非相邻 same-circle period conditions [Steps 36–37]。

非紧 Weyl line-source probes 在有限 alternating chains 上发现 period mismatch，随后 Step 38 识别为精确乘积
\[
\prod_{k=1}^{n-1}\frac{2k+1}{2k},
\]
且 symmetric truncation 表明它是 finite-chain end effect；具有 \(\mathbb R^4\) asymptotics 的 finite Ricci-flat chain 若完全 period-matched 又会受 positive mass 限制 [Steps 37–38]。但 Step 39 用 Page、CLW 和 toric Kähler–Einstein 例校准后，撤回“noncompact finite-chain mismatch 推出 compact obstruction”：这些 compact Einstein 例有 repeated circle classes 且 periods 完全匹配。Step 15/17 的 \(\mu=1\iff A=0\) 只属于 separated cohomogeneity-one SdS ansatz，不能推广成一般 toric 两-rod theorem [Steps 39–41]。

Step 40 借 Liu 结构事实重构 diagonal sector：固定 lattice basis 的 diagonal fiber metric
\[
h(v,v)=a^2p^2+b^2q^2
\]
沿 codimension-2 rod 消失只允许 \(v=\pm e_1,\pm e_2\)，否则 \(p=q=0\) 是 corner。Liu 的 exact Einstein \(T^2\)-manifold 结果说明 twist-free diagonal reduction覆盖 alternating two-unoriented-circle sector；Page/CLW/dP3 有三种以上 circle classes，属于 non-diagonal sector [Steps 40–41]。子问题变为是否存在 \(m\ge6\) 的 diagonal \(T^2\)-invariant positive Einstein metric，即 \(\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\), \(k\ge2\) 上的 diagonal Einstein metric。

Liu 方法显示固定 orbit metric 后还需同时满足 orbit-volume eigenfunction、线性 \(g^\Omega\) 方程、非线性
\[
\det(g^\Omega)=\phi^2,
\]
水平 Einstein、正定性、corner 与 slope 条件。Step 40 的“三约束对一函数”与 product-rigidity 线性化不是证明；Step 41 重算发现原线性化方程错误。constant-curvature regular polygon FEM 的早期 “68.7% hexagon gap”也被修正为约 \(1.84\%\) 的 restricted-model near miss：
\[
\mu_6\approx6.973,\quad A_{\rm eig}\approx0.2868,\quad
A_{\rm side}\approx0.2710.
\]
这不足以排除 variable curvature 或非规则 polygon [Steps 40–41]。由于即使无 diagonal Einstein 也不能排除底层存在非对称 Einstein，更不能决定是否有 collapsing pinched metrics，该路线在 Step 41–42 被降为 symmetry-restricted laboratory。其有用遗产是 rod/corner、period transport 和完整 variable-curvature compatibility map，而不是 compact obstruction theorem。

## 四维正非塌缩 Route A：从 EH obstruction 到一般 ADE 表示论 [Steps 30–47]

若四维正 pinching 序列非塌缩，且 GH 极限没有 codimension-4 奇点，Cheeger–Naber 的 \(C^{1,\alpha}\cap W^{2,q}\) 收敛、弱 Ricci 方程和 elliptic regularity 可给 smooth exact Einstein 极限，并通过 diffeomorphism recovery 将 Einstein 度量放回原流形 [Step 30]。因此 regular noncollapsed alternative 不需 deformation theory；真正剩余的是 bubbling。

读取 Ozuch 的 Einstein degeneration 文献后，确认 Eguchi–Hanson 第一障碍来自 Taub/Pohozaev/Wronskian 守恒量。Orbifold 展开
\[
g_o=e+H_2+O(r^3)
\]
与 ALE 展开
\[
g_b=e+H^4+O(r^{-5})
\]
的边界配对在 exact Einstein degeneration 中必须消失。EH 情形写成向量条件
\[
R_\pm(p)\zeta^\pm=0,\qquad
R_\pm=W_\pm+\frac{\Lambda}{3}\operatorname{Id},
\]
而不是仅写 \(\det R_\pm=0\)；后者只是允许自由改变 \(\zeta\) 后的存在条件 [Steps 30–31,43]。Step 31 的谱脚本校准圆 \(S^4\) 有 \(\det R_+=1/27\ne0\)，Kähler–Einstein 例在 Kähler chirality 上有 kernel。

研究逐步把 obstruction transfer 重写成平衡 annulus/mode projection。orbifold \(l=2\) 模式 \(H_2\sim r^2\)，尺度 \(t\) 的 ALE 模式 \(t^4H^4\sim t^4r^{-4}\)，Wronskian signal 为 \(t^4\)，在 \(r=t^{2/3}\) 大小相当 [Steps 32–34]。但平衡半径不是必须固定；真正重要的是存在足够长的 usable annulus window。Step 34 曾因径向 ODE 常源产生 \(\log\) 而误以为需要 \(\delta\log(1/t)\to0\)。Steps 35–36 根据用户纠正改为 bubble frame 固定 \(1\le\rho\le R\)，先固定 \(R\)、令 \(\delta_i\to0\)，再令 \(R\to\infty\)，不需任何 \(\delta\)-\(t\) rate [Steps 35–36]。

flat cone \(\mathbb R^4/\{\pm1\}\) 上 Bianchi/TT probe 给齐次 rates \(l\) 与 \(-l-2\)；parity 排除 \(l=1\)，首个非 gauge even regular mode 是 \(l=2\)，对偶 decaying mode 为 \(-4\)，正对应 EH coefficient。Wronskian mode-diagonal，使较大的 \(l=0\) mode 不污染 \(l=2\) pairing [Steps 33–34]。Step 42 放弃 pointwise \(C^2\) blow-up，改用三个 EH obstruction/Jacobi tensor modes 的 angular metric projection和弱 Pohozaev 配对。

Step 43 的 chirality 分析修正了 Step 42 “KE 使第一障碍失效”的过强结论。正 Kähler–Einstein 四流形在 complex orientation 上
\[
W_+=\operatorname{diag}(2\Lambda/3,-\Lambda/3,-\Lambda/3),
\quad
R_+=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0).
\]
Kähler form 只 pin 住 self-dual block；reversed EH 测试未受 Kähler 结构约束的 \(R_-\)。纯 EH splitting 中 compatible resolution class 增加 \(b_-\)，reversed class 增加 \(b_+\)。若 KE orbifold 有 \(b_+=1\)，而目标 \(\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\) 有 \(b_+=k\)，拓扑要求 compactly supported positive rank，故会逼出 reversed bubbles 和 \(R_-\)-kernel 条件 [Step 43]。但有限点谱退化不能触发全局 Derdziński 分类，且一般 ALE tree 必须用 compactly supported intersection rank 而非逐个 EH 计数。

Step 46 按用户要求把 scope 从 \(A_1\)/EH 扩到 Kleinian ADE。脚本 `workspace/scripts/step46_gamma_invariant_l2_modes.py` 对 spin-2 representation 限制到 ADE rotation groups 作 character 计算：A、D 型保留非零 invariant \(l=2\) modes；E\(_6\), E\(_7\), E\(_8\) 的相关 self-dual spin-2 invariant 空间为空 [Step 46]。同一步分析 annulus window，得到大致
\[
t\ll r\ll\min(t^{1/2},t^{2/3}\delta^{-1/6}),
\]
约有 \(\frac12\log_2(1/t)\) 个 dyadic scales，可结合 weak-type harmonic-radius estimate 选择好环；但 chart patching、坏集 cutoff 和 projection 仍未证明 [Step 46]。

Step 47 指出 Step 46 只用了表示论的一半：orbifold 固定点的曲率块本身也是 \(\Gamma\)-不变的，
\[
W^\pm(p)\in\operatorname{Sym}^2_0(\mathbb R^3)^{\Gamma/\{\pm1\}}.
\]
`workspace/scripts/step47_curvature_invariant_degeneracy.py` 解出 invariant linear equations。A\(_1\) 是相关 block 完全不受约束的主要类型；A\(_k\), \(k\ge2\)，和 D 型将 \(\det R=0\) 压缩为适应坐标下的一两个显式标量方程；E 型相关 block 上 \(W=0\)，故正 \(\Lambda\) 时
\[
R=(\Lambda/3)I
\]
不可退化 [Step 47]。这撤销 Step 46 把 E 型 compatible bubbles 视为第二 exceptional locus 的表述。加减标签可能随 orientation convention 交换，但 invariant 结论不变。

同一步删除了“Kähler generic”语言。紧致性序列给定的是固定 orbifold、固定奇点和固定 bubble direction，没有概率或 family genericity。正确结论是有限维 dichotomy：若所有拓扑所需的 reversed directions 都有 \(R_-(p)\zeta\ne0\)，则它们被一阶阻碍；若某方向满足 \(R_-(p)\zeta=0\)，则固定极限落在必须具体分类的退化 locus。不能由“通常 \(\det R_-\ne0\)”直接排除 \(\#_k(S^2\times S^2)\) [Steps 46–47]。

## H4 从点态 ODE 到归一化 Jacobi 通量：必要性桥仍未闭合 [Steps 47–49]

Step 47 首先把 H4 从不安全的 pointwise radial ODE 改为 dual TT pairing：取 cone annulus 上的 \(\Gamma\)-invariant \(l=2\) TT harmonic \(Y\)，将 Ricci defect 与测试张量配对，并把线性化 Ricci 的二阶导数分部积分到测试场上，以避免 Step 11 禁止的统一二阶 metric 控制 [Step 47]。

用户随后指出，仅取 annulus 内两端截断的 compactly supported TT test tensor 会得到近乎恒等的两-mode 关系，不能读出 obstruction。Ozuch/Biquard obstruction 的本质是：测试场应为 bubble 上光滑于核心、在无穷远衰减的 obstruction Jacobi field \(o_k\)，只在外端 \(\rho=R\) cutoff。内端无边界项，外端 flux 读取 ambient quadratic coefficient 与 \(\zeta\) 的配对 [Step 48]。若 \(|o_k|\sim\rho^{-4}\)，bubble-frame Ricci defect 为 \(O(t\delta)\) 或按相应尺度记号的同阶量，积分误差增长至多对数；固定 \(R\)、令 \(\delta_i\to0\)，再令 \(R\to\infty\) 可避免 rate 条件 [Step 48]。

Step 49 又纠正：未归一化的边界泛函因 \(h_i\to0\) 只会平凡趋零。signal 与 ambient quadratic perturbation 同为 metric scale \(t=\epsilon^2\) 阶，故必须研究
\[
\mathcal B_k(R,i)/t_i
\]
或等价的 \(\epsilon_i^{-2}\) 归一化。cutoff commutator 也是 signal 同阶的一部分，不能粗略丢弃。真正缺口是 quantitative two-scale matching：从 Cheeger–Naber 仅有的 \(h_i=o(1)\) 弱收敛，推出
\[
t_i^{-1}h_i\to H_2
\]
并识别归一化外端 Wronskian 为
\[
c\langle R_\pm(p)\zeta,\zeta_{(k)}\rangle.
\]
这远强于普通 \(C^{1,\alpha}\) cone convergence，至今没有证明 [Step 49]。因此“任意 \(C^0\)-Ricci-pinched degeneration 必满足向量第一障碍”仍是开放的 necessity theorem；它不是已接近闭合的标准 Cheeger–Naber 后果。

---

## Bi-Kähler product quotient：从 exceptional probe 到正分支 hardness wall [Steps 44–51]

Step 44 检验具体 bi-Kähler orbifold
\[
(S^2\times S^2)/\langle\sigma\rangle,\qquad
\sigma(x,y)=(a(x),a(y)),
\]
其中 \(a\) 为各球面 \(\pi\)-rotation。该作用有四个固定点，局部线性作用为 \(-I_4\)，故有四个 \(A_1\) singularities。产品 Einstein metric 下降到 orbifold；因 \(S^2\times S^2\) 对两种 orientation 都是 Kähler，
\[
R_+=R_-=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0)
\]
[Step 44]。因此 compatible 与 reversed EH 两种 chirality 都有二维 kernel directions，一阶障碍在适当 \(\zeta\) 上消失。这是第一阶 chirality theorem 必须保留例外的具体模型。

Step 44 最初声称取两 compatible、两 reversed resolutions 自动得到 spin、偶形式 \(3H\)，并把每个 EH 能量误写成 \(8\pi^2\)。Step 45 修复：quotient 的 Satake Euler characteristic 为 \(2\)，regular orbifold 部分贡献 \(16\pi^2\)；每个 \(A_1\)/EH bubble 的能量量子为
\[
8\pi^2\left(\chi(EH)-\frac1{|\Gamma|}\right)
=12\pi^2,
\]
总量
\[
16\pi^2+4\cdot12\pi^2=64\pi^2=8\pi^2\chi.
\]
这只是 CGB 一致性，不是独立的无障碍证据 [Step 45]。若 \(r\) 个 bubbles reversed，则 rational bookkeeping 为
\[
b_+=1+r,\qquad b_-=5-r.
\]
但 orbifold 与 EH pieces 各自 spin 不足以证明 glued resolution spin/even；需检查 \(\mathbb{RP}^3\) 边界上的 spin structures。Freedman 即使适用也只给 homeomorphism，不能给标准 smooth type [Steps 44–45]。

Step 48 计算 product quotient 上所有四点的 \(\zeta\)-realizability：每个 \(R_\pm\) 的 kernel 为二维，因此任意固定 chirality assignment 都可在一阶选择 kernel direction。Step 48 还计算了一个二阶 Ozuch determinant 在 rank-one block 上为零，但 Step 49 根据用户纠正撤销其负载意义：即使二阶障碍非零，它升指标后仍趋零，不会阻止本题的 near-pinched input metrics；第一障碍才是 operator-norm 临界项 [Steps 48–49]。

这一认识改变了研究分配：无需完成 exact Einstein gluing、Fredholm 或隐函数定理，便可沿 Biquard/Ozuch refined approximate metric 直接估计 Ricci-endomorphism defect。采用 length scale \(\epsilon\)、metric scale \(t=\epsilon^2\)，杀掉第一障碍后，EH-frame 余项 \(O(t^2\rho^2)\) 升指标成为 \(O(t\rho^2)\)，核心为 \(O(t)\)，标准过渡区 \(\rho\sim t^{-1/4}\) 为 \(O(t^{1/2})\)；若只引用 Ozuch weighted estimate，可安全写成 \(O(t^{1/2-\beta/4})\)，仍趋零 [Steps 49–50]。第一障碍 \(t\lambda o\) 则仍为 \(O(1)\)，解释了 kernel 条件的必要性。reversed EH 作为无向 Riemannian manifold 与普通 EH 等距/同尺度，其局部 refinement 和误差估计照搬，但 attaching orientation 改变，测试曲率块由 \(R_+\) 换成 \(R_-\)。产品 quotient 两个 block 都是 rank one，故混合 chirality 四泡在局部一阶上可行；不同点在 leading order 不相互作用 [Step 50]。

Step 50 因此把该路线整理为单向 hardness reduction。对每个实际得到的 mixed smooth filling \(M_r\), \(r=1,2,3\)，refined four-EH approximate construction给出
\[
\|\operatorname{Ric}_{g_t}-\Lambda g_t\|_{\rm op}\to0.
\]
其可靠程度依赖于 Ozuch/Biquard 四维 refined estimate 和实际 smooth attaching；原始 Biquard 论文未在 A02 端直接取回，Step 50 通过 Ozuch 对其 Section 14 的引用和内部 construction 固定了 source-safe rate，MV 只作指数校准 [Steps 49–50]。这不是 exact Einstein existence theorem，也不是反例。

Armstrong 型论证与 van Kampen filling picture支持 quotient及 EH 解析后流形简单连通；有理不变量为
\[
\chi=8,\qquad (b_+,b_-)=(1+r,5-r).
\]
Step 50 的一个 toric lattice 初算因在退化全 divisor pairing 中代入 representatives 得到错误 determinant \(-1296\)，已撤回；修正的 all-compatible fan probe给 unimodular odd form、signature \((1,5)\) 和四条 \((-2)\)-曲线。fractional discriminant-glue probe显示 \(r=2\) 在不同 node choice 下 parity 可能不同，强化了“不得未经 Kirby/边界数据宣称 spin 或标准 diffeotype”的结论 [Step 50]。

混合行 \(r=1,2,3\) 是简单连通、带正标量曲率、\(b_+\ge2\)、严格满足 Hitchin–Thorpe 的四流形。PSC 使通常 SW/LeBrun obstruction 消失；研究记录中的已知紧正 Einstein 四流形都满足 \(b_+\le1\)，但这只是现状，不是定理。没有已知存在定理覆盖这些 mixed rows，也没有已知非存在定理排除它们 [Steps 50–51]。因此可银行化的结论只有
\[
P_4^+\Longrightarrow M_r\text{ 承载某个 Einstein 度量},
\qquad r=1,2,3.
\]
它把四维正非塌缩分支的墙定位为“这些 PSC、\(b_+\ge2\) 流形是否承载 Einstein 度量”的开放问题。箭头不可逆；构造既不证明 \(M_r\) Einstein，也不反驳 Yau26 [Steps 50–51]。研究因此停止继续追逐 product quotient 的 spin、\(V_4\) 枚举、高阶 Ozuch 障碍或强行套 SW 障碍，把该 arc 视为已达到当前方法的 ceiling [Step 51]。

## 负 cutoff-flow 链的独立审计、错误发现与后续撤回 [Steps 51–54]

Step 51 按 A02 的交叉核验角色，聚焦 A01/A03 负链唯一负载接口，而不是整条复述。首先核验归一化 cutoff 流
\[
\partial_tg=-2a(\operatorname{Ric}+g)
\]
的 \(L^p\) 曲率反应项。常数缩放测试表明 metric norm variation 给 \(2p\int aF^p\)，volume variation 给 \(-n\int aF^p\)，故系数是
\[
2p-n,
\]
临界 \(p=n/2\) 时消失。A03 Step 51 的最终公式正确，但中间曾把 volume 项写成正号并出现 \(2p+n\)，这些行必须废弃 [Step 51]。

同一步指出 cutoff Hessian source 不能靠“度量等价”推出 \(|\Delta_ga|\) 或 \(|\nabla_g^2a|\) 统一界；建议直接分部积分，用
\[
|\nabla a|^2/a=4|\nabla\chi|^2
\]
把一阶 cutoff 项吸收到 Yang 的 weighted dissipation 中。负载目标被压缩为 A2 simultaneous first-exit preservation：先证明修正后的 critical \(H_2/L^2\) inequality，再检查 \(Q,J_6\) 和 pointwise \(a\mathrm{Rm},aE\) [Step 51]。

Step 52 独立 stress-test 后发现两个更基本问题。第一，在 flat \(T^4\) 上取 \(\chi=(1+\cos x_1)/2\)，归一化固定-cutoff 流从零曲率产生曲率，
\[
\int|\mathrm{Rm}|^2=48\pi^4t^2+O(t^3),
\qquad E'/E\sim2/t.
\]
因此未平移的 critical curvature energy 不可能满足 homogeneous \(E'\le CE\)；空间变化的 cutoff 产生真实 \(g\owedge\nabla^2a\) forcing [Step 52]。但 Steps 53–54 又纠正不能把这过读成“所有 start formulation 都被击破”：A03 的 shifted curvature \(T=\mathrm{Rm}+G\) 正是为吸收这类源项而设计，flat-\(T^4\) 只反驳 unshifted homogeneous closure [Steps 53–54]。

第二，DeTurck pullback 满足
\[
\phi^*(a\hat g)=(a\circ\phi)\phi^*\hat g,
\]
不是 \(a\,\phi^*\hat g\)。普通 DeTurck trick 得到 transported-cutoff flow，而非原 fixed-cutoff geometric flow。正确 repair target 是 metric 与 transported scalar \(\hat a\) 的耦合系统；A03 提出的 triangular/output-velocity iteration在结构上可能可行，但尚无完成的 coupled contraction theorem [Steps 52–54]。A03 Step 53 一度报告 coupled start theorem，Step 54 又自行撤回，因为 frozen input velocity只给 Hölder dependence，需新的 triangular iteration。故 exact fixed-cutoff flow start至 Step 54 仍未证明。

Step 52 还提出 IL family 上 Sobolev-critical product 导致 \(\delta_0\lesssim A^{-1/2}\) 的结构 ceiling，并据此声称流动只能给 per-manifold gap。Step 53 一度把该 ceiling作为重分配依据，因为 Steps 3–4 已在固定 \(p>1/3\) 给更强统一 gap，流动唯一价值是 \(p\downarrow1/3\)。但 A03 message #386 在 Step 54 指出：eligible cores 总体积可与 \(\operatorname{Vol}\sim A\) 同阶，volume-weighted averaging可能抵消全局 \(A\) 因子；此前从局部能量上界反推 Sobolev-energy product 下界也不合法。A02 因此撤回“已证明 \(A^{-1/2}\) 不可能性”的强说法 [Step 54]。当前准确状态是：

- A03 的 dimension-uniform negative gap 未证明；
- A02 也没有证明其因 \(A^{-1/2}\) scaling 必然不可能；
- exact fixed-cutoff start 与 simultaneous first-exit bootstrap仍未完成；
- shifted \(T/U/C\) terminal continuation可以作为独立模块继续研究，但不能替代 start；
- Steps 3–4 的固定 \(p>1/3\) 稳定积分 gap仍是更可靠的已证负结果；
- \(p=1/3\) exact Einstein 非存在成立，但 stable pinching margin为零，仍是主要开放边界 [Steps 52–54]。

## 负 ALE 构造：Burns–Kronheimer 对比、crepant 墙与 smooth-category 修正 [Steps 53–54]

Step 53 把正分支形成的 sign-agnostic 第一障碍机制转向负侧，询问已知 no-Einstein 流形能否通过 Ricci-flat ALE bubbles 获得
\[
\|\operatorname{Ric}+g\|_{\rm op}\to0.
\]
核心观察是局部 topology-change 模型与已知非存在机制之间存在错位。

对 ADE/Kronheimer 型 Ricci-flat ALE bubbles，若负 Kähler–Einstein orbifold 的 Kähler-pinned block满足
\[
R_+=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0)
\]
（复 orientation；符号标签依 convention），compatible hyperkähler bubble direction可落在二维 kernel 中，杀掉 operator-norm 临界第一障碍。高阶障碍对 near-pinching不可见，因此 refined ALE approximate construction在局部上可能运行 [Steps 53–54]。这类 ADE resolution是 crepant，引入 \((-2)\)-曲线而保持 \(c_1^2\)。

相反，LeBrun/Ishida–LeBrun 的无 Einstein margin来自 nonminimal blowups、\((-1)\)-曲线和 \(c_1^2\) deficit。自然局部模型 Burns metric是 scalar-flat Kähler但非 Ricci-flat。Step 53 用 Kähler potential
\[
\phi(s)=s+\log s
\]
计算
\[
\det(g_{i\bar j})=1+\frac1s,
\]
故 Ricci form
\[
-i\partial\bar\partial\log(1+1/s)
\]
非零。缩放 \(t g_{\rm Burns}\) 后，其 Ricci endomorphism以 \(t^{-1}\) 可见，不能隐藏在 \(\|\operatorname{Ric}+g\|_{\rm op}\to0\) 序列中 [Step 53]。这解释了为什么最直接的 blow-up gluing无法同时实现 tight pinching与已知 LeBrun 非存在 topology。

Step 53 最初将此概括为“Ricci-flat ALE pinching自然落在 crepant/Einstein-plausible topology，而已知非存在来自 noncrepant/Burns topology”。用户在 Step 54 指出需更细分：Q-Gorenstein/Milnor-fiber smoothing若得到 ample \(K\) 的平滑输出，Aubin–Yau直接给负 KE，因而对 Yau26 是无害存在例；crepant resolution本身有
\[
K=\pi^*K_{X_0}
\]
nef and big但非 ample，因为 \(K\cdot E=0\) 对 exceptional \((-2)\)-curve。该复结构不承载 Kähler–Einstein metric，但这不等于底层 smooth manifold不承载任何 Einstein metric [Step 54]。

为使讨论非空，Step 54 构造并用 affine Gröbner bases检查一个显式 nodal quintic
\[
F=z^3(x^2+y^2+w^2)+x^5+y^5+w^5+xyw^3=0
\subset\mathbb{CP}^3.
\]
脚本 `workspace/scripts/step54_negative_wall_audit.py` 验证其唯一 projective singularity为 \([0:0:0:1]\)，局部二次型 Hessian非退化，故为 \(A_1\) ordinary double point；quintic canonical model有 \(K=\mathcal O_X(1)\)、\(K^2=5\)，crepant resolution引入 \((-2)\)-曲线并使 \(K\) nef、big但非 ample [Step 54]。

但 A01 message #389 在 Step 54 末指出重要 smooth-category caveat：若 ADE canonical surface存在 global Q-Gorenstein smoothing，并有 simultaneous resolution/Ehresmann bridge，则 crepant resolution的底层 smooth manifold可能与 ample-canonical smooth fiber微分同胚；后者由 Aubin–Yau承载负 KE。这样，即使 central resolved complex structure的 \(K\) 非 ample，底层 smooth manifold仍已知 Einstein。A01 声称其某个 BCGP \(\mathbb Z_4^2\) row通过 reflexive tangent sheaf、\(H^2(T_X^0)=0\)、Lee–Park smoothing和 Ehresmann完成了该桥；A02 在 Step 54 尚未独立读取和核验这些文件，故不能把该特例视为已由 A02 认证，但必须据此收窄负 hardness claim [Step 54]。

因此截至 Step 54，不能银行化
\[
P_4^-\Longrightarrow\text{所有 crepant ADE resolutions 都产生新的开放 Einstein 问题}
\]
这一宽泛说法。正确筛选问题是：哪些局部第一障碍消失的 Ricci-flat ALE/ADE desingularizations，其底层 smooth manifold既未通过 Q-Gorenstein smoothing、simultaneous resolution 或其他机制已知承载 Einstein metric，也未被 LeBrun/SW/HT 排除？显式 nodal quintic很可能可由普通 smoothing变成 ample-canonical KE surface，是否与其 minimal resolution同 smooth type需按上述桥独立检查 [Step 54]。

同样，Step 54 未能取得用户建议的 Nakajima、Šuvaina、Lock–Viaclovsky 原始分类来源；两次 knowledge retrieval均误返其他对象。因此“所有 \(\Gamma\not\subset SU(2)\) 的 Ricci-flat ALE都落入 Q-Gorenstein/Milnor-fiber分类”没有在 A02 端建立。非-Kähler Ricci-flat ALE、一般有限 \(\Gamma\subset SO(4)\)、AC 而非 ALE degeneration，以及负塌缩/直径逃逸仍是真实漏洞 [Steps 53–54]。

## 高维 codimension-four stratum probe：从积分障碍转为 obstruction bundle [Steps 46, 53–54]

Step 46 曾提出把四维 isolated ALE bubble 的 mode/Wronskian 推广到 \(n\ge5\) 的 codimension-four singular stratum：四维 ALE作为法向横截面，沿 stratum积分 obstruction。Step 53 进行了有界 probe，结论是否定 naive integral cancellation而不是建立新 theorem [Step 53]。

因为 Yau26 使用逐点 operator norm，若 stratum上任一点的第一障碍系数非零，对应 ALE core就出现 \(O(1)\) Ricci-endomorphism defect；沿 stratum积分相消不能补救。若该思想有内容，正确对象应是一个沿奇异 stratum 的 obstruction bundle：法向曲率块
\[
R_{\mathrm{normal},\pm}(y)
\]
作用于 ALE/kernel parameter section \(\zeta(y)\)，满足逐点或椭圆型条件，并包含 normal connection和 tangential derivative项 [Step 53]。warped-product toy calculation还说明，fiber parameter沿 stratum有 \(O(1)\) 切向变化时，即使fiber metric很小，也会产生不可忽略曲率；\(\zeta\)需要平行或足够慢变。

Cheeger–Naber bounded-Ricci stratification和slicing提供codimension-four结构背景，但不自动给ALE bundle theorem、parameter regularity或collapse情形。四维 isolated H4-dual necessity bridge本身尚未闭合，因此Step 54决定将高维方向保留为有限结论，而不扩张为下一条多步计划 [Steps 53–54]。
