二维由一致化定理解决；三维可用正 Ricci 流/几何化处理正、负分支，但均尚未忠实 Lean 形式化 [Steps 1,5,70–71]。四维跨零、半闭及边界区间已排除：\(S^1\times S^3\) 的 flat\(\times\)round 度量可缩放进入非负区间且不承载 Einstein；Lohkamp 使任意闭 \(n\ge3\) 流形进入任意负半闭区间 [Step 84]。因此四维只能继续研究严格正、严格负两腿。Step 85 提炼出全维必要条件：若某 \(n\ge3\) 维命题为假，必须有一个不承载任何符号 Einstein 度量的闭流形；这只是必要证书，不是等价命题。当前仍无 \(n\ge5\) 的具体 all-sign reservoir [Step 85]。

**[负分支：从局部泡、LeBrun 障碍到 diffuse connector] [Steps 1–4, 22–24, 32, 48–58, 85–93]**  
最初尝试用 Min–Oo 稳定性反驳负近 Einstein，但其额外假设 \(d(g)^2\max|K_g|<\Lambda^2\) 不由 Ricci 双界推出；若无 Einstein 流形上存在 \(\Ric+g_j\to0\)，必经尺度逃逸、曲率集中、塌缩或线性化近核退化。闭双曲流形说明直径控制不能成为一般终点 [Steps 1–2,22]。

orbifold/ALE 解消路线发现第一障碍在未加权 Ricci 算子范数中是临界尺度：EH/Calabi 障碍项 \(t\lambda\chi\) 升指标后仍为阶一非标量 endomorphism；仅有 weighted、\(L^p\)、积分或 GH smallness 不够 [Steps 1–3,32]。Burns \((-1)\)-blowup 的 raised-index Ricci 缺陷发散，排除了该局部 ansatz，但不排除固定流形存在其他 near-negative 度量 [Steps 43,53–54,85–86]。

Step 2 的四维 Einstein CGB/LeBrun 论证曾有错误，Step 3 完整撤回并修正：
\[
8\pi^2(2\chi+3\tau)=4\int|W^+|^2+\frac43\lambda^2V.
\]
用 monopole 类凸包而非单个 blow-up 类可恢复 \(k\ge A/3\) 等阈值。若拓扑积分障碍有严格余量，且 near-Einstein 补偿仅为 \(O(\delta^2)V\)，可得稳定 pinching 下界；边界 \(k/A=1/3\) 仍有 exact Einstein 非存在，但不提供稳定余量 [Steps 3–4,53–54]。正侧 monopole/BF 障碍与正 pinching因 PSC/Weitzenböck 不相容；负侧不能作同样的类层面推论 [Steps 72,86–87]。

最重要的负侧 reservoir 是闭实双曲四流形 \(N\) 的 \(M_N=N\#N\)。Sambusetti–Kotschick 的 degree comparison 给任意 Einstein \(X\to N\) 的
\[
\chi(X)\ge \frac32|\tau(X)|+|d|\chi(N),
\]
而 \(M_N\) 有 \(\chi(M_N)=2\chi(N)-2\)，故不承载任何符号 Einstein [Step 87]。BBCG 再把 Ricci 下界转成体积不等式；正确缩放为 \(\widehat g=(1+\delta/3)g\)，并与 CGB 合并得到仅约 \(3/(4\chi(N))\) 的加性 pinching 下界 [Steps 87–92]。scalar excess 账本表明固定 \(N\) 时缺口必须扩散到体积 \(\Omega(1/\delta)\) 区域；当 \(N\) 变化时误差为 \(O(\delta\chi(N))\)，不能给 dimension-only 障碍 [Step 91]。因此研究判断从“窄 neck 必失败”转为：必须构造或排除沿 essential \(S^3\) 把拓扑改变扩散到巨大体积的 connector。

warped waist 给出 \(\|\Ric+3g\|_{\rm op}\ge3/2\) 的模型下界，free-\(T^2\)、orthogonally transitive connector 还被排除于 \(\delta<0.246249763690668\)，但两者均不覆盖一般 \(S^3\)-seam、非 OT 或 diffuse connector [Steps 88,93]。A03 的后续径向 charged-cap/high-twist 试验和 #681 separator-local escape 只加强了“局部 redshift/cap 不足以完成 connector”的判断；完整负构造仍开放 [Steps 98–100]。

**[Ricci-only 正则性、CZ spike 与紧致性路线的关闭] [Steps 5, 9–11, 30, 33–35, 42, 47, 58–63, 79–80]**  
四维正 pinching可给 Myers、Bishop、Bochner 控制、有限基本群、\(b_1=0\)、Weyl 能量预算和明确 Hitchin–Thorpe 窗口，但 Step 5 曾错误地从 Ricci 双界、直径和体积下界推出 harmonic radius、光滑 Einstein 极限及固定微分拓扑。该推论被撤回：即使 exact Einstein 序列也会发生 Weyl bubbling、orbifold 极限及 ALE 泡 [Step 5]。可保留的是非塌缩情形的有限型/ orbifold 弱紧致性，不能无条件排除 codimension-four 奇点 [Steps 9,30,43–45]。

Step 11 在 \(S^2\times S^2\) 上构造相反 warping，令 trace-free Hessian 在 Ricci 块中抵消而混合 Riemann 保留，得到
\[
\|\Ric_{g_j}-g_j\|_{\rm op}=O(\Lambda^{-2/3})\to0,\qquad
|\Rm_{g_j}|(0)\gtrsim\Lambda^{1/3}\to\infty.
\]
这否定了“\(C^0\) Ricci pinching 加小局部 \(L^2\) 曲率即可得点态全曲率界”的路线，说明 Ricci-only 情形仍有 \(\nabla\Ric\)/Cotton 与 trace-free Hessian 通道 [Step 11,58]。由此 H4 从点态泡极限转为弱 TT pairing；同时确认 \(\delta\log(1/t)\) 是 neck 共振尺度 [Steps 42,47,59–63]。

高维 transition-scale 方案只能把塌缩序列放大到 RCD\((0,n)\) 极限；称其为光滑 Ricci-flat ALE 仍需额外正则性。四维 CGB 可限制部分 hyper-Kähler ADE 泡，但 class-T、generic holonomy、内部 orbifold 奇点及固定体积 mixed-row degeneration 仍开放 [Steps 79–80]。almost-Killing/CFG 路线也失败于缺少全曲率控制和尺度正确的 \(L_Zg\) 小性 [Steps 28–30]。

**[Torus/rod/对称实验室及其降级] [Steps 12–21, 25–26, 34–42, 58]**  
一般 torus 约化给出
\[
g=g_B+h_{IJ}(d\phi^I+A^I)(d\phi^J+A^J),\qquad w=\sqrt{\det h},
\]
以及竖直 trace 方程、twist 守恒；无 twist 对角情形经修正为
\[
K_B=\tfrac14(|\nabla v|^2-|\nabla\log w|^2),\qquad
-\Delta_Bp=(1-K_B)p.
\]
rod 标签脚本支持部分多边形作用的交叉形式为 \(kH\)，但 corner jets、周期闭合、Gauss–Bonnet 和无 strut 条件从未形成真正闭 smooth pinched 度量。大 rod collar 被纠正为 periodic/infinite Weyl rod chain；alternating labels 自动无 strut、孤立 Schwarzschild bubble 和非紧 period matching 的早期故事均撤回 [Steps 18–21,34–41]。该线保留为研究 period transport、rod/corner、ALF/Schwarzschild 外层模型和对称数值实验室，不再作为主证明路线。

**[四维 EH/ALE 障碍、fixed-resolution construction 与 product mirrors] [Steps 30–50, 57, 64–69, 75–84, 89–93]**  
Ozuch/Biquard 结果确认 EH 第一障碍由 Taub/Pohozaev/Wronskian flux 给出，要求
\[
R_\pm(p)\zeta=0,\qquad R_\pm=W_\pm+\frac{\Lambda}{3}I,
\]
而不只是 \(\det R_\pm=0\)。chirality 多次校准：Kähler–Einstein product 在两种取向下都是 Kähler，故 \(R^+=R^-\) 均为 rank-one block，kernel 是二维平面，不是“某 block 有 kernel”即可自动解消 [Steps 30–31,43,67,93]。TT modes 的首个非 gauge even regular degree 为 \(l=2\)，其 dual 是 EH coefficient；\(\ell=2\) 是未加权 Ricci \(C^0\) 中唯一 logarithmic critical mode，\(\ell>2\) 及高阶 obstruction 低于主缺陷，故 tight pinching不能强迫整个 obstruction tower 消失 [Steps 33–34,46–47,62,69,73–74]。

Step 65–67 排除了 raw EH core、纯共形修正、低维径向 BVP 和不完整 U(2) ansatz：真实 product ambient jet 有五个 mixed angular components，节点 isotropy 仅 \(T^2\)，不能用三函数径向模型 export [Steps 65–67]。随后研究稿给出 \(\mathcal O(-2)\) disk bundle 上显式 biaxial Einstein 族 \(q_\Lambda\)，减去
\[
V=\frac5{72}(r^3-r^{-1})\partial_r
\]
后得到 \(D\Ric_{\rm EH}\widetilde h=g_{\rm EH}\)，并经 `step68_qLambda_core_verify.py` 核验。Step 83 又对完整十维 Weyl basis核查了 trace-free、divergence-free、harmonic、radial gauge 及
\[
D\Ric_e(\eta K)=-\frac{\eta_{tt}+6\eta_t}{2r^2}K.
\]
在共同 radial normal gauge、\(O_2\) ALE tail 和 smooth cutoff 假设下，形成固定 resolution 的条件性构造：
\[
\|\Ric_{g_a}-\sigma g_a\|_{\rm op}\le C/|\log a|.
\]
它覆盖正、负 product mirrors及 hyperbolic A1 orbifolds，但仍是 near-Einstein 构造而非 exact Einstein 存在 [Steps 68–69,83–84,89]。

正 mirror \((S^2\times S^2)/\mathbb Z_2\) 有四个 A1 点；负 mirror \((\Sigma_2\times\Sigma_2)/\mathbb Z_2\) 有 36 个。正 mirror resolution 的 smooth topology row 包括
\[
\CP^2\#5\overline{\CP}^2,\quad
2\CP^2\#4\overline{\CP}^2,\quad
\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\ \text{或}\ 3\CP^2\#3\overline{\CP}^2,\quad
4\CP^2\#2\overline{\CP}^2,
\]
但部分仍需 Kirby/spin 审计 [Steps 57,64,75–76]。mixed rows 单连通、PSC、在两种取向下 non-Kähler/non-symplectic，且有严格正 near-Einstein 家族；这使其成为 \(P_4^+\) 的固定测试族，而不是已认证反例。

现成 no-Einstein 证书与 orbifold construction 结构性错位：正侧 monopole/BF 被 PSC 杀掉；reversed A1 rows 的 \(+2\)-球和 adjunction 只排除已知 BF 数据；orbifold+Ricci-flat ALE 满足 Chern–Weil 中性
\[
\chi-\tfrac32|\tau|\ \text{不下降},
\]
并与 BCG/Sambusetti entropy inequality 相容 [Steps 86–90]。因此这些构造避开了现有 gauge/entropy 证书，但这不证明 mixed rows 承载 Einstein，也不证明其不存在。

**[H4 flux、变分路线和 Green function 路线的限度] [Steps 47–50, 59–80, 84–85]**  
clean annulus 上 TT pairing 给出边界 flux 常数，四维有 \(-3I_K\) 等显式系数；但一般 bubbling transfer 需处理 gauge、outer tail 和 neck resonance。product Green factorization 被否定：算子谱分母是 \((\lambda_1+\lambda_2+\text{shift})^{-1}\)，不是两个静态 Green 分母乘积；必须处理 TT negative mode、scalar zero modes、Bianchi slice 和 positive spectrum [Steps 47–49,76]。mixed receiver block 的局部阶数为 \(t_jt_i^2\)，等尺度 \(O(t^3)\)，低于当时 \(O(t^{5/2})\) remainder，因此早期直接算 \(\mu_2,\mu_3\) 不具判决力 [Steps 77–80]。

四维 scale-invariant functional
\[
F(g)=\int(|W|^2+s^2/24)\,d\mu
=8\pi^2\chi+\tfrac12\int|E|^2
\]
在 near-pinched fixed rows 上达到拓扑下确界的极限，但 log-Weyl 家族是非紧 minimizing sequence；所有固定 \(L^p,p\ge2\) defect因支撑体积而消失，不能提供 coercive gap或保证 attainment [Steps 84–85]。因此直接变分法、\(L^p\) residual 和简单 Palais–Smale 路线已关闭，除非补充真正的紧致性机制。

**[Step 94–100：正 mirror obstruction program 的连续修复与推进]**

**[三门框架与 Gate 1 修复] [Steps 94–96]**  
Step 94 将 mixed-chirality 计算组织为三个顺序门：先局部 \(O(t^2)\) 项，再相对 remainder，最后才算 \(O(t^3)\) pair coefficient。最初用 SO(2) transitivity 证明 \(\Pi_K\mu=0\) 是错误的：这是 equivariant map \(K\to K\)，如 \(z\mapsto f(|z|)z\) 并不因旋转而消失。Step 95 用节点同时固定的 \(T^2=SO(2)_A\times SO(2)_B\) 及 \(\beta=0\) weight-one subcircle 修复：二次 homogeneous map 需满足 \(a+b=2,\ a-b=1\)，无整数解。更深层原因是 product curvature \(R^\pm=\diag(\Lambda,0,0)\) 的二维 kernel：\(\zeta\) 消耗一个 kernel 方向后，互补 \(2\times2\) block仍含另一 kernel 方向，故 \(\det R_\perp=0\)；一般一维 kernel 的 \(\det R=0\) orbifold没有此保护 [Steps 94–96]。

节点权重必须带 pole signs：
\[
\theta_j=s_A^j\alpha+\epsilon_js_B^j\beta,\qquad
\sigma_j=\epsilon_js_A^js_B^j.
\]
因此 anisotropic pair 条件由 \(\sigma_i=\sigma_j\) 决定，不能简单按 chirality 匹配。早期“opposite 必 isotropic、same 必 anisotropic”撤回。兼容 pattern 有 \(\sigma=(+,-,-,+)\)，diagonal balanced 全同号，adjacent balanced 有另一种交换结构 [Steps 95–96]。

**[变分重构与 calibration 限制] [Steps 97–98]**  
Step 97 把 projected obstruction 重写为真正的有限维变分问题：在合适 fixed-volume、Bianchi/Ebin slice、automorphism quotient 和 complement 解消下，Einstein 方程应是 reduced Einstein–Hilbert/normalized scalar curvature potential 的梯度。四次项示意为
\[
f_4=\sum_{i<j}c_{ij}|\xi_i|^2|\xi_j|^2+
\Re(q_{ij}\xi_i^2\bar\xi_j^2)+\cdots,
\]
要求 \(c_{ij}\) 实且对称、\(q_{ji}=\bar q_{ij}\)（经 frame transport），Euler 齐次性要求非零临界点满足 \(f_4=0\)。因此旧的单节点 \(|q_{\rm diag}|\) 对 \(|2q_{\rm adj}+q_{\rm diag}|\) 以及“\(|Q|>|P|\) 会有 kernel”的说法均撤回；\(Pz+Q\bar z\) 有非零 kernel 当且仅当 \(|P|=|Q|\)，两种严格不等式都可逆。`Step99RealLinearPQ.lean` 已内核核验这一有限维事实 [Steps 97,99]。

OSS/degree-4 del Pezzo资料及 Biquard–Rollin period geometry支持：四 A1 product quotient 是 KE moduli boundary，平滑 compatible smoothing 的 vanishing-cycle periods 落在 \(K=\omega^\perp=\ker R^\pm\)，而 resolution 的 holomorphic \(\omega\)-方向被排除。TTCS 同时警告：KE locus 上有零梯度并不自动推出每个 partial sector coefficient individually zero，除非有真正的开集、完整 LS 坐标和所有 complement/global/frame 项。故“兼容 pattern 的 full reduced potential 在适当坐标中受 KE locus calibration”可保留；partial raw sector 不能单独作结论 [Steps 97–98]。

**[Step 99：A01 数据的独立复核与 trace/traceless 分离] [Step 99]**  
A02 独立运行 `step99_a01_trace_obstruction_audit.py` 和 `step99_selected_spectral_recompute.py`，在四个 convergence rungs 上重算 A01 的 chirality maps。结果确认：AB 及 AA/BB tensor sectors 的 physical same-chirality maps \(B_{++}=B_{--}=0\)，cross-parity 消失，cross-chirality 对称；选定数据与 A01 存档完全一致。旧数值 \(-0.03144,+0.01773\) 只是 parity components，不是 physical same-chirality coefficient。

在 NN receiver 的 physical cross-chirality table中，AB 是 trace/isotropic：
- adjacent trace coefficient \(0.12576998928\)，即 isotropic eigen coefficient \(c_a=0.06288499464\)；
- diagonal trace coefficient \(-0.070907042884\)，即 \(c_d=-0.035453521442\)。

AA/BB tensor sectors 是 traceless；adjacent coefficient幅值
\[
q_a=0.0080049973185,
\]
而 diagonal tensor coefficient当时尚未有存档。由此：
- diagonal balanced pattern 的 leading matrix 为
  \[
  c_a(u_1+u_2)I+T,\qquad
  \|T\|\le q_a(u_1+u_2),
  \]
  margin \(c_a-q_a=0.0548799973215>0\)，对任意正 scale squares和 phases均正定于 raw inter-node order；
- adjacent balanced pattern 初看有 \(P=c_au_{\rm adj}+c_du_{\rm diag}\) 的 scale-ratio window，因此不能仅凭单节点方程判断；
- \(r=1,3\) pattern 因存在只接收 adjacent opposite source 的节点，若 \(c_a>q_a\) 则直接排除 raw leading kernel [Step 99]。

这些仍不是 local theorem：原始 remainder 是 \(O(t^{5/2})\)，大于 \(O(t^3)\) 主项；还需完整 LS slice、self/complement Schur、frame/projector motion、global \(\nu_l\) deformation及 relative \(o(t^3)\)（含可能 \(t^3\log t\)）估计。

**[Step 100：四节点 closure 与 diagonal tensor structural vanishing] [Step 100]**  
Step 100 处理了 adjacent balanced 的四节点耦合，而非继续使用单节点窗口。两正节点对两个负节点的 adjacent/diagonal角色互换；令 \(x=u_4/u_3\)，两个节点的约束互为 \(x\leftrightarrow1/x\)。因此全系统有解的必要窗口退化为 \(x=1\) 是否可行：
\[
|c_a+c_d|\le q_a+q_d.
\]
数值上需
\[
0.027431473198\lesssim 0.0080049973185+q_d,
\]
即 \(q_d\gtrsim0.01943\)。

随后调用 A01 已有 `compute_full_chirality` 框架，补算 diagonal \(SS\) source。四个 \((\tau,L_{\max})\) rung 上 AA/BB tensor cross-chirality response均为零。提出的结构机制是 antipodal pole 的 \(c_2/s_2\) tensor modes 符号相反：\(c_2\) 比例为 \((-1)^\ell\)，\(s_2\) 为 \(-(-1)^\ell\)，且 SO(2) kernel symmetry保证幅值相等，故每个谱模逐项抵消；adjacent pair因一因子 pole匹配则增强。由此 \(q_d=0\) 的计算证据使 adjacent-balanced 的阈值失败，Step 100 将正 mirror 五个 mixed chirality patterns 都判为“leading inter-node order obstructed” [Step 100]。

这一结论目前应保持为**经过独立谱重算的 leading-order obstruction candidate/结构性谱恒等式**，不是完整局部定理。仍需确认：  
1. diagonal cancellation是否确实属于完整 Einstein linearization，而非当前 heat-regularized/spectral model；  
2. self-interaction、complement Schur、frame/projector、global deformation 是否在 trace channel pattern-independent或不能抵消正 margin；  
3. 如何把 Ozuch Prop. 3.14/Cor. 3.25 型高阶展开改造成相对 \(o(t^3)\) 估计；  
4. 即使 local branch 被排除，仍不能推出 \(\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\) 或 \(3\CP^2\#3\overline{\CP}^2\) 没有远离该 degeneration 的 Einstein 度量，更不能单独反驳 \(P_4^+\)。

**[高维方法判断与 Lean 状态] [Steps 24, 73–80, 94–100]**  
Step 94–96 提出并修正了高维方法结构判断：正 Einstein 若 \(\Ric\ge0\)，可用 Gromov simplicial-volume estimate
\[
\|M\|\le C(n)\Vol(M,g)\quad\text{在 }\Ric_g\ge-(n-1)g
\]
并缩放 \(\varepsilon^2g\) 迫使 \(\|M\|=0\)，故 positive simplicial volume 排除非负 Einstein；但四维负 Einstein 障碍依赖 CGB 的 \(|W|^2+\lambda^2V\) 结构或 \(\Lambda^2=\Lambda^+\oplus\Lambda^-\)，这些机制不直接延续到 \(n\ge5\)。偶数高维 Pfaffian含不定交叉项，奇维无相应 CGB 体积上界。因此 \(n\ge5\) 的空白是方法性缺口，不是命题真假的证据 [Steps 94–96]。

Lean 方面，早期资产仅覆盖 Heisenberg、Bochner、twist、flux 等代数；命名几何公理壳不能冒充真实几何证明 [Steps 27–29,69–74]。`MetricScalingNormalization.lean` 已无 placeholder、无额外公理地形式化 metric scaling、Ricci \((0,2)\)-tensor不变性及区间 normalization，但没有 Levi–Civita/Riemann/Ricci 几何栈 [Steps 86,88]。Step 99 的 `Step99RealLinearPQ.lean` 及其 dependency check 进一步可靠地形式化有限维 \(Pz+Q\bar z\) 核判据，仅依赖允许的 Mathlib axioms；Step 100 的四节点交换闭包也属于可独立形式化的纯代数/组合层。完整 curvature、gluing、低维经典定理和 Yau–26 主命题尚未形式化。

**[当前总体状态与未完成连接] [Steps 83–100]**  
研究目前最强的正侧资产是：固定 A1 resolution 的 \(C/|\log a|\) Ricci near-Einstein 构造、product orbifold 的精确 rank-one curvature/kernel 结构、经独立重算的同 chirality 消失和 cross-chirality trace/tensor 表、以及正 mirror 五个 mixed patterns 的 leading obstruction candidate。它们解释了 compatible Kähler smoothing 与 mixed non-Kähler rows 的局部差别，但尚未给 exact Einstein 非存在或存在。

负侧最强资产是 \(N\#N\) 的 all-sign no-Einstein reservoir及其 BCG/CGB diffuse accounting；真正缺口是一般 diffuse \(S^3\)-seam connector或排除它的统一定理。四维完整反驳仍须同时处理正、负严格分支；正 mirror local obstruction不足以完成这一点。\(n\ge5\) 尚无 all-sign reservoir、一般存在机制或 faithful Lean curvature layer。

### Sparse — Step 100 | trajectory | 4039 tokens

### Decisions and Reasons

- The target remains the original all-dimensional Yau–26 statement: for every \(n\ge2\), determine whether dimension-only two-sided Ricci pinching forces the same closed smooth manifold to admit an Einstein metric, or strictly refute the assertion. A proof needs one valid interval in every dimension; a refutation in one dimension must defeat every possible interval, including positive, negative, and crossing-zero branches [Steps 1, 58, 72–74, 83–85].

- The project retained the distinction between the mathematical proposition and the available research routes. Min–Oo, prescribed-Ricci flexibility, compactness, ALE/orbifold gluing, gauge obstructions, toric and nilpotent models, and explicit constructions were explored as tests rather than assumed solutions. Negative near-Einstein stability was restricted by its diameter/full-curvature hypotheses, while positive Ricci pinching was recognized to give Myers, finite \(\pi_1\), \(b_1=0\), and volume control without excluding collapse [Steps 1–24].

- The first ALE gluing counterexample idea was rejected because weak residual norms do not control the raised-index Ricci endomorphism on a scaled core. A first obstruction \(O(t)\) remains order one after raising an index, whereas higher \(O(t^k)\) obstructions are subcritical for \(k\ge2\). This separated the role of first obstructions in near-pinching from their role in exact desingularization [Steps 32, 48–50, 73–74].

- Several initially attractive global shortcuts were explicitly withdrawn: unrestricted smooth compactness under Ricci pinching, no-collapse from positive pinching, simple LeBrun threshold arguments, “nef but not ample implies no Einstein,” and broad toric/nilpotent rigidity claims. Their failure redirected the work toward mode-sensitive bubbling, topology-changing mechanisms, and the distinction between local degeneration results and global Einstein existence [Steps 2–4, 9–30, 54–57].

- The four-dimensional route retained Chern–Gauss–Bonnet, signature, LeBrun-type estimates, and the corrected Biquard–Ozuch first obstruction, but treated them as accounting or local-necessity tools rather than complete contradiction mechanisms. Curvature energy can concentrate in bubbles, rods, bolts, and necks; the corrected LeBrun estimate has a gap only away from its endpoint [Steps 2–4, 14–18, 30–47, 53–54].

- The product-quotient families became the main controlled laboratories. The positive four-node mirror gives smooth rows with types
  \[
  \mathbb{CP}^2\#5\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^{\,2},\quad
  2\mathbb{CP}^2\#4\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^{\,2},\quad
  \#_3(S^2\times S^2)\ \text{or}\ 3\mathbb{CP}^2\#3\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^{\,2},\quad
  4\mathbb{CP}^2\#2\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^{\,2},
  \]
  up to the recorded spin/Kirby convention. The compatible endpoint has Kähler–Einstein desingularizations; mixed rows are non-Kähler and nonsymplectic in both orientations, but no global no-Einstein theorem is known for them [Steps 55–57, 64, 75–83].

- The fixed-\(A_1\) logarithmic construction was upgraded to a theorem-grade near-pinching statement. For a fixed Einstein orbifold, markings, chiralities, gauge conditions, and \(O_2\) control, the resolution carries metrics with
  \[
  \|\operatorname{Ric}_{g_a}-\sigma g_a\|_{\mathrm{op}}
  \le C|\log a|^{-1}.
  \]
  This is sign-neutral and includes non-\(U(2)\) sectors, but it produces near-Einstein metrics only, not exact Einstein metrics [Step 83].

- The local product-orbifold calculation was repeatedly repaired. The product is not conformally flat:
  \[
  R^+=R^-=\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda,0,0),
  \]
  so admissible first-order EH parameters lie in the two-dimensional kernel plane \(K=\operatorname{span}\{e_2,e_3\}\), rather than being selected by a scalar critical scale. The obstruction is therefore a kernel-plane angular response [Steps 92–96].

- The first local quadratic obstruction vanishes by the full \(T^2\) stabilizer and weight parity, not by the earlier invalid claim that no equivariant vector exists in \(K\). Node-dependent pole signs replace chirality-only selection rules. The leading response has the real-linear form
  \[
  z\mapsto Pz+Q\overline z,\qquad
  \ker\ne0\Longleftrightarrow |P|^2=|Q|^2,
  \]
  and common bubble scale cancels. The algebraic kernel criterion was checked in `Step99RealLinearPQ.lean`; it does not formalize the geometry [Steps 94–99].

- The finite-dimensional equations were reinterpreted as the gradient of a reduced quartic Einstein–Hilbert functional on a properly sliced deformation space. This imposes reciprocity, real symmetry, and dependence on both phases and relative scales. The compatible Kähler–Einstein smoothing locus is an essential calibration: in correctly normalized smoothing coordinates the leading reduced potential must vanish on the compatible open locus [Steps 97–99].

- Step 99 initially identified a possible existence window for the adjacent-balanced pattern because one node’s scale ratio could satisfy \(|P|\le |Q|\). The user required imposing all four node equations rather than treating one node as decisive. Step 100 then adopted the exchange-closure argument: the two nodes of a chirality class exchange adjacent and diagonal partners, so the second constraint is the reciprocal of the first. Their intersection is nonempty exactly when the equal-scale point satisfies the inequality [Step 100].

- Step 100 also completed the previously missing diagonal cross-chirality tensor entry. The spectral framework was independently rerun for diagonal source pairs at four convergence rungs; the physical diagonal tensor coefficient is
  \[
  q_{\mathrm{diag}}=0.
  \]
  The recorded mechanism is exact cancellation between antipodal \(c_2\) and \(s_2\) tensor modes: their pole signs are opposite at every angular level, while the \(SO(2)\) kernel-plane symmetry gives equal magnitudes. This is not merely a numerical smallness claim within the checked spectral model, but its promotion to the exact geometric coefficient and its treatment of all boundary/non-spectral terms still require proof [Step 100].

- The adjacent-balanced four-node system now has the necessary condition
  \[
  |c_{\mathrm{adj}}+c_{\mathrm{diag}}|
  \le q_{\mathrm{adj}}+q_{\mathrm{diag}}.
  \]
  With the audited values
  \[
  |c_{\mathrm{adj}}+c_{\mathrm{diag}}|
  =|0.06288499464-0.035453521442|
  \approx0.027431,
  \]
  \[
  q_{\mathrm{adj}}\approx0.0080049973185,\qquad q_{\mathrm{diag}}=0,
  \]
  the condition fails. The other one-/three-reversed patterns already fail because \(c_{\mathrm{adj}}>q_{\mathrm{adj}}\), and the diagonal-balanced pattern has a positive leading margin
  \[
  0.06288499464-0.0080049973185
  =0.0548799973215.
  \]
  Thus all five mixed chirality patterns in the positive four-node mirror are obstructed at leading inter-node order [Step 100].

- This “positive mirror closure” is recorded only at the leading local coefficient level. It does not yet prove that the mixed smooth rows admit no Einstein metric. The result excludes Einstein branches converging through the specified product-orbifold degeneration only after the missing Lyapunov–Schmidt estimate and geometric calibration are completed; it does not rule out distant Einstein metrics [Step 100].

- The decisive analytic gap is now the relative expansion, not another isolated coefficient. The available crude error \(O(t^{5/2})\) dominates the leading \(O(t^3)\) pattern-sensitive term as \(t\to0\). A theorem requires an \(o(t^3)\) relative remainder, including possible \(t^3\log t\) terms, while controlling self-interaction, complement Schur terms, moving frames/projectors, global Einstein deformation variables, normalization, and nonlinear terms. The user explicitly prioritized attacking this estimate directly rather than formulating another inventory of hypotheses [Step 100].

- The positive local result is not to be mistaken for a proof of \(P_4^+\). A complete local obstruction still leaves open the three independent Einstein-sign legs on the mixed rows: excluding \(\lambda>0\), closing the generic Ricci-flat possibility, and excluding \(\lambda<0\). The rows remain strict-Hitchin–Thorpe, simply connected, PSC, and outside the currently known Kähler/monopole mechanisms, but no all-sign global obstruction has been found [Steps 57, 78–84, 100].

- The negative branch remains equally necessary for a dimension-four refutation. Lohkamp makes boundary negative intervals universal after scaling, and \(S^1\times S^3\) defeats crossing-zero and boundary-zero intervals. A strict negative branch can only be refuted using a closed manifold with no Einstein metric of any sign. Sambusetti’s \(N\#N\) hyperbolic connected sums provide such reservoirs, but near-negative pinching would require a diffuse topology-change mechanism spread over volume \(\gtrsim1/\delta\); warped and orthogonally transitive connectors do not cover this case [Steps 84–91, 98–99].

- The negative product mirror remains useful as a companion laboratory. Its compatible rows are negative Kähler–Einstein by Aubin–Yau, while mixed fillings lose the standard Kähler and monopole mechanisms. The same kernel-plane spectral mechanism may apply after sign reversal, but its 36-node combinatorics are substantially richer. The user recorded the negative mirror coefficient table as a possible companion after the positive remainder issue, not as a substitute for the all-sign/global gap [Step 100].

- The all-dimensional program remains unresolved. Dimensions two and three are settled at ordinary theorem level by uniformization, Hamilton, and three-dimensional curvature/geometrization arguments, but none has been faithfully formalized in Lean. In \(n\ge5\), positive simplicial volume excludes nonnegative Einstein metrics, but no dimension-independent negative-branch obstruction or all-sign no-Einstein reservoir has been certified. Codimension-four singular strata, ALF/ALG/ALH bubbles, bubble trees, and diffuse non-OT connectors remain open [Steps 70–74, 85–99].

### Research Line

- The work began by testing whether existing stability or curvature theorems immediately settle a sign branch. Their hypotheses proved too strong or their conclusions too weak. This shifted the central question toward what degenerations are compatible with pointwise Ricci isotropy and whether those degenerations can be converted into either exact Einstein metrics or global counterexamples [Steps 1–30].

- Four-dimensional analysis then became the main laboratory because it combines explicit curvature identities, gauge theory, topology, ALE models, and computable product quotients. The research learned that integrated curvature budgets and standard gauge certificates are largely orthogonal to the pinched classes: positive pinching kills the usual monopole mechanisms, while compatible ALE fillings preserve the relevant Chern–Weil surplus and often land in known Kähler–Einstein classes [Steps 30–59, 86–92].

- The noncollapsed bubbling line developed from first-obstruction scaling and Biquard–Ozuch flux identities. The \(H_4\)-dual calculation identified the quadratic mode as uniquely unweighted log-critical, yielding a sharp \(\delta\log(1/t)\) phenomenon. This clarified both the power and limitation of Ricci pinching: it can detect the first resonant channel but cannot force an entire higher obstruction tower to vanish [Steps 34–50, 59–74].

- The logarithmic resolution construction supplied a robust source of near-pinched metrics on selected smooth rows. It became a stress test for any proposed universal compactness or energy argument, since the \(L^2\) Einstein defect can vanish while the pointwise Ricci-endomorphism defect decays only logarithmically. The construction explains why direct minimization, \(L^p\) compactness, and ordinary Chern–Weil estimates do not settle the proposition [Steps 68–70, 83–85].

- The positive mirror program then moved from topology and broad obstruction searches to an explicitly audited local spectral calculation. The product curvature correction changed the object from a false scalar scale equation to a kernel-plane \(2\times2\) response. \(T^2\) weight parity removed the quadratic obstruction; Biquard–Rollin and OSS/Tian–Yau supplied the compatible smoothing/KE calibration; independent A01 computations verified the physical same-chirality vanishing [Steps 92–99].

- Step 100 completed the leading four-node pattern analysis. The diagonal cross-chirality tensor term was computed as an exact antipodal cancellation in the spectral model, \(q_{\mathrm{diag}}=0\). The adjacent-balanced apparent scale window disappears after imposing the exchanged equation at the second node. Together with the existing margins for the other patterns, this closes every mixed positive-mirror pattern at leading inter-node order [Step 100].

- The interpretation of the coefficient table is now structural rather than merely numerical. Same-chirality terms vanish in agreement with the open compatible Kähler–Einstein smoothing locus; mixed cross-chirality terms survive precisely where Kähler and symplectic structures are lost. This provides a coherent explanation of the KE/non-KE dichotomy, but it remains a local degeneration statement until the full slice and remainder analysis is established [Step 100].

- The next positive priority is the single relative \(o(t^3)\) estimate for the product-orbifold Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction. The required work is to adapt Ozuch’s higher-order framework so that the computed leading matrix survives self, complement, frame, global-kernel, normalization, and logarithmic-annulus corrections. The large leading margins help only after a relative estimate is available; they do not overcome an \(O(t^{5/2})\) absolute remainder [Step 100].

- The adjacent-balanced row is no longer treated as a live leading-order existence window. If a future exact calculation changes the diagonal coefficient, the reciprocal-window criterion gives the threshold \(q_{\mathrm{diag}}\ge0.019426\) for reopening it; with the checked value \(q_{\mathrm{diag}}=0\), it is closed at leading order. Any subsequent phase-system analysis is conditional on correcting that coefficient or finding additional terms at the same order [Step 100].

- The research must preserve the local/global distinction. Even a successful positive-mirror local theorem would not establish a global no-Einstein result on \(\#_3(S^2\times S^2)\) or \(3\mathbb{CP}^2\#3\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^{\,2}\), and therefore would not refute the positive branch. The negative branch still requires either a new diffuse non-OT connector theorem on an all-sign reservoir such as \(N\#N\), or a new global obstruction insensitive to sign and distant from the known gauge/Kähler mechanisms [Steps 82–91, 100].

- Lean remains downstream of the mathematical geometry. The checked scaling and real-linear \(P/Q\) artifacts demonstrate that small algebraic components can be formalized, but the curvature, Levi–Civita, orbifold, gluing, spectral, and Lyapunov–Schmidt layers are not yet formalized. The formalization route should therefore proceed incrementally from certified finite-dimensional identities only after the analytic statement being formalized is fixed [Steps 69–74, 86–88, 99–100].

- The current state is unresolved but more sharply localized. Stable assets include the theorem-grade logarithmic \(A_1\) construction, corrected cone/flux analysis, ALE neutrality, the Sambusetti all-sign reservoir, the scalar-excess diffuseness constraint, the positive-mirror topology and symmetry ledger, calibrated same-chirality vanishing, the Step-100 diagonal tensor cancellation, and the closure of all five mixed positive patterns at leading order. The principal unfinished directions are: the relative \(o(t^3)\) theorem; exact verification that the spectral cancellation survives the full geometric reduction; global no-Einstein arguments for the mixed positive rows; diffuse negative connectors; the negative-mirror coefficient program; genuinely higher-dimensional mechanisms; and a faithful Lean differential-geometric foundation [Steps 83–100].
